Dr. Clark will go very far out of his way to help anyone! Great professor. His lectures are amazing! He manages to keep the class interested and aware. Book Response Essays are a wonderful teaching tool, discussions are great! Wonderful environment and great professor! AWESOME!!

Dr. Clark is an amazing professor and a great person willing to help anyone with anything. This class was  not only fun but very challenging. Dr. Howe is a wonderful professor, and extremely caring. He was extremely considerate and was willing to work with me while I was dealing with some family matters outside of school. The class is not a blow off class and you will learn a lot from it. Definitely recommend!

If you don't need an easy class, or if you like a professor that only reads PowerPoints, this is your class. Extremely easy course, however, very boring as well. Multiple "team projects" with randomized teams each time.

Mr. Hudson's material is very organized and basic (in a good way). A very solid, professional teacher who pays attention to detail so there are no surprises and mistakes in the material that has to be covered. What is covered is useful in the real world. Lectures  Useless Rambles

Great professor. Really cares about making his courses good. Class is taught at 8 AM which isn't everyone's cup of tea.
RUDE!!
Great professor, clear expectations, and very helpful.  Just do the homework and practice problems - and you'll be all set.
Very good professor he knows his stuff. The review sessions help out, and if you do the recommended problems in the book you'll be fine.

Dr. Flynn is the Chemistry professor to take Chemistry with at WT.  He's tough but he's totally fair.  He's available to his students anytime.
Hard grader, many test, and no helpful notes.
A very simple class strict on test but other than that, it's OK

MKT 3342* this class w.b based off an audio blog, that you must respond to daily. He gives you the deadline to respond to them. This makes up most of your grade. reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor. Make sure you pick a group of people that contribute or else you end up doing majority of the work. Would take any class he teaches.

Video blog book review wasn't my favorite part, but it was done individually. Overall, the work is extensive, but professor grades fairly. Recommend!

This is a nontraditional class. The class is based on his blog and participation within. The biggest challenge is the group project, and tests are in groups. But it is manageable with good communication and a good group. He's not hard on grading as long as it's quality. This was an interesting class and would recommend taking it with him.

Dr. Gerlich is very dedicated to his class; he shares daily blogs about current events in marketing.  He always responds immediately via text messaging. The grades consist of daily blog participation and two group projects. The group project has challenges, but it also allows us to collaborate where each member brings forth their best attributes.

So I agree this is not a professor hard core students want to take. He does do non traditional things that do help you learn the subject matter, so do not take if you like traditional learning. I think you get what you put into the class. Two big group projects for this class with no tests. You must comment on blog posts to pass.

This class was useless, and I feel dumber. There were essentially two grading components; group projects (two exams and a paper), and participation on his blog. There was zero reference to any actual instruction. Zero. No textbook, no lectures, no slideshows. The final group exam accounted for 30% of my grade and took me 15 mins. Useless.
You will have great discussions about current events related to marketing through daily blogs.

reminds me of some of my highschool teachers who left a lasting impact on my life. wish i could have taken a class with him in person. for evolutionary marketing you'll have a lot of "homework" but its really just posting responses to his blog. Turn your brain on for 2 seconds and you'll get full credit. Multiple group projects can be a challen

Took this professor for an ungrad class as well, didn't disappoint. He teaches through daily discussion boards about current events. Large group project, and two group exams in essay format. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: All you have to do is the daily blogs and the tests
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

If you don't follow them or you don't know how you will be in trouble. If you find yourself in a bad group you will be in trouble. If you can follow instructions and work well in groups, you will be fine.
Read daily blogs and respond to them of up to two paragraphs every day. Only 1 hour to do the test which are online.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Most of your grade is a group grade, including the midterm and final. Little and non-specific feedback (or none at all) and delay in grading. Repetitive, daily blog prompts. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: The amount of work is just staggering. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Gerlich has a daily blog that he required students to post 20 discussion replies to every 4 weeks or so. The blogs are all marketing related and I found them quite interesting. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I had no problems in his marketing class.  I enjoyed his assignments and blog.  What I could not believe is that people would give up the easiest grade in the class.  We were supposed to comment in the discussion forum 80 times, and some people posted maybe 10.  I do not like my tests being group projects though...
One of the best marketing classes I've ever taken. Dr. Gerlich keeps the content fresh and exciting. He really cares about the students and their success.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This class was primarily group work, exams and essays. Enjoyed the content the professor provided.

-Many group papers. Never told me he had a problem viewing it. Fixed only after I saw my transcript.
This class was fun and quite interesting. I am not a marketing fan, but Dr. Gerlich does an excellent job keeping students engaged. I highly recommend this professor!

Tends to rant about is old days, doesn't cover most of the material needed for the exams. He seems to focused on his photography or breaking bad tours to care about class.
I'm a good student for the record. But his tests are unreasonably hard. It's at the point where if I had studied twice as hard, I still would have made the same grade.

Exam grades are based on group exams. You are part of a group of 5-6 other students. There is no credit for your own work. If you have loser team mates, they will destroy your A. Professor rarely answers emails, does not use a text book, and will not help you if you have non-participating group members. He just expects you to do the work for them.

Great professor.  Encouraged group projects to split the work and exams were done as a group.  He is eager to answer questions when you need help and fast responses.  Best class I took so far. I wish he taught more classes.
Grading for Class participation is unreasonable for an online class.
Good teacher, Beware of tricky multiple choice tests. Overall good teacher but not an easy class by any means.

He's not a very interesting professor to listen to and often times he is sort boring in class. He's very nice and his office hours are always good to go in if you are not understanding something. reviews.comment: He's a good professor if you like to read and enjoy psych. He does tend to ramble during lectures which causes the schedule to get off track pretty often. He's pretty understanding and open to questions. Memorization won't get you anywhere.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Best professor I've had, but don't take him if you're lazy. If you actually want to learn and work hard, take him. His lectures are AWESOME if you put in the work and read the book before class (it's college, stop complaining about reading a textbook). He really cares that his students are learning and not just regurgitating. Loved this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: rants about his life stories that is irrelevant to the topics he's teaching. All he does is stay on one slide for a majority of the time and talks about his life stories. Very rude at times too during office times, tests are horrible UNLESS you actually read the book and go through slides on your own.
He is a very smart man but a horrible teacher. He does not seam to understand that you are in his class to learn and that you do not already know the material.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's very passionate about psych, so his lectures aren't too bad, but I can never really get into them. His tests are half what's covered in lecture and half what's in the textbook so you have to really read and show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He really cares about you understanding the material and not just memorizing it, which makes the class really hard because the tests have a lot of concept questions and not as much math as you would think. He is not a bad professor because he cares and gives tests back with feedback, but you cant keep em. He urges you to go to tutoring so do it.

He is an extremely tough professor but he prepared me, as an undergraduate, better than any other professor did for what to expect in graduate school. He is always willing to help and is brilliant but sometimes disorganized.
Likes to intimidate students. Gives no feedback. Never makes appointments on time.

Took him for stats, experimental, learning. I made As in all 3 courses, but oh, I worked for them! He is very intelligent, and very willing to help, IF you show him you truly are trying and take his courses (and psych) seriously. I would try to get on his good side; (I think) I did, and it does pay off in the end! Oh, and READ THE TEXTBOOK!

He has you work the problems before class which always really confused me. But once he explains it, it gets easier. Also if you ask for help, he's there to do what he can. I think the biggest problem was he understands everything so well and it's hard for him to dumb it down.

Dr. Byrd is a terrible undergrad professor. He does not and will not report grades at all during the semester so don't bother asking. Questions & comments just throw him off, that's never a good thing. His tests are neither valid nor reliable as they test you mostly on language and he uses too many distractor options.

I had this professor for several classes and would take more with him in a minute.  He is excellent - requires much of his students, but students will remember the material when engaging in a career in psychology.  He is concerned that students learn and be able to apply material learned.
Very disorganized. Lost my final test. Took over my lab time after he'd approved it weeks in advance. Bright, scatterbrained. Difficult to predict what he will test over. Hate him a decade later.

Took Dr Byrd for about 5 classes in my undergrad. A common misconception is that he doesnt care for the student and is unapproachable. I found this not to be true. His material IS much more difficult than many other pysc teachers and he can be unorganized at times, however he legitimately cares that you are really learning and not regurgitating.

He is a very hard teacher I would have to study a week in advance, and spent most of my time with his class. He doesnt lecture out of the text but you NEED to READ IT because you wont understand what hes talking about. He is very unorginized. I donr recomend him but he is the only perfossor that teaches certain classes!Prepare yourself!

One of my most challenging classes so far. He doesn't teach what will be on the test and is a harsh grader, especially when it comes to the open-ended questions. Be prepared to be challenged, yet confused and lost at the same time.

he was a great teacher, and pretty easy.

VERY GOOD TEACHER!!! :)
Just be there for the notes and the review sheet. Do the 4 papers and you'll definetly pass.
Excellent professor, very personable. He is funny and knows his material. A++

great guy, very personable, genuinely cares about his students. knows his material, but generally follows a straight lecture format (can be boring). if you take notes and study for tests, his classes are pretty easy!

Very sweet and caring! Will work with you to get a good grade. Overall the best professor I have had the pleasure of knowing!

Just take Dr. Khan.

I start with this because many students get worried when they see heavily graded exams, but I promise you if you show up to SI and fully utilize your resources for the final...you're gonna pass. Also, he's super funny and kind. A++

Excellent Professor, wouldn't want anyone else for chemistry which is a tough subject. Really grateful that Dr. Khan goes the extra mile to help his students have the best chance at success possible. 

Make sure to go to SI and tutoring in order to have a chance at your best possible grade.

Ignore the people who say bad things about this professor. He genuinely wants to see his students succeed and is willing to help. He even tell you what you need to know for the upcoming exams. Definitely do your homework and study and you'll be fine. Even though I got a D in his class, that was unrelated to his teaching, it's because I suck at math

Professor Khan is excellent and really cares if you care about your grade. It is absolutely do-able to get a good grade, I'm so happy to have a teacher who really wants you to succeed in a tough core class like chemistry. Highly recommend getting a tutor for chemistry and go to all SI sessions to make sure you nail exams(do the practice problems).

Ignore any of the positive reviews on this guy. Don't take him, he has no idea how to teach. His attitude is appalling. He acts like he is better than anybody. If anyone says anything good about this guy, they're lying. He doesn't know how to talk to his students, he just plain rude. DO NOT TAKE HIM!

Take chem with Dr. Khan!! He is very knowledgable and has good lectures. His homework is not required, but you probably won't pass the exams if you don't do it (the exams are based off the homework.) Chemistry is very hard, but he wants his students to pass and is a lot of help during office hours.
There are other options in the department. That's all I'm comfortable saying right now given his reputation.
I'm changing majors because of this guy. Rarely in his office and takes way too long to reply to emails. Not a very good teacher either.

It's a difficult class, but he does his best to make it easier. Buy his biochem 101 book, it'll save your life. The final is worth 50% of your grade, but he tries to make it pretty simple. His lectures are long, but he keeps them interesting and explains them very in-depth. If you speak up, Khan will help!!

While a tough regimen when it comes to grading (3 test grades including the final w/ no retakes) it is very doable if you show up to class and do the homework, he even mentions some of the questions in the tests are just copy pasted from the homework, very easy to work with.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

Sarcastic but super funny and nice guy.

Dr. Khan is an amazing instructor. He wrote the book used in class and it is easy to follow compared to other chemistry books I have read in the past. reviews.comment: (Chem 2 Summer) Get his book. Homework is not mandatory and is light. Much easier than chem 1.  Very easy topics, especially if you study before class. Skips a lot of material in the book. Liked him until the final. Doesn't curve often. Made a 90 and 95, 88 in lab, and still got a B. Final is 50% of the grade and I ran out of time; it was harder.

Amazing professor if you show that you care.  Available outside of class to help with any questions and if you go and ask for help you will definitely do well.  Easy A if you get his book and really study the material thoroughly.  GET HIS BOOK.

reviews.comment: Pay attention in class, if you have questions don't be afraid to ask because he will move on. He likes feedback and when students speak up. reviews.comment: he does not have graded homework the only thing that will be for a grade is three tests Test One is over the first 3 chapters and is 20% of your Grade Test two is the next 3 chapters and is 20% of your grade the final is 50% of the grade and the other 10% is the lab. He goes very fast in his lectures and is not very helpful when explaing
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's very funny. His class is never boring. He demonstrates very clearly.  Strongly recommend his book for those who take his class, it contains test questions in previous years. It is extremely helpful. The course is much easier when you have that book.

Dr. Khan is a great professor. He is blunt, but has enjoyable lectures. For people who haven't taken or didn't have a good chemistry in high school, the subject is a lot to handle. If you have any questions, don't be afraid to ask!

The book he wrote is a must! It helps greatly and has practice problems for each chapter. I couldn't have done so well without it. Overall his class is very enjoyable and he is always willing to help you.

The class is vigorous and tough, but if you do the "recommend" homework and go to class, you will pass. He is also very helpful and available when you are having problems or need extra help. He wants his students to be successful.

Took Dr. Khan for Chemistry II (1412) during the SUMMER. the course material was very difficult but he explained everything very well! great lectures, cool guy! but there's only 3 tests and  the 3rd test counts 50% of the grade. you get the grade you work for. again this is his SUMMER course. he may be different during semesters.

Get ready to study for exams a week ahead!! He does his best to help you understand the subject, but let's face it; chemistry is hard in general. Oh yeah, test are worth about 30 percent, final 60 percent, and 10 percent in class participation. (I think, I can't remember at the moment, but its very similar) Make sure to get his BOOK, its a must!!!

Chem in general isn't easy so don't expect to skip class and pass. He recommends you to buy his book which helps in the long run and has past test examples. Speak up if you have questions and he will answer them.

It's not that he's a bad prof, but Chemistry is just a hard subject. His self-written book is super helpful and he's a pretty funny guy. He knows what he's talking about (unlike most) and will help you whenever he can. The curves on the tests are nice (10-20 points). People who fail his class usually don't show up or don't study.

He is a good professor. The criteria is tough and he is wiling to help you as long as you go to him and ask for it.  Has a book to go along with his lecture which is quite helpful and doesn't make the class drag.  The main downside is that the only grades are test grades, so there's no extra fluff to help your overall grade. Must work hard in class

Wow! Mixed reviews. I got a B, but was close to an A (95 going into the final). I could have done several things differently. If it is in his book, you must know it - understand it & memorize it. Some exam questions were copies to the practice ones, but with 1-2 slight changes, so be careful. I did not get the grade I wanted, but that's on me.

I agree with the last post, I personally know that this class was hard, and some exam questions I didn't think was right.  But with the curves etc., you should be fine.  He is fair.  One thing that I do agree with, is buy his book!!!  I got an A in the course, but would not have without the book!!!
Thanks Dr. K.!!!  You're the best!!!

Khan's class is not just about learning the concepts and memorizing what needs memorizing - you need to memorize his exact words.  Buy the supplemental book - it's full of his slides with fill-in-the-blanks.  All he does in lecture is read the slides.  Tests are really tricky.

Tough and confusing tests,  he uses  the a-j scantron - which sucks since they're your whole class grade.  Be prepared for trick questions. And the final is worth 50% of your grade. I wouldn't take another class with him.

It doesn't matter if you like him or not - he's so in love with himself that  other people's opinions are irrelevant.  Your Biochem grade is 3, multiple choice exams (including the final) and the final is worth 50%.   He is intentionally tricky - puts incorrect structures and misspellings as options.  Buy the supplement book and study it.

I'm a nursing major so passing Chemistry basically determines if you get into the nursing program. Overall, Dr. Khan is one of the BEST professors I've ever had! He knows what he's talking about and is totally open to helping you out. But, you have to study or you'll definitely fail. It's not easy, but if you study, it can be.

I had Chem II and Biochem I with Dr. Khan.  Exams are multiple choice.  BEWARE on exams - he will intentionally provide incorrect answers with misspellings and incorrect structures.  He was great in Chem II, but seemed to have more of an attitude during Biochem.  Would I take another course with him?  I'll look into other options first.

Great guy. The semester I took was the first to get his book. SOOO helpful I think it was $40 but worth every penny. After tests make sure to go to office and look at it. Questions from other tests are similar to final.

Great professor. Challenges students during lecture and on exams.  If you can pass Organic I and II with an A or B at WTAMU then this class is not that difficult.  Lots of information to memorize, and solid study habits are a must.  I spent 20+ hours preparing for each exam, and the final was cumulative.
Class is tough, tests are surprisingly tricky.  It's a fun subject though, and he knows what he's talking about.
to hard!!!!!  Boring!!

I don?t know?I did really well on his final.  I liked his class and thought he was very helpful.  True?he?s tough and you have to do the homework, but welcome to college!!!  Plus, he is not hard to look at first thing monday morning!!
Just reads the slide show out loud--if you ask him questions he helps you--but somehow he's exams were impossible. we had a 20 point curve on our final because the whole class failed.
He teaches off a slide show and doesn't show how to do the math related work.
Super nice professor, uses examples and personal experience throughout the lectures, and explains accounting really well.

I could not recommend Prof Lightfoot enough for Acct 1. The class is structured very well. Definitely take this class for accounting. Dr. Lightfoot's lectures are clear and easy to understand. She goes out of her way to really make sure that you understand the material. Homework is based of her lectures and the Exams are based of both lectures and homework. She offers a decent amount of extra credit. You will do well in her class.

reviews.comment: Very good about making sure we understood the material. Was very nice and cared about us as students. Great lessons and can't wait to take more classes from her!

Great professor. Would take again.

If you read the material, take good notes, and work hard, you will be fine. Everything is there for you to succeed!

This class was useless, just takes up a lot of time and you do not learn anything useful at all. A lot of papers and discussions over the assigned book. If you pay attention and try hard It's easy to get an A in this class. Dr. Lockwood really cares about how her students learn and tries very hard to teach how and why calculus works.
Didn't always follow the syllabus.

Great Professor!!! I'll be taking her for calc II. She is one of the easiest calc professors there on campus. Material is hard but you have to attend class every day and pay attention in order to pass.

Ok, So if your looking for an easy professor who just let's you slide by and pass the class, DO NOT TAKE Dr. Lockwood. However, if you want to be the absolute best calculus student possible, Dr. Lockwood will take you to the next level with your math and reasoning skills. She is very helpful and in fact let my class text her to ask questions.

Very tough class but well worth it!  Dr. L makes students work hard and challenges them, which forces students to use their brains and learn the material.  She teaches Calculus II exactly how it should be done!

Very difficult class, with little to no help from the professor.  She has very few open office hours, and will cut tests short/move the class so that she can go to meetings.  She does not put teaching first.  She did not give us the student evaluation forms, so I felt that this was the best way to say to her or anyone else: Do not take her class!

She was too busy with administrative duties. Students were second to meetings and university deadlines. Unnecessary amount of homework.We never knew what was next or what she felt was important enough to be on a test.Plays favorites and grades accordingly.
Good teacher, cares about students.  Knows her stuff.
No Comments

McFarland is a pretty chill professor, knows what he's doing, and is hella funny too. Attendance isn't mandatory, but highly encouraged. He can be tough on critiques, but for good reason. Available outside of class most of the time, I would take a course from him again.
McFarland is by far my most favorite professor. He is super kind, funny, and will help you whenever you need it. Just go to class and you will be alright.

This class was Basic Video Production and we had to use a lot of creativity and imagination in his class. He is always there to help you if you need it. We learned how to use video editing software and edit videos and documentaries. Not too difficult but does require some effort and imagination.

Ochem can seem very daunting but if you put in the work you will easily pass this class. Shresta will help you in any way she can, but you must ask questions or she will assume you understand. Go to the SI sessions, even if you just go once a week you will have a much better grasp on the course material.

If I didn't have to take her I wouldn't but she's the only teacher. Her homework does not match our exams. Not enough quizzes to cover all exam topics per exam. Any teacher who says a 68% average is great on exams is a red flag. Exams are reasonable, before is not.

Go to SI and get a tutor if you want a chance in this class to pass.

Dr. Shrestha is great at explaining the content in the lectures. I never had an issue understanding her explanations. She provides multiple attempts on the quizzes which help boost your grade. Her exams are fair but difficult. I recommend buying a modeling kit but do not buy the textbook. I used it once for practice problems and they do not help.

Dr. Shrestha is VERY smart. Her exams are tough, though. Go to the SI sessions, especially if they're still with Anisha. She is pretty difficult to understand sometimes, so keep that in mind. I found the textbook free online because you only need the practice problems.  You'll basically need to memorize all of the slides and the practice tests.

reviews.comment: He assigns a lot of homework, but he's a great professor and makes sure that you know your stuff. If you put in effort he'll put effort into you.
Great professor. I liked him so much I woke up 10 minutes before registration to make sure I got his class this semester.

Professor Moore was very clear and organized. His straightforward lectures were never boring or slow, yet I rarely felt rushed to keep up with his class. For our group projects he was readily available at his office and was very helpful. I had the blessing of taking him for both 2413 and 2414, and I wish I could have taken him for 3340 and beyond.

Moore is a very understanding professor and is always open to answer questions and is easily accessibly via email. His test reviews are always harder than the tests which make the tests much easier; the homework can be a lot sometimes, but if you ask him about it, Moore will always help.

Dr Moore has great organized lectures. There was a lot of homework, however, it was helpful for all the practice.  Exams were not too difficult. If you study the homework, you will be fine. He is super kind and very helpful if you are confused.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor N. Moore is probably the best calculus teacher you could take. He checks in on the class, he explains things to the best of his ability, he's super approachable, his office hours are great, and will take the time to explain everything you need. Absolutely the best professor I have taken for math.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Microbiology is freaking awesome. This professor is on fire with his teaching. His exam are pretty simple to pass as long as you are actively following through his slide shows (which are really nicely laid out). Professor Williams is very passionate about teaching microbiology, sometimes before each exam we have day toreviewinclassfor extra credit.

I thought this professor was nice at first and classes were always so interesting but when it came to asking questions he would roll his eyes. Teachers when you don't understand something they spent their whole life studying:

This professor uses written in answers instead of multiple choice on his tests. If you dont write everything exact, word for word from the PowerPoint, he will fail you. And his tests are all he grades.

He does not care about his students. One time, I told him the equipment in the lab wasn't working, and he argued with me that it was my fault until the TA came in and told him that he couldn't get it to work either.

He thinks very highly of himself, makes zero time for his students, and is as horrible as the bad ratings say. Just because he's passionate about teaching does not mean he's a good person. If you ever go to his office to ask for help, he will blow you off and treat you like you're a thorn on his side.

Dr. Williams did a fantastic job teaching this class. Although attendance isn't required I highly suggest you go for the in class assignments. Those definitely help boost your grade. Going into this class I was scared based on his ratings however as long as you study a little for the tests and show up for the class you should be totally fine!

I think he was a great professor I think that if you spent any energy showing up and paying attention and committing to studying you will be FINE He had somewhat challenging exams, but had a study day the class before that helps a lot, I think people think this class is going to be easy, but it's an upper level bio class so pay attention in class
Dr. Williams is awesome at teaching. Put some respect on this man's name. If you pay attention in class you'll do great.

Professor Malachi is extremely passionate about his course, and it shows, between both the lectures and the lab. you will hear "because microbiology is awesome," and TBH, the course was awesome because he was my professor.
So if you have to take microbiology, his class is awesome.

This professor teaches so bad, I had to come here and warn others. I missed bc I was sick and brought him a doctors note. I asked if we could go over the important things in class  because sometimes, answers on the exam aren't found anywhere in the slides or textbook because he likes to make things hard. He said no bc "it was my fault for missing"

I was nervous since I had looked at rate my professor prior to class, but I was pleasantly surprised! His class is pretty self explanatory, he has clear grading guidelines and clear expectations. His exams are multiple choice and no textbook was required. As long as you follow the slides and study you will get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was an overall just awful professor, doesn't like to work with students or meet them in the middle. If I had to choose, I'd go with a different microbiology professor.

Easy class, consisted of 3 papers due about a month apart. He responds to emails fairly quickly, and since you have to form your own opinion on the topics the content is actually quite interesting to research.

Dr. Owens is one of those professors who you can tell knows plenty about the subject he teaches, but doesn't have the first clue as to how to teach.  Sadly, he's the only prof that seems to teach FIN6320.
Very tough class, homework sucks, tests are really hard and you have to basically teach yourself.  DONT TAKE ONLINE if you can avoid it.  He does grade fairly.
Great Lecturer, easy to listen to. Tests and assignments are extremely hard though so take with caution.
He is smart and knows what he is talking about. His tests in the other hand....

Excellent lecturer, brings current issues to class
Great Professor!

She is really smart and I feel that she has high expectations from us. If you study and do the reading, she also gives 60 points worth of extra credit!!

If youre late for whatever reason, excuse or non-excuse, shell kick you out of class and not allow you to participate nor be there for the lecture. Just be prepared for a professor who just very strict, monotone, and hard.

Doppler Dave is a great professor. Attendance isn't mandatory, but he gives extra credit for it. He bumps your final grade up by 2 points if you don't miss more than two classes, which can be the line between a B and an A. He is extremely excited about the subject and loves teaching it and when you engage. He gives as much extra credit as he can!

Doppler Dave is good professor. Come to class, study for exams, do assignments and pay attention in class and it will be an easy A for you. He provides study guides which are helpful and will try to find very understanding ways to help you understand a topic. I would definitely take him again.

I am from around here and I thought it we be fun to have Meteorologist " Doppler Dave" as a professor. Don't under estimate him. He really does care about his students. He just sometimes forgets that we aren't as passionate for meteorology as he is. His test are hard so study a lot.

My major is nowhere near enviro science/meteorology but I wish my department had the quality of professor that Dave Oliver is.  He knows everything there is to know about the weather/atmosphere/earth's interaction with the weather etc. Seriously, he could give a 2 hour lecture just from memory. Expects a lot from the student, but truly cares.
He is a very kind and funny man. Actually the local weather man "Doppler Dave", and he knows it. That being said the class is interesting and worth taking.

Great professor. I only wish he taught more than one class that I had to take. He genuinely cares that the students understand the material he is teaching. He won't give you your grades, but if you show up, make a solid effort and ask questions in class or privately, he will make sure you understand and pass the class. Top notch instructor.

If this is the same teacher that is Amarillo College now  then he is great. I am not good at English and i do not like the subject, but he helped alot. He gives you a chance to correct your essays and stuff so you can not only get a better grade, but learn what you did wrong. He taught me more in eight weeks than i learned in 12 years of schooling.

Mr. Joshuah O'Brien was my professor for english 1302 research and rhetoric class. He is wonderful , lovely, handsome and helpful. You need a book, expect to have pop quiz, extra credit and a lot of papers. However, it is worthy because he explains very good.

A very helpful and kind guy. I took his class for English 1301 and it was totally easy to get an A. I just came to class and did what he said. He's really nice with international student. I like him and am looking forward to taking his class ^^

He can be hard and harsh before and during the midterm, but everyones work was flawless in the final. "A"

He challenged us to think a little more and challenge ourselves. The material is not difficult and in hindsight neither were the exams once you put in the work. It's college not high school, and it's engineering so im not sure why people expect it to be a breeze.
He is clearly very smart, but most of the people are struggling. He treats the class like a senior level course.

Dr.Perkins is my favorite professor at WT. He is the most willing professor on campus, and the class is fun and interactive. You get to do really cool time worthy presentations as well. Dr. Perkins is also extremely personable and willing to help.

A great professor and person. His lectures are easy and fun as long as you participate and get the most out of them. He is always willing to help and go out of his way to make sure you understand what he is teaching.

Dr. Perkins is one of the best professors I have had in my college experience here at WT. He genuinely cares about the well being of his students, and if you are comprehending the material. Blake is a great teacher, his classes are not easy but if you put forth the effort you will get the grade you want. I do not like his test format he has a lot of writing on the tests and show move them to where you can type them on the computer.

Blake is very personal and a good teacher and overall good person. His classes are fairly easy just take notes you will be fine.

Price is awesome!  You are going to work for your grade, but you will have a lot of fun every day.  A lot of professors are too busy to deal with student issues, but you can go talk to him any time. Awesome teacher!
Of all the professors I've had, he's been my favorite

This may be the best course I have ever taken!  Not only is the content directly applicable to my career (teaching/coaching), but Blake makes the course interesting. Awesome class!  I learned so much that will help me in my coaching career.

Tirey is the real gem of the WT math department, he cares about your grades and will help you understand all the material. He was by far my favorite professor!

so energetic, classes are not boring

Tirey was THE BEST!! He is incredibly understanding and willing to work w/ you. He provides many opportunities for office hours & extra help. Responds to emails quickly. He clearly wants his students to succeed, but wants to see effort. He gives amazing exam reviews & prepares you for tests. Quizzes everyday over the previous class lecture.

Professor Tirey is a great teacher and makes learning fun. I appreciated how he took the time to explain and answer any questions students had. It was nice to be able to use the online textbook and not have to purchase one

Took Tirey for Math for lib. arts and this the best choice ever! If you have the chance to take this class over algebra, DO IT! Professor Tirey is an awesome professor!! Very understanding and cares a lot about his students. I was stressing about my grade before the class started but ended with a high A. I cannot say enough good things about Prof. Tirey! He really cares about his students and wants the very best for them. He takes his time explaining and understands that not everyone 'gets' math. Be prepared for homework after every class and exams every few weeks. If you struggle with math he is definitely the right professor for you!

Easily one of the best professors on campus. Tests are pretty straightforward and are online. Very occasionally gives homeworks with them only being around 15 minute assignments max on average. Highly recommend.

Grading criteria is not set. He does not use rubrics for projects, so it is hard to know how much detail he is looking for. He is a great professor. If you come in and participate the class goes by fast and you get out early.

Mr. Ray is a great professor, if you need this class credit take his class.

Great professor!! He has amazing lectures and he makes the content very fun to learn. You have to participate in the lectures sometimes for credit but its not hard. He lets you out of class early every time as well which is nice.

By far the coolest professor ever. He had a rocking mullet at one. He was even in a band called "Legend 7" look him up! He is so awesome. He made me love my major and help me get my job right out of college.

This guy knows what he's talking about, always. He's definitely not nice if you don't show any interest in his class, and you can't just coast through, but you're better off at the end of the semester. Feel like I made a friend as well as learned what I needed. Fantastic teacher and mentor.
I've had Mr. Ray every semester, he is a GREAT guy and really cares about his students! He knows so much about what he teaches!

Dr. Matlack gives great and intriguing lectures. He throws in jokes and personal field experience that make his class fun. Attendance is very mandatory as there is a ton of information to cover. What an amazing professor. He loves his job you can tell. He understands things can happen outside of school. As long as you show up I promise you will learn what you need to pass his extremely interesting class. Good luck yall.

Dr. Matlack is pretty great. He doesn't go into a whole lot of detail so it's not a super in-depth course. If you do bad, it's all your fault or you cant read ppts.

Dr. Matlack for some reason has his 2000 level classes being much harder than his higher level classes for no reason. His test are fill in the blanks mostly and requires you to memorize his whole lecture otherwise good luck passing his class. But at least he's not a boring professor.

Dr. Matlack is a funny professor who cares about his students. He can sometimes get off topic but overall his lectures are super important because all of the answers on the test are there. Matlack is overall a great professor. He really cares about his students and tries to prepare them for the future. However he's a scatter brain which leads to interesting lectures but can also cause him to be unreliable sometimes. The material for his classes is fairly easy but he can be a hard grader. Also be prepared for open ended test questions

One of my favorite professors! He is very engaging in his lectures and keeps all of his classes interesting. If you show up and take notes the tests are not very difficult. Love Dr. Matlack! I've had two of his classes. His lectures are entertaining, as well as informative and his class is structured in a manner that allows good discussion. Tests are directly from the lectures, which are easy to stay attentive during.

If you sit through one of his classes, you have sat through them all. He doesn't change lectures or tests year to year either, so nearly all the students have old tests and make an easy A that way. He is incredibly flaky and unreliable, just ask any grad student he has ever had. You're forced to take his classes for wildlife but don't learn much.

Dr. Matlack is actually a great professor and very helpful. 9 times out of 10 he will work with you if you need something. I've taken 4 of his classes now and all are are power point driven with the tests coming exactly from the notes so be prepared to take notes, know them, and don't miss class.

Matlack provides no advising on what classes are needed to be a wildlife biologist, doesn't have office hours, can't keep graduate students around,  sleeps through or abandons students on his field trips (seriously), gives no career help. His classes are uninformative and repetitive. He's unreliable as a professor and mentor.

Ray is a fun guy but a horrible professor. His classes do not prepare you to be a wildlife biologist, it's just memorizing the same basic information for every class. Don't let him help you with any research, he knows nothing about good experimental design and will likely flake out on you half way through. Don't be deceived by his charm.
If you like taking tons of notes, memorizing useless material, and having fill in the blank tests with no study guide, this class is for you.

Useless prof if you want to be a wildlife biologist. Funny but knows nothing about ecology. His classes are required so you can expect an easy A without learning a thing. Doesn't prep you for future.
Excellent professor with a great sense of humor.
Very nice guy who has lots of interesting stories to tell. The only thing I dislike is how he grades- EXTREMELY picky.

He is so fun and upbeat. Even though we have very different worldviews, he is a great teacher and I hope I can take more of his classes. his tests are fairly easy and the material is manageable. I suggest him to people who are willing to do some work, but not as much to people who love to be fiercely challenged, for them I suggest Kazmaier.
It was so fun despite it being early in the morning. He's very passionate and charismatic.

His 2 obsessions are powerpoint and bats. His lessons and seemingly his knowledge do not stray from what's on the powerpoint, even if you find something contradictory in the book. And he's a bat biologist, so every example he gives is related back to bats.
No Comments

Dr.Bingham is an amazing teacher who really cares about what she teaches. She goes above and beyond to get you ready for whatever.

Dr. Welch is amazing!! Best professor makes everything so easy to understand and follow along with.
