A bit of writing but nothing too hard and you get to develop your writing skills further than with many of the other business professors. Definitely a business communication class.

I LOVED this class with Dr. Berry. It's pretty self explanatory and if you just do your work diligently you'll pass. She is a great teacher and I really took a lot out of the class without it being over baring.

Really focuses on grammar in each assignment, and shows you how much you might not know about it. Tons of extra credit opportunity. Very understanding if she sees you're working at it. Harder than one might expect but if you work even a little bit, very little chance to fail.

Dr. Berry is a perfect example of how a professor should conduct themselves. Dr. Berry is the most personable professor I have encountered. She provides not only insightful lectures, but lessons a student can apply in their everyday life.

I got an easy A in her class, but it's because I am good at writing papers. This is the only form of projects we were graded on, other than an oral presentation.  She appreciates hard work and extensive proofreading. She also seemed a little partial to me because I participate in class. Class is more beneficial to take in first semester of college

Good professor. The class is very interesting and she's very nice, she makes you feel open to ask questions and interact with the class. Papers are 2000 words but eh it's okay. Overall would take again

Dr. Berry is a very creative in her teaching skills, and communication is very clear when speaking with the students. I as a student understand clearly and anytime I have a question Dr. Berry never hesitates to answer and help me better understand.
Great teacher
Great professor that gives good projects. Makes students interact with each other which is usually fun. She explains in very good detail and gives you opportunities for extra credit.
Very interactive with students and clearly explains information and projects to us.
Great professor and makes classes fun

Dr. Berry is a pretty great professor. Down to earth, simple to understand and relatable. Her lectures and assignment aren't just work you have to complete, they're -must-know-for-life information. She is always available to critique rough drafts which is an opportunity for an easy A for the caring student. , try in this class and you will succeed

I wished I'd seen the previous review before taking her. Weekly 500 word discussion board with 2-250 word replies,1500 word monthly writing assignments and a COMPREHENSIVE FINAL. Lots to read. Too bad she takes the "my way or the highway" attitude for conflict resolution/ negotiation. Doesn't care about student's personal issues. Take someone else

Weekly discussions are actually papers. She will expect a 500 word paper with citations, plus 2 - 250 word responses to other classmates every week. She also expects you to read several supplemental papers that are about 30 pages in length each. So expect to read 100+ pages every week in total.
Professor Medlock was an interesting professor. Overall her class was really easy and she made it fun. Lots of group work and in class skits/acting.
Anne is a very passionate person who loves what she does. I enjoyed her class
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Asked for feedback for a final. She said it looked great and gave me a D.  Caused me to make my first b in college.
Easy open book quizes almost every class meet. Mandatory theater production viewings. Group projects for tests.

Anne is so fun! She is very passionate about her work and makes class very interesting. If you enjoy theatre, this is the class for you. It will be a breeze. Be prepared for many group projects. Step out of your comfort zone in this class and you will breeze right through it!
GROUP PROJECTS. If you dont like em, dont take her class. Anne was a wonderful instructor. All you had to do was take some quizzes, write play reviews and do A LOT of projects.
Very energetic, lots of group projects, only a few online quizes and just a nice person

Dr.Macy is one of the best professors I've had at WT. She truly cares that her students succeed and will do what she can to help them. You are allowed to bring one note sheet per unit for the exams which was really helpful. There are pop quizzes so be prepared to do a lot of studying. If you put forth the effort to learn, you will succeed.

It is a hard class, but she is a good teacher. She relates a lot of the stuff to things in real life. She usually gives a heads up when there is a quiz and gives an idea of what the test questions are going to be the class before the test. You also get to bring one page of notes front and back for each unit on the test.
This was a great class and I always enjoyed the side story's! I highly recommend that everyone takes a class from Dr. Anne. She will always make you laugh as you learn!
I really enjoyed this professor and her class, just be aware of pop quizzes and be willing to study a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment:
Easy class. The amount of curves in this class is insane. 

If you want to pass, just do the practice exams. If that isn't enough, she also lets you bring 1 entire page of paper per chapter as a guide for when you have in person tests. I would say it is impossible to fail this class unless if you put 0 effort in.

This is probably one of the hardest classes I have taken so far in college. Her introduction to the course was "This class is extremely difficult" and she was not lying. It's just too much material to learn in a summer session. She does builds in a 30 point curve knowing that you are going to get your ass kicked.

Dr. Macy was a great professor to have! She was always willing to help out students with questions and did her best to help everybody do better in her class. She is a tough grader, and requires attendance so you will have to show up to class. Otherwise, so long as you study and get the help that you need, an A is easily attainable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Do you want to hate your life? Are you looking to feel inadequate and hopeless? Have I got the class for you! She's horrible. Scattered, all of her notes is nonsense that you study, then never see again. She taught a beginners class you like you were already an accountant. 80% of the class dropped out on week 2. I stuck it out. Wish I had left.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Macy is by far one of the best professors Ive had in my entire academic experience. My only regret is taking her masters level course during a summer-mester. I genuinely love finance, but with a demanding career, it was hard to make it happen. Her class is not easy. She doesnt give fluff work. You will either know it or you wont! Just study!
Ok class. The exams are hard and its difficult to understand the solutions to the questions. A lot of reading. So if you are a visual learner this class is not for you.

This course has got to be the worst course I have ever taken. The professor teaches based off her personal notes, it does not cover all the topics on the test. The paper was pretty difficult. There is 3 tests and a paper to make up your grade. The final is optional and can be used to take place of one of the lower test scores.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Macy might be my all time favorite professor. The way she structures her classes allows you to truly grasp and learn from a subject. She also really cares about her students and is always willing to help and give feedback. However, her classes are no cakewalk, you have to put in effort to get an A, but all in all her classes are very rewarding

She is very up front about her expectations and actually sent out a "if you don't like it, drop the class now" message before classes began; I loved it. The SMIF paper takes a lot of time to complete, but as long as you don't wait till the last minute, it is doable and she doesn't grade too harshly. Good teacher, responds quickly to questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is my 2nd course with Dr. Macy. Now that I've used what she taught me at work so many times, I see what a gem she is. If you're willing to work, you will learn so much in FIN6370. She brings real-life experience to her lectures, which really cannot be beat. She's smart, caring, accessible and a fair grader.

Tough class due to not much "fluff" Your grade lies on the exams and the paper only. Read, Read, read the notes she gives you. If you don't understand something, communicate with her. She is quick about answering emails and always willing to explain something. Start the paper far enough in advance to ask all the questions you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Macy is a great professor. You will learn quite a bit taking this class. She grades fairly; the grading scale is weighted so small failures will not sink you. Take this class only if you are willing to work hard. You can get an A if you put forth the effort, but you will easily fail if you aren't proactive.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I wouldn't take another class only because she doesn't use textbooks. It also would've been nice if more practice problems appeared on tests. Other than that, she's super smart and made a point of showing us how practical and necessary finance is in our lives. I learned great tips on buying a car. And I know what to do if I win the lottery!

This is one class where I feel like I must have missed out on a lot of great lectures with the online experience. She gave very involved, personalized feedback. Tests were quite confusing, especially at first, but she did balance that with bonus questions and such. She was very fair to try to give students the grade they truly deserved.
She did not really put any effort in. Recycled material and an old textbook with cases that are becoming outdated in a rapidly changing industry.

Investments was a tough class.  The SMIF investment research paper was the toughest paper I have ever written.  She taught every detail of the paper, but I watched 3 of her lectures until my son had even memorized them.  I did well, but don't start at the last minute or you will regret it.  Tests are not easy A's either.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is really cool just don't miss her class- read her lecture notes and you'll get an A- no book needed

Only 3 tests and a paper. Class does not require a book, but her lecture notes don't cover  everything on her tests. While there is no homework, that means there is no opportunity to practice (and get feedback) on what she is teaching.  Final is optional and drops one low test grade. Final paper is hard and graded tough.
Not much guidance or direction of material provided. Tests were based on case studies and the practice quizzes do not help to prepare. Must read, read, read!!!
I knew the notes inside and out.  Learned the principles, so it wasn't all bad, but the tests were unfair.  10-15% of the questions were not covered at all.
Tests will throw you for a loop! BUT get with a group to take em. They are all online!
She went over the material very well and taking the practice quiz for each chapter helped with the test.

There is no textbook for this class.  Only notes that the teacher perceives as helpful but they are not. Practice quizzes are nothing like the exam.  I took 7 classes this spring.  I made A's in all other classes but a D in this class.  What is wrong with this picture?!

Dr Macy(Terry)*married,   Tough class, I took her in the summer where we had to cram our knowledge. She has no book, she has her own notes! Read those notes as many times as possible! Take the practice problems quiz as many times! It's a toughy but she will help you out!
A very fun professor with a great sense of humor that defies her South Dakota background.  Has a great deal of knowledge in her field. And I agree, very attractive.
Didn't really care much for the class, but easily one of the better looking professors on campus.  Neil Terry, you know what I'm talking about.

Dr. Macy is a very helpful and friendly person.  This class was online, and she did everything she could through her lectures, and e-mails to make sure students understood the material.  If you had a problem, you could go in and talk with her.  The subject matter is very hard to grasp at first, so be prepared.  Practice, practice, practice.
No Comments
She will help you and cares about the students.  She makes lectures as interesting as possible.
Tests are unfair ... does not prepare students for test...Wont help...wont show what was missed on tests...can't see tests at all...easy practice questions then extremely difficult test questions

She does not use book.  Lecture notes are simple, after reading and working problems mat. is easily understood.  Her test questions very hard. Does not prepare students for the type of material or questions on the test.  Lectures are entertaining and students enjoy them.  Not fair with grading projects, if she likes you good grade, very subjective.

She was unavailable for the beginning of the class because she was moving, but she was very understanding and let us turn in work late whenever we needed to. She was always accessible outside of class and helped in any way she could.

Susan is quite scatterbrained, so if you're really organized, the class may not be for you. But she is extraordinarily understanding of personal issues that may arise. She is personable and knowing her students on a personal level. She still texts me and I haven't taken a class with her in about a year. She grades on effort and participation, so as long as you try, you will thrive.
If you want an easy grade, then take Mrs. Amos.  If you want to learn Spanish, then look elsewhere.
I love Mrs. Amos! She is super funny and she knows her stuff. She can sometimes be a little scatterbrained but she is really personable. Great teacher.

By far the worst professor I have ever had. Our syllabus was three weeks late and when we got it it was incomplete. Several of our classmates reached out to her and we never got replies. At one point she was not even responding to text messages let alone emails. The work was not bad, but it was stressful not having communication at all.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. Throughout the whole summer course she did not provide ANY feedback or grades on our papers so you don't know how to improve or if you are on the right track. All of the assignments lead to 1 final project that deals with the collaboration of all the other assignments. Didn't get a final grade for the class for 2 weeks.

I found this class to be very frustrating. Professor Grueber took months to grade some assignments and when with an assignment due every week it was difficult to know if I was on the right track, especially when each assignment built on the last. I didn't feel that the assigned reading was valuable at all.

Some people can handle juggling the work of being a teacher, and some cannot. She cannot. I have never failed a class and I came very close to failing because she could not give clear instructions on when things were due or even what assignments were supposed to be. I learned nothing but basic information from this class and barley managed a "C".

I have taken this course online. I had expected the professor to provide a lot of examples for good strategy and bad strategy. There was no feedback given to the homework. It was more like read chapter 5 and complete the homework. I think one can learn more from Udemy or youtube videos on strategic management rather than this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Class was okay. Lots of independent work and writing papers is required. The course was basically one major project that is split up into smaller papers having different due dates, so just be sure on what topic you want from the beginning. A lot of times I felt stuck when writing because some instructions were not clear even after clarification.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Guerber was very responsive via email. Book and reading materials were excellent. Course assignments consisted of six short papers (2-4 pages) and one longer paper (7-9). No exams. Writing on the same company and reusing information from text and previous papers were encouraged. Very doable as a compressed summer schedule class.
There is one group project that lasts the entire semester, but she gives you work days in class to work with your team. Lecture days can be boring, but overall not a bad class. Would recommend.
took her class during a summer session.  not to bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: She's a very easy going person. She has class "work days" to give you time to work on your group projects. She gives you everything  you need to know for tests. If you email her she will email back as quickly as she can.
Does not adhere to the syllabus and changes due dates with little notice.  The group project was 100% self-taught.  The professor did little to explain or teach anything regarding the project.

I was failed on a paper when I didn't add a page number to the citation but had everything else cited. Instead of a few points he failed me for it. Spoke to professor several times so that I can correct my mistakes for the next assignment and there was no hope. I felt it was all out of my control and had to reach out to an advisor for guidance.

I've never had a harder time in a class than with Dr. Anwar. He makes his class mandatory but can't keep any students interested. I tried for a bit, but it just got annoying that he relied solely on the book to teach this class. Teaching for 40+ years should make it a lot better than what I went through in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Never failed a writing assignment and he was failing me. I asked for feedback and he couldn't do that. I pointed out how I was following his criteria and he ignored it. If I wanted to teach myself by just reading a book and writing a paper then I wouldn't pay a university thousands. Does the least to get a paycheck. Anyone can tell students to read
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Textbook was INTENSE (30-40 pgs per chapter). I liked him a lot though. Clear feedback and if you have critical thinking skills, this class is a no-brainer. The papers were time-consuming, but not difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Really enjoyed his class but would've rather taken it in class rather than online. The content is good and I enjoyed the projects given.

Dr. Anwar is a good professor and a fair grader.  The only real gripe with him is that the syllabus and assignments can be contradictory and confusing.  There is also a tremendous amount of writing in this course.
great teacher, classes can get a little bit long, boring
Overall he was a pretty cool professor. Cared about the students and the grade they ended up with at the end.

I took Dr. Anwar's Seminar in International Management (MGT 6330) online.  Be prepared to write 8-10+ pages per week.  Directions are often not clear (e.g. "Respond to two articles. 3 paragraphs." Ok, 3 paragraphs each or combined?)  Online resource links are a jumbled mess.  Grading is fair and an A is easily attainable by putting in effort.

Not easy, but as long as you can write clearly very easy. Thats not to say there isnt work to be done, there is too much, it just isnt hard. Short presentation but if you try you get an A. Smart man, knows alot, but is pretty outdated.

Anwar is an excellent professor. As long as you put effort in the class you will pass! You do have to do a presentation but it's pretty easy. He is very helpful if you need anything or have questions.

Tough professor, but fair.  The challenge with this online class was the weekly assignment and discussion assignments which require extensive research with multiple references. Also, he has a comprehensive, yep I mean extremely comprehensive online repository that he looooves to remind you about how great it is.  He's right, it was useful.
Best professor at WT. Just google business marketing and see who pops up. Really. Do it.
Overal a decent professor. Has lame jokes. <some still funny>

Dr. Anwar is a brilliant professor. Like everyone else has said, he keeps folders on all of the major companies and can recall details about them with ease. He gave us a list of questions to study for the tests, but the answers are very detailed to you do have to devote a lot of time to studying. I've heard that his other classes are easier.
Anwar is very knowledgeable and very interesting.  Keeps a profile on every company ever, probably.   Watch out for his dry sense of humor, he watches too much Jay Leno.

Dr. Anwar is so knowledgeable! I wouldn't be surprised to find that he knows the background on every company in the world! He's funny and generates interest in marketing! I would sign up for his class any day!
Dr. Anwar is the bomb. He is so funny and laid back.  I would take one of his classes any day.
I loved him! He was funny and interesting and made the class fun.
Dr. Anwar rocks. He is the best marketing professor by far
Funny man. Pretty liberal when goes to his teaching and testing.
No Comments

This class was super fun and attendance is a huge part of the grade, you have to come to class. Coach Love is very straightforward and will call you out but she knows what shes talking about. Her TA Colleen was really funny and easy to ask questions if we didnt understand something.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: At first, I thought I was going to hate this class. Coach Love raised her voice at me the first day and I developed a horrible attitude. Once the class proceeded, she quickly became my favorite professor. She taught me how to have an open mind and that it's okay to do something wrong. I loved this class and I can't wait to take another one with her

The group projects aren't fun. If you don't have appropriate information or you give wrong information, Coach Love will call you out on it. She also tries to lighten the mood with jokes and they're actually good jokes. Her tests are difficult but if you take the time to study, you'll do fine.
Basically show up and you'll get an A. It's a fun class so there's really no reason to skip it. She's pretty direct and can be intimidating but she's really funny as long as you're not an idiot.

Equestrian Coach.  Can be a bit in your face, but knows her horses.  Don't be put off by her less than stella attitude.  And don't be an idiot in one of her horse classes either.  She will call you out.

He lets you know it will be hard. Suggestions: A: DO ALL the work. As long as you do the work you will set yourself up with a good grade going into the final. B: DO the practice problems IN EXCEL and keep ALL the workbooks. Quizzes and exams are open note. C: COMMUNICATE if you are in your final semester or need help. He is helpful if he knows!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: There is no doubt you will work hard in this class. However, you will also learn A LOT about finance. Although there is a lot of work, it is highly regimented and structured so it's easy to stay on track. He dropped the project this semester so the class is less work than it used to be. Highly recommend if you actually want to learn.

Ammerman is a terrible professor. He expects you do things like read and do homework. Also, he expects you to demonstrate that you've actually learned something by the end of the course in order to pass. Do not take his class unless you want to do work and actually learn how to do financial analysis in real life.

Although the professor is kind and is usually responsive to emails, I do NOT recommend anyone to ever take his class. It is just too much work to the point that it is very difficult to complete even if it's your only class and don't have a job. Case studies are impossible and the final can really hurt your grade at the end and it is cumulative!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: More time/effort required here than any of my other MBA classes to date, incl: weekly homework and case studies plus four quizzes, a hard final, and a massive project (start early). Poor textbook made it extra hard. However, the teacher is very caring, supportive, responsive, and willing to work with you. My only class with live lectures (great!).

This class is a challenging class, and Dr. Ammerman expects you to work for your grade, but he will help you in any way he can if you ask. He is very understanding as long as you work at it and participate. He is a very kind and intelligent professor.

Class exams do not cover anything you are learning. Ridiculous semester project that is not well explained. He should not be teaching. He expects you know everything about being an accountant, so why are we taking his class? Supposed to be so we can learn. Do not take this guys class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: BEST PROFESSOR I HAVE HAD EVER IN LIFE HANDS DOWN END OF STORY!!! Not only is he extremely caring and wants his people to succeed, he wants you to LEARN! His class is demanding but its soooo worth it because what he teaches you is worth its weight in gold. If youre looking for an easy course - this is not it. If you are looking to learn, it IS!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Be prepared to work but he's GREAT! Hard professor but you will learn! Don't take him though if you are taking an equally difficult course. Would definitely take again!

Best professor that I had at WTAMU!!! He makes the class hard, but you will definitely learn if you put in the work as he matches or exceeds the work that his students put in. He holds live class via Webex for online courses which is incredibly valuable!!! He also does a weekly study club which was extremely helpful!!

This class is hard, but it actually was fun and you'll learn alot. He will meet with you outside of class to answer questions and he responds to emails pretty quickly too. Do your work and ask for help when you need it and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: This was the hardest class I have taken in the course of my graduate degree, but the teacher is awesome. He is passionate about his work and his goal is to ensure that his students are prepared to implement the techniques learned in a real world application. He genuinely cares so if you are struggling speak up because he won't leave you behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This is probably the most difficult class I have taken in my college career so far, but that being said I really do enjoy this professor. He is a brand new professor so he has a lot to learn but he is extremely understanding and will work with you if you are struggling. THIS CLASS IS HOMEWORK HEAVY but it helps lessen the weight of the hard exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Ammerman is an extremely kind, understanding and fair professor. Although I've only been in this class for a couple weeks, it's evident that he truly cares about the students and them understanding the material. He will literally bend over backwards to do whatever he can to accommodate each student and make sure they understand the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. A is an amazing professor who genuinely cares about his students. He has a very deep knowledge about testing and that makes this class all the more enjoyable. I would recommend taking this course AFTER completing Statistics.
Wonderful professor, great teacher, and genuinely cares about the well-being and learning of his students.

He is a great professor. His specialty area is in Neuropsychology so he lectures deeper about this subject. His Theories of Personality class is great also. He either uses the textbook or he doesnt depending on the class.

I absolutely adore Dr. Campbell! This was my first class with her, and I hope to take another one. She is so much fun, caring, and made going to class enjoyable. We had a lot of fun activities and went on four “field-trips”'! Participation does matter and attendance is mandatory-we only met once a week. She gives amazing feedback and is helpful!
This class included many quizzes and fun assignments. There are a lot, but it is not hard. Professor does provide extra credit opportunities.

I really liked this class. The coursework was very helpful for education. It prepares you for what you need. The professor gives great feedback on assignments. Most coursework includes quizzes and there is one large assignment.

She also does not allow for serious emergencies such as missing a due date on an assignment for being in the hospital. Do not take this professor for this course there are many other options. She will leave you with a grade lower than what you deserve because she grades assignments low.

She is organized and has all the requirements laid out. Homework is not too hard but very time consuming. Test are kind of hard but more that I felt very rushed. Lowest exam, homework, and practice questions are dropped. My advice is to complete every single thing that you can get points for and you will be okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Can be dry occasionally but accounting is difficult to make interesting. Good at keeping students engaged and following along. Explains concepts multiple times in different ways. Allows one notecard on each exam and 3 checks on each homework. Usually only one homework due each week, which is very helpful. Would recommend.

The class was exceptionally well organized. She was very generous to allow the lowest Exam, Homework, and Practice Question grade to be dropped. Notes and instructional videos were absolutely on point, and the exams followed the course material very closely. It's accounting, so 100% accuracy is needed - know that.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Make sure you stay on top of things. She will put things in folders where you can't find them and expect you just go searching for it.

I recommend taking this class alone instead of with another class during the semester since there is a lot of work (which is expected as a grad student). She was extremely accessible if I had questions which I did. Tests were hard but covered the chapters we did. Do all wileyplus assignments and you will pass your tests and the class. Not an easy A
She is a new professor to WT.  Her exams were EXTREMELY hard!  You will have homework   A LOT of homework. It's not an easy course. I would recommend to take it with another professor.
Will take points off for anything Very picky Very hard tests Lots of extra work for little points.  If you can, find another teacher!

Dr. Bang is an influential leader in and outside the classroom. He definitely cares about his students. I enjoyed his class and sense of humor during lectures. I am looking forward to some of his other classes. Be aware that you have to put in the work and study for his exams. Hands down the best professor I have had at WT.

Dr. Bang is a great professor and will help you with literally anything if you just ask. You do have to apply yourself for this class, but as long as you take good notes and read over the study guide you'll be fine. Make sure to go to classes though because he gives surprise attendance quizzes.

Loved Dr. Bang. If you're a freshman, I would recommend taking him for every CJ credit you'll need. Exams are easy if you pay attention during lectures. Class participation is important! He is respectful and will learn your name if you try to be involved with the class. He is super good about explaining things you may not understand, so just ask!
I absolutely love Dr. Bang, I wish he could teach all of the core classes I need!!

Dr. Bang is so brilliant in the area of Criminal Justice. His lectures are engaging and informative. You only have to write a couple of papers and read a chapter before class typically, so the workload isn't bad. The tests are typically 50 multiple choice with an essay question, and if you attend class then you should be good.

I've taken around 5 of Dr. Bang's classes and they are always really informative. He had to take over this class for another professor halfway through the semester and he did really good with it. Good lectures and he knows a lot of great information.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Bang is a good lecturer, he gives situations that will make you understand the concept. Read the chapters and you are fine on pop quizzes. Listen to lectures and read his power points and you will do fine on test. reviews.comment: Knows his stuff!
Dr. Bledsoe is the sweetest man in the world. If you show up, throw some words on papers to turn in every class period, and laugh at all his jokes you'll pass with flying colors. You'll love him!

He is a nice guy, but needs to learn boundaries. His class does not include anything about the music business, just some stupid documentary that he won't let us choose what goes into it. He needs to retire. He doesn't even look at any of the homeworks, so just fake it and you'll make it.

Darrell Bledsoe is an American Treasure. He should teach every single music class in the world. He is the single most fascinating and enigmatic professor I've ever has. His jokes are of the highest caliber and his knowledge of music even greater. My only complaint is my self esteem went down because I knew I'd never be as successful as Bledsoe.
This is very low effort do it at your own pace course, and you can succeed just fine if you utilize on campus resources such as the writing lab.

The professor grades hard. Professor MacDonald is great! When I first joined this class, I wasn't the biggest fan of writing. But I was able to learn so much more from her. She grades hard but she helps you improve your writing.

Dr. Macdonald is one of the most brilliant instructors that I have ever met! EXTRAORDINARY INSTRUCTOR!  wow...  If you get the chance to take her course, DO!

Hands down, Dr. MacDonald is the best English teacher I've ever had. She's quite passionate about what she does and is explains ALL of her material, most of which is from novels, with crystal like clarity.

Dr. MacDonald is quite possibly the most passionate instructor I've had the privilege of studying with.  Her passion for the subject matter as well as her students is refreshing.  Plus you may find yourself really enjoying literature and its examination.

Dr. MacDonald is the greatest teacher I've ever had.  she changed my life, and made me want to study English and be like her someday.  Some people were born to teach.  dr. MacDonald is one of them.  Take her class.  you won't regret it.

Dr. Bouma is a character. She is really good teaching as a professor. If you are deciding to take her for Microbiology, do it. If you take Medor you are gonna fail. reviews.comment: Dr. Bouma is awesome!! Would recommend her for anything in the world. Took three classes with her, loved them all. Med micro and histo were especially helpful for medical school (1st year now). Very energetic, exceptionally smart, went out of her way to help me w/ anything I needed. Exceptional teacher, great personality. Worked around athletics.

I LOVE DR. BOUMA!! She is so brilliant and so passionate, and very good at what she does. She is energetic and cares about what she is teaching. She can seem a bit abrupt and off-putting at first, but that really is only until you show her that you, too, care. Took all the classes she offered, and she was my advisor. Prepared me well for med school

Loved her class - ended up taking two more classes with her and would still like to take more! Very fast-paced course, but it is obvious she loves her subject and is highly intelligent. She is blunt with you; just be organized and prepared for class and meetings and you will be fine. Lecture attendance wasn't mandatory, but don't miss the labs.
Great professor!

She is very high energy and blunt -sometimes rude and pleasant simultaneously.  If I could change one thing about the course it would be quizzes.  They are nothing more than busy work and I find that frustrating.  At this point in college, if students procrastinate, that's up to them.  Know the course objectives and you'll be fine.

She's super smart and definitely lets you know that she's smarter than you. She is incredibly rude and even insults you with a smile. The class is very fast paced and you have to be able to keep up and always go to class. On a brighter note, I learned so many things in this class and the lab exercises are pretty cool.

EXTREMELY lively and energetic. I found myself forgetting to breathe when she is really getting into lecture since she talks so fast and moves around so much and so quickly. She obviously likes the subjects she teaches. Her assignments and tests will make you think but she is not out to fail anyone and they are never overly difficult.

She is very smart graduated from John Hopkins. She teaches to you like you're all idiots compared to her. Focuses a lot on the chemistry aspect of it. Do the objectives and you'll do okay on the tests. You must study a lot for this class. Not an easy class. Try to take a different teacher if you can. You'll learn a lot,but she's super hard and rude

Very helpful class, it's fast paced but you will learn a lot. Lab assistance is a must. Complete the objectives and you'll be good for tests. Very interested in students, very open to help outside class, give review sessions, etc. Very straight forward, likes smart questions hates lazy students. She will help you if you help yourself.
Very energetic. Hard class but straightforward. Hands out notes- very helpful. Class is very interesting sometimes. Can be rude.
Fast paced. She over-emphasizes biochemistry aspects of this course.
she is very energetic but yet very rude. She hates when people will ask her questions, and she has no sympathy towards anyone no matter what

Very very very energitic woman.  She answered all emails in a very prompt mannar.  Teaching was a little fast pace, but very informative.  The class is made easy due to the outlines and objectives she hands out.

I enjoyed this class so much! There was a lot of reading, all relevant and informative. He gives amazing lectures that you will get the most out of by doing the reading BEFORE class. Bowman is fair and if you do the reading, show up to class, participate, and turn work in on time you should do great.

reviews.comment: Dr. Bowman is an amazing Professor to take if you want an easy A or B. He does give out book quizzes but you literally don't even have to read the books as long as you do research on them. He grades really fairly and his lectures are very easy to understand. He also lets you go to his office without an email and he will gladly help you!
He great and easy as long as you pay attention

Should've gotten an A in this class but I screwed it up at the last second by not turning in 2 assignments. Should be a good sign that even thought I straight up did not do 2 assignments I still got a B in this class. Take this professor. It's fun and it's a free credit.
One of my favorite professors. None of his tests are multiple choice, and the essay is worth 80% of the grade.

I didnt like Dr Bowman when I first started class, but I wasnt keen on writing essays. But Dr Bowman grades very fairly, he does a great job preparing you for everything he will test you on. I recommend him.
Awsome

reviews.comment: Dr. Bowman is a true gem. I earned an A in his course. His lectures are so interesting! I really think that he will do all he can to not only help but accommodate you! I highly recommend him!

He is an amazing lecturer, super funny and going to class is something I looked forward to. Grades come from doing 5 of 15 study questions, the 2 reading quizzes, and the three major essay type test. His test aren't super hard and he gives you a study guide. Go to class and you will be fine, he is really good at explaining everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is so understanding and works with you as long as you just talk with him. He is by far my favorite teacher that I've had in college! You don't have to present or anything in class which I liked a lot. All you really have to do is do 5 out of the 15 questionnaires and take the tests, which are fairly easy as long as you study!

I am not a history person and i really enjoyed this course. Professor Bowman made things interesting and was extremely clear on how his tests would be graded. There are 15 essay questions throughout the semester and you must do only 5, these are graded super easily.  You do have to study vocabulary but if you study in advance its a breeze.

Dr. Bowman is the best professor I have had at WT. He kept me interested every day in class. He respected me, and I respected him. I would recommend him to every one. Especially those who think they don't like history, because he will make you like it! I promise! Overall, he is a great person and I'm sad I won't have him again.

Dr. Bowman is an awesome professor, he will work with you, even if you miss a quiz, he'll give you a make-up assignment. His tests are fairly easy if you study a little. No expensive textbooks to buy, to the point lectures, he's not dry and won't put you to sleep! Would (I am) take again!

One of the greatest professors ever!!! Decent grader, amazing feedback on papers and tests. Very little reading and homework, use sparknotes and understand the basics. If you know someone in that class who takes notes and know when the tests are, you can miss class. You will not want to miss this class though, he's so funny and has the best quotes.

Bowman is great! I am not a history person whatsoever and I really loved his class! He made the subject interesting and it was easy to pay attention in class. You do have a good amount of work but if you keep up with it you'll be fine!
Bowman's lectures are pretty interesting and to the point. A few major assignments, but nothing too hard if you're willing to put in a little effort. Did not use a textbook.
Very helpful teacher! Does grade hard on exams. Keeps every one interested and alert. Just show up to class and takes notes.

Dr. Bowman is by far the best professor I've ever had. His lectures are interesting and he is definitely one of the easiest graders on campus. There is absolutely no reason you should fail his class. If you need a class he offers, take it!

I am taking Dr. Bowman for 1301. He has changed my view on history. I used to hatedespise the subject but he has completely changed that. He is a very good professor. Gives 15 writing assignments throughout the semester, you only have to do 5. 2 easy quizzes and 3 tests TOTAL.  Very pleased with this course.
Absolutely Loves this class! Super helpful and very fair. Willing to work with student's also. I would definitely recommend him to anyone

One of the coolest guys you could ever want for a professor. Gives out 15 writing assignments a semester but only 5 are mandatory. two easy quizzes and three tests that includes the final. Test are easy as long as you go to class and study your terms. He worked with me to get me caught up when I missed a lot due to family emergency this semester.

Best professor I've had so far. Extremely helpful, you learn a lot and he's an overall great guy! I would recommend him to anyone. Took two of his classes and was never disappointed. The only class I ever looked forward to.
He really likes his subject, and is willing to work with you. I would recommend his class. I will take another class of his next semester.
Best teacher I've had at wt. taking him again this semester
I absolutely love him. Really funny, smart, organized and he almost never even uses notes. Relatable (he's young) and TA is a fair grader. Take him!

Took for art history 2 and it was easily one of the easiest classes I have ever taken. Most of the group projects were fun and easy, the other work was so simple to do for an easy grade. She teaches very well and often makes you think about certain moments of history. She is one of the most caring professors on campus and will help you whenever.
Dr. Roos was amazing! Her art history course was so incredible and easy. She really encourages people to talk about and think about the art works and why people liked/didnt like this and that.

Lectures were interesting and engaging, and every piece of material we went over was relevant. She asked thoughtful questions and welcomed diverse opinions on texts. She was always uplifting but still challenged us in a way to get us to feel confident about our work. She seemed genuinely interested in our success and development.

Dr. Roos is fair and helpful. I did feel like the lectures were lacking, but that's because she expects a lot of participation and discussion in class. That's fine, but I'm the type of learner who needs someone to explain to me, rather than me trying to explain it to myself.

reviews.comment: Highly recommend world masterpieces with Dr Roos- she is BRILLIANT.

reviews.comment: Dr. Roos is an inspiration.  She creates an atmosphere of critical thinking through lectures and class participation.  I recommend her courses to anyone wanting to sharpen and expand their literary knowledge.

She was very helpful and wanted to see all students succeed. You have daily quizzes over the readings, super easy questions with a sentence or 2. If you have an A or B average in quizzes and no more than 4 absences, you're exempt from the final. Lots of reading but totally worth it.
Incredible teacher!  Willing to do anything for her students, really enjoys the subject matter and is very interactive with the class, cannot recommend her enough.
extraordinary teacher!  compassionate, humble, and has a way of teaching that is not intimidating but very effective!  Could not stress enough what a great instructor she is to all of her students!
She is a great teacher who is wiling to do whatever it takes to help he students succeed! Fairly easy class as long as you keep up with your paper!

lots of reading, but no textbook.  really cares about students and is very helpful and lenient if she feels you're trying. interesting subject matter, good class discussions--sometimes felt as though there were lots of questions brought up but no answers. papers were not given definite directions but she offers to clarify. good teacher, good class.
Brilliant, helpful, fair.  Looks you in the eye. A straight shooter.  Worth the work.

She's a fantastic professor that's very open, honest, and caring. She made it very clear what our assignments would cover and provided feedback. She created an environment with fun assignments that helped with my confidence in public speaking. As long as you show up, participate and study your quizzes and reviews, you will do great!

Professor Bohannan was amazing, kind, and very respectful. Grade' speeches very easy, explains on rubric what to do better next time. Really helped with my confidence in speaking in public.

reviews.comment: I loved loved loved Professor Bohannan. She puts exactly what she is going to teach on the board and gives all the notes for each chapter. Her projects are easy and fun to do! 10/10 would recommend taking her class.
Amazing woman who is literally just a gem! She makes sure all her students are well prepared and just cares so much about anyone she teaches. I would LOVE to get her in the future!

I love Professor B. As long as she can tell you tried or that you followed her instructions, she will give you a perfect score every time. I recommend doing the extra credit opportunities and going to class because those give your grade a big boost meaning you won't have to take the final. One piece of advice,always make min. time for presentations
I loved Mrs Bohannan! She is one of my favorite instructors. She is so personable and funny

Great Professor!!! You have to study hard but it is an easy course. She makes the entomology very interesting. Everyone around me complained because they actuality had to study. Just study and get an easy A!!! Easy and Fun Projects!!!!

No Comments
Easy class

Unless you memorize his lectures that are on MWF and not up for review, you wont pass the tests, TAKE NOTES!!!

This class was the hardest class I took this semester. The questions on the quizzes rarely match what was taught in the lecture. In order to pass you need to cheat. this man teaches a music appreciation course that makes you hate music. His quizzes will be so random and inconsistent you might as well just cheat, thats the ONLY way to get a good grade in his class....

Lots of opportunities to get points and test require little studying and are very easy Very practical class

Not impressed. Took his class online and had to meet up with him on campus to go over some things that were confusing me, and ended up feeling like I was really bothering the man. Hes certainly a tough professor, and takes no nonsense, but he is actually a very interested and caring educator. Hes one of the heardest workers ive seen in a long time.
One of the worst instructors I have ever encountered!  I would never take any other class taught by him, ever!!!

He really wasn't that bad. There is a quiz every day, sadly I think you can only pass if you cheat. The art section was most interesting. He tells alot of dry jokes. I think he tried to make the class interesting.

His classes are set up like a Mon/Wed/Fri class. The lectures are very hard to begin with and dont ease up until a month before finals. He wasnt my choice for proffesors, but he's the only one who taught the class and I wouldn't take another class from him.

Steve Rocks!!

Dr. Bogner is a great prof. He truly loves history and really extends his course to our local area. Very interesting course and not hard if you just study. Offers alot of extra credit that is more than just papers.
Taught well, he goes very fast during the notes though.  DO NOT SKIP AND DO THE EXTRA CREDIT.  STUDY STUDY STUDY.
He is super nice and tries his best to make class interesting. Notes are hard to take and tests are mildly hard, but I would recommend him as a teacher.
Nice guy. likes history and teaching, get some face time and the class will be a brezze, test can be hard if you don't study and offers a ton of extra credit

Professor Stitzel is very good at teaching economics and you can tell he is passionate about it. He cares about the students and that is evident in his personability. He opened my eyes to Econ and helped develeop in me a love for it.

This class is the worst I have taken in all 5 years so far. There are hours and hours of lectures with him doing podcasts with other professors from years ago. None of it is actually current. I have learned nothing at all in this class. Be prepared to have to use chat gpt to do your assignments, then critiquing the assignment it made. Save yourself

Great and straightforward professor. Online class for me so just a lecture video and short quiz each week. I hate when prof. dtm and have so much work every week, this class gives you exactly what you need to know, such a breath of fresh air. No textbook or anything but he includes this other cite for extra help which I enjoy doing if I have time.

This class was not easy or hard. I was not a fan of his lectures, skipped through a lot which didn't matter cause most of the questions weren't on the test anyways, questions on test didn't make a lot of sense. Bad handwriting on lecture vids. 10 question quizzes, 3 attempts couldn't miss more than 2 questions to pass the quiz. Nice guy though.

He gives quizzes with unclear, grammatically incorrect T/F questions. For an ethics paper, he asks for UNEDITED ChatGPT prompts but deducts points if the chat exceeds 3 pages, implying he WANTS THEM EDITED. His illegible, handwritten PowerPoints are useless on quizzes. Lectures are wordy, despite him asking the opposite of you. Disappointed.

Read, understand, and take the time to thoroughly answer the discussion questions and you will be fine in this class.  The material is not hard to understand but by no means is it an easy A. Quizzes are straightforward from the assigned reading. Podcasts for the discussion questions are informative and require note-taking and critical thinking.

Class was easy enough but the professor cares more about his podcast it seems than teaching. Errors are abundant in quizzes, tests, and so on. The content is good if you're new to the field. It's easy to grasp, just very boring.

This class is difficult for non-econ majors and those who are not active in sports. Quizzes are difficult if you do not pay attention to lectures and thoroughly write your own notes. He does give lecture notes but they are not very helpful on quizzes. 2 written projects were assigned and he is a heavy grader. Can be very stressful class.

Dr. Stitzel knows economics and provides excellent lectures. We had weekly quizzes and chapter tests. You get three attempts with random questions, and he takes the highest grade of the three. The questions are taken straight from the lecture notes, so be sure you get all the info from his slides. This class has been one of my favorites so far.

Dr. Stitzel provides an array of media to expose you to the principals of macro-economics. He expects you to combine your learnings from multiple viewpoints and sources to create coherent open-ended responses. I found his teaching methods to be daunting at first, but extremely relevant and retainable at the course end.

reviews.comment: This course was broken down into 5,2 week readings and assignments. The professor is a hard greater. Lots of external resources to read, watch, or listen to for assignments. reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: All we had during this course was chapter quizzes (you get three attempts on each however each attempt has different questions and in my opinion get harder as you go) and papers. For the project he gives a very vague rubric of what he wants but then grades and says you are missing stuff. Doesn't respond to questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Stitzel knows economics, and I respect the fact that he creates his own questions for exams. He also has discussion boards that help learn the material much better as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I just started my grad program at WTAMU, and I feel fortunate to have had Dr. Stitzel as my first professor in this journey. His class is definitely challenging and involves a lot of reading and studying, but he is very accessible and quick to respond to messages (it's an online class). I would definitely take another class with him if possible.

He's a good guy at heart and will try to work with the student to help with their understanding of the material. His exams are hard but he gives a leg up on grading when he sees real effort. Get knowledge of economics, I'd totally take another class from him were I not graduating.  Best of luck in your future years of teaching!

reviews.comment: Had a sub in for principles macro and realized how great Dr. Stitzel is. Please come back soon Dr. Stitzel! This other guy is nuts!
Do not take this professor, if you want to pass

Not very good at explaining things but he cares about his students. You will be graded on homework, 3 tests, and a final. He assigns 2 homework problems to be typed weekly and has a test over 4-5 chapters always on a Friday. As long as you turn in your work on time and communicate with him about any complications it should be an easy A.

His teaching style is confusing at times because he skips many steps in between while working our examples. He also gives very few examples to work with in order to do your homework. He does however give you many opportunities to bring your grade up and is open for readjustments as long as you communicate with him. Very understanding and nice.
Lots of work and effort involved. Dr. Burnett is accessible and understanding. The workload is fair and exams a bit hard

The worst class I ever had! Was a waste of money. The professor does not bother to put any effort. All we got is textbook, auto-generate quizzes & homework and exams. No research, no group discussions. Volume of homework and quizzes is high and yet exams are 75% of the grade. Not balanced at all! Stay away if you can.

I believe this class is laid out in the best way possible to learn accounting. There is a lot of homework requirements, but this is what makes you learn by practicing the concepts. Everything is very straightforward in this class and structured the same week after week, you know the exact expectations on week 1.

Excellent course materials made it easy to learn. Weekly homework and practice problems reinforced the material without taking too much time. The lowest two homework scores and lowest exam scores are dropped. Predictable and effective. Would definitely take from her again.

Prof. Burnett provides a structured way to review each chapter and complete the homework which aids in understanding the material. The homework, while plentiful is necessary as accounting is a subject where practice is necessary to fully grasp topics.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: She has the most bizarre grading system and criteria. She assigns a ton of HW and only gives an 75 mins to complete exams with calcs. To put this into perspective, other comparable classes like Stats and Fin give you up to 3 hrs for the same # of questions and calculations. I work full-time and this class takes up so much of my time and effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: 3 or 4 tests,  & each chapter has a very comprehensive online homework through the textbook software. If you don't round your answers EXACTLY to 2 or 4 decimals, depending on situation, you won't get any credit. They take FOREVER & are aggravating & tedious as heck. The exams are actually easier than the homework, then again so is rocket science.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He was the most memorable professor of my college career. He truly cares about his students and their success. He clearly communicates his expectations for projects and tests so if you pay attention, you will get a good grade and learn so much.
Butler makes class so freaking fun that you will never want to skip! The textbook was used outside of class, but you will still need it. 10/10!

Personable guy. Doesn't get up on a high horse. Treats everyone respectfully. Doesn't pick favorites. Easy going. Knows his stuff! Has a lot of professional experience & it shows. Not much of a challenge though.

He is an amazing teacher. Extremely helpful, he will push you but just enough to get you to work hard and want it. Never doubt when to take his class. I have taken many classes with him and they are all fabulous.
Great Teacher.
Great professor that wants to see his friends succeed! I really recommend to take any of his classes

She isn't helpful at all.  I can't believe that she is actually teaching classes at a university. Stay away from her and he classes.  Don't listen to the other comments people are leaving; someone said she came in and helped on a Sunday, I tried to meet her 3 times to change a grade and she never had time for me.  I'm in shock people like her.

We took 1 test over all the content, and then had 1 big group project. However, the project was really cool, and gives you great experience from what you would actually do in the marketing world. Plus the professor is super cool, and there isn't a whole lot of class time. You mostly work outside of class with your groups and meet with her.

This is a required business communication course, which to be honest was quite remedial... HOWEVER, I learned things in this class that I can carry with me for the rest of my professional career. We worked on writing, public speaking, interview skills, resume workshops, etc. All the things you think you already know, but didn't.

This class made me change my major to marketing! I was able to work with real clients on real projects, while learning how broad this field really is!  It also should be mentioned that our group needed help on project and she met with us on a Sunday to make sure we succeed and understood the concepts.
I loved this class and how it was taught. Most of the focus was on real world application rather than memorization!

Great class and teacher! Only grades are 1 or 2 hw, with 1 test over everything and a big group project. The project is really good though. Gives you an idea of what a real marketing presentation would be.
Test is really tough, but not a lot of homework assignments, and class hardly ever went the full time.

The one and only test was pretty simple and straightforward. You need to ask for examples of marketing plans when you get to the group project stage or else you will have NO clue about what's going on. If you're group sucks, you can still get an A. Mine was great and I had way more fun doing it than I thought.
We only took one test, but the material was covered during lectures. A bulk of the class was a group project, which was a lot of fun!
She is a bad teacher.

He's a big talker, which makes the class pretty dull. Most of what he teaches should have been covered in high school. The papers aren't too bad—they just take some time to complete—but he does offer a lot of extra credit. Just be prepared to sit through 50 minutes of boredom each day.

This was honestly one of the best classes I have taken at WT. Dr. Pearson's online course is thorough, but overall a really nice experience. Discussions relate to the unit notes and there are plenty of opportunities to do well. Even the essays are enjoyable to write.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Pearson has a set schedule for each semester. You had a 10 question quiz after each chapter and only had to write 5 essays out of the 13 topics you go over. You can do your first 5 and get them over with or spread it out. He gives feedback on all essays and then you have a discussion board. I took this class online and I liked it.

This professor has been the best one I've had so far, and I have taken A LOT of online courses. He is straight forward with what he expects, and it isn't hard at all to achieve it. You choose the chapter writing assignments you want, only 6 are graded, regardless of how many you submit. I recommend this professor for any student that can take him!!
Honestly one of the worst classes I've taken, he grades so hard and is too specific on how he wants things. I wish I never took him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. P. is awesome even in the online environment. His expectations were clear. If you read the material you can do well in his class. I loved history after taking this course. Dr. P. uses additional information outside of the text. The surfer logs make you find more information on the topics which made learning the topics fun. Great job Dr. P.

Dr. Pearson has an intimidating reputation, but is actually quite personable. He held all of us to high standards, and was clear what those standards were. If you pay attention to his syllabus and avoid his "pet peeves" (a list of proof-reading guidelines he hands out at the beginning of the semester) you will do well and learn a lot.

Took this class online there are 13 writing assignments but you are only required to do six. There is a 150 word discussion and a weekly quiz. Class is not difficult if you complete the writing assignments in the first 6 weeks then the class will be easier. Quiz and writing assignment are right from the book.

Dr. P is one of the absolute best professors I've ever had. The best lecturer ever and really cares about his students. He also happens to be very funny and personable. Absolutely recommend this class!!

I took HIST 1302 online and I had to drop it because I honestly didn't have time for it. It's 3 assignments a week with a discussion, test, and writing assignment. It gets to be a lot and it takes up a lot of time. Maybe he's different in person but don't take him online
reviews.rating_tags: SO MANY PAPERS--Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor.  He really cares about his students.  He gave a few quizzes out as homework and had only 1 quiz in class.  It was about a video.  We had an extra credit opportunity worth 20 points, due before finals week.  Midterm and Final are timed essays in class.  He let us bring in a front and back sheet of paper to them.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Show up, take good notes and you'll pass. Seven quizzes over the semester (if he's in a good mood he'll make them take home), some quizzes are pop, though. Midterm and Final are essay based, but he gives the study guide a week in advance and lets you bring a cheat sheet for both.
Dr.P is one of my favorite professors so far, he's really interested in what he teaches and explains everything so it's relate able, I would definitely recommend him!

Dr. P is great! He really cares about his students and is super understanding when life happens as long as you're honest and don't try to make excuses. He has a genuine love for history which helps get you into learning. As long as you take really good notes and attend class you'll be fine. He is really particular about what he wants on tests.
Awesome professor! Made me interested in history

I was so nervous about taking history! Dr P was an absolutely wonderful professor and ended up being my favorite class this semester.  Make sure you take VERY good notes and write down the outline he writes at the beginning of class. Put effort in and pay attention. He likes to know his students care. Also gives a 20 point extra credit asst !

He is a very nice man that loves what he teaches. He is very passionate about what he teaches. He only gave a midterm and a final. If you attend class you and take good notes you can make an A. He expects good written essays on his midterm and final. All in all, he is an awesome teacher, there to help you always!

Dr. P is the best history professor in this institution without a doubt. Pearson is flexible in deadlines, understands what your situation is and his exams are straight forward and he lets you use your own notes.
Excellent teacher! Cares for his students to the utmost! Highly recommend!

Just finished May intersession... best class and best professor at WT! His class is challenging but you will really enjoy it! I wish he taught more classes... well worth the money! I wish more professors cared as much as Dr. Pearson does. You can tell he is truly passionate about teaching and really enjoys his students!

Best prof I had in college (Amarillo College, WTAMU, TTU). His classes were hard, but in a good way. I felt like I was actually learning. He was very helpful and understanding. All around just a good person.
Great Teacher!
Great Teacher
Amazing, amazing teacher. Truly cares for his students and wants you to pass. If you want to pass, go to the extra study sessions. I will definitely take class from him agaim.
Really great professor. Keeps class interesting. Takes a lot of interest in his students...

Great professor!  One of the few professors at WT who knows what he's talking about!  Made even Environmental History something I wanted to learn about!  Took many classes with him...he's difficult but will go out of his way to help you with anything you might need!
This professor kept things lively even through 3 hour summer intersession courses.  He is passionate about what he teaches, and it shows in his lectures.  Professor Pearson, you get an A+
He is very helpfull and easy to approach. My interest in Environmental History has grown since taking this class. Very writing intensive and he expects a lot. He is a caring understanding prof.
Great professor.  Really cares about his students and genuinely enjoys what he teaches. An all over great guy,
Great professor, go to the extra study sessions if you want to pass

The best teacher on campus!!  Really, genuinely cares for the well-being and educations of his students, as well as their lives off campus...a great guy...will take as many classes with him as possible...A+
I had him online, and the tests were pretty difficult, but you can use your books and notes.  And he's pretty nice when it comes to late homework, etc.
Has a passion for history.  His upper level classes are fun if you participate

He is a tough grader on writing. You can't get away with not reading in his class. Lectures are usually interesting and yes he's got a hot bod! All in all, you'll have to work hard if you take Dr. Pearson, but its worth it.
Class was somewhat difficult, but definately worthwhile! Do ALL your reader assignments, skip reading the book because it won't help. He was really hot too for an older guy (close to 40?).
His summer class rocks but be prepared for pop quizes

Dr. Byers was a good professor. I highly recommend her. Her grading guidelines are clear and if you have any questions about exams she is open to meeting with you to go over what you missed and why you missed it. She does talk soft, but she is pretty easygoing. As long as you pay attention to her lectures and study for the class, you will do fine.

This class is in the running with Ochem for one of the hardest classes on campus. You will be drinking from a firehose of information and have to guess what she will test you on. She is a very detailed oriented person and I would avoid her at all costs if you can. I could not due to being a biochemistry major.

As long as you study, youll be fine. Nearly everything on her exams is covered in class in her powerpoints so dont waste money on the textbook. She talks softly and it was hard to hear her. If you study outside of class, you also dont have to worry too much about missing a couple lectures. There were no pop quizzes, just the exams and final.

Those who criticize Byers for being difficult obviously do not listen to her. She states heavily that her class is simple to pass but you have to work hard for it. She is helpful in studying as she gives reviews for each exam and does not give out homework. She also drops the lowest test grade. Take Byers if you are prepared to study.

reviews.comment: Dr. Byers is an amazing professor. She is so passionate about the subject and will provide with all of the information you need to pass during her lectures. reviews.comment: I highly recommend her, her lectures are easy to understand. Don't need to buy the textbooks, because she provides PowerPoint slides. reviews.comment: 5 Exams including the final.  She drops one of your exams before the final which makes getting a good grade really easy.  Final is cumulative.  She is available in your office and makes sure you understand topics learned in class.  Very organized and brilliant! The only downside is the lectures feel long when you know what she's talking about.

4 test decide your entire grade. There's actually 5 but she drops the lowest... Don't let that fool you because you'll fail at least one unless your reviewing a week before the test. She's honestly not a bad teacher, but there's much better and easier teachers.

Lectures are very long, not very helpful

Professor has passion for her subject of study, however, she does get off track in lectures often times giving in depth examples, which can be pointless if you're concerned with the test material. Dr. Byers is not a good teacher, do not take her class. She expects you to read the book every single night of your life to pass one test. All she talks about is the stuff we don't need to know. She doesn't give any other work besides exams.
Very good professor and gives very detailed lectures and some help on reviewing for tests. Requires a lot of studying for exams, but overall an interesting professor!

This professor does not give good feed back. Her lectures are extremely long. At times students will get up at the middle of class and walk out because of lectures being too long and boring. Her tests are tough you have to study a whole lot. The tests are too much in detail and in her lectures she is too general. Good luck passing her class.
Four years ago when he was new at wt he taught statics. He cared most of us and shared lots info and knowledge with us. First time it was hard to catch his accent but no big problem
I just recalled. You must enjoy a long night exam on each test. Dr. Chang is the best professor but I couldn't follow his enthusiasm. I am repeating this class again.
Seems funny teacher..care most of us...a little accent problem..but I am sure he is the best professor at wt.
Good
She was kind of rude to me honestly

This class isn't too hard, just show up and do your work. Yes she grades pretty hardcore, but that is just how she is. I feel she treated others very differently instead of treating all of us the same.

The class was not hard at all, if you show up you will get an A or B, but the professor was awful at communication the tests are copy and paste from the textbook and ai, again not a hard class the professor just wasn't likable.
There is so much extra credit and only 2 tests, midterm and final. You will do quiet a few speeches, but as long as you do how she wants them done, it is very easy.

Loved Mrs. Cannon! As long as you communicate with her and follow all the guidelines for the speeches, you'll pass. Make sure to look at everything on the lessons tab because she will sometimes include extra credit. Great at communicating and overall and very sweet lady! Be ready to speak in front of your class though. Had a total of 5 speeches!

I don't recommend anyone take her class. She treats a lot of people like high school children and she puts so much work on you. She put so much work on me I didn't have time to barely get tutoring for my chemistry and pre-calculus classes. If you need to take this class, please take it with someone else.
not a bad class but it was hard sometimes to contact her and alot of work to do.

The class is pretty easy. It was a hybrid class for me. We had weekly work that she gave us a week to work on put is super easy, but on top of that we had lots of speeches. Its not too bad tho just be prepared to speak infront of your class.

Yes I failed her class (more that I just stopped turning in work). Textbook is mandatory, as work and tests are pulled directly from it. Make sure you make a friend who also takes the class to bounce speeches off of/ help you. She has a very specific way she likes assignments and grades- follow and reread all directions. A stickler for details.

Overall Mrs. Cannon is an easy A if you show up and do the work. She gives a lot of extra credit and if you complete it all you will most likely end up with an A. simple lectures

reviews.comment: If you are looking for a professor with any compassion DO NOT take this class. She has no understanding of emergencies. I was .4 points away from passing and she wouldn't let me do anything. I do not recommend her at all.

Take Dr. Chou for as many CS classes as possible. He is very funny but in the awkward way and I truly miss his teachings ever since I switched universities. Class is almost equally weighted HW and exams so you need about a 50 on all exams to pass the course which is easily achievable. If you do the practice problems and HWs exams will be a breeze.
Great professor! If you show up to lecture, do your assignments, and take notes you're guaranteed to pass. He is super helpful and encouraging when you struggle with a topic, just ask questions!
Good professor who takes feedback well and implements it quickly.

reviews.comment: Extremely kind and helpful. This man is awesome.

Very nice guy and he's very smart. The class starts out easy but gets difficult very quickly. Do not get behind. Tests are hard and the material is not really from the textbook. Some assignments are unclear yet he will take away points if you don't do it exactly his way.

Dr. Cepeda is a poor teacher, and he does not follow the textbook. He really sucks...
Great Professor - I graduated in '91 and went into the oil business.  Pay attention to all those drawings!!  You will use them in the real world.

Text book was never used just studied the notes he gave us and thats all you needed to sutdy with. But he loves to draw and I mean DRAW. Sometimes it was hard to follow because he went fast but anyone should be able to get a C or better

really easy class, his lectures are really spuratic and not very orderly. but other then that not bad
