reviews.comment: Professor Freas is a talker and a joker. He provides excellent PowerPoint slides with all the notes you need for the tests. Eight outside reading quizzes are done on your own time due by the end of the semester. I had him for POSC 2305 & 2306 courses and enjoyed his lectures and stories from his life experiences as an attorney.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: funny guy and very understanding. enjoyed the class
Overall, a super easy class to pass. Hardly any homework and is pretty interesting in the lectures.

Chuck is a cool professor. Don't need the book because he provides all lectures and tests come from material taught in class. Attendance is highly recommended, tests are open note so take advantage. Anything less than an A in this class you should rethink why you're even in college
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: A knowledgeable professor that enjoys teaching this subject. Exams are easy and open note. As long as you come to class you will do well. Very nice, funny, and approachable.
Very opinionated. Been there, done that type of person. Some lectures are pretty boring but the tests are easy and open-note.

Professor Freas is a good professor! Hes very enthusiastic and knows what hes talking about. He does not require you to be in class but does occasionally give you extra credit for being there. All tests are open note/open book. There are outside reading quizzes but theyre super easy. Only grades are exams (open note) and reading quizzes.

He really enjoys what he teaches and is very knowledgable about the topic. With that being said, he does talk the entire class period every class. All the lectures are posted online and can be used for the tests. There are only a few tests and some outside readings with quizzes but it's all very easy.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Constantly does his best to help his students succeed. Will ask questions to the class on how we want to do things to make it easier on us. All homework is due at the end of the semester and notes are put online. He usually talks the whole class period but he is decently interesting to listen to. No papers which is a huge plus! Would recommend!

LOVE this prof. Took him 2 times and each very easy, HW and Quiz 4 exams. Final optional if you did good on exams. I took him online, uses lockdown but still can "get help" easily. Accounting class was all opened finished all hm and quiz for the semester in a month. Real good class!

He is a great professor! He tells tons of dad jokes which can be really funny to not at all. I enjoy his lectures as well but sometimes they can get very boring. The only assignments he gives us is the Cengage hw and quizzes each week! He also picks the 3 highest exam scores which makes the final exam optional (total of 4 exams).
This was a great class. I did not like accounting at all, but this professor was very good at his job. All exams were online and he drops your lowest exam grade.

He is a great professor for 2302. Make sure you to go to class as high participation and attendance means the tests are online. Do all of the quizzes and homeworks. I also recommend recommend doing the pre-quizzes as well even though they are not graded. Note taking is easy, just write stuff on the outlines. Outstanding professor
Professor Clark had an easy-to-understand lecture style. His lectures really cleared up what the reading left you confused about. Hoping I have him for my next accounting course!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Clark was my favorite professor at WT and I plan on taking another class with him in the future. He has real-world accounting and business experience so he was a great teacher in my opinion. He pretty understanding and really wants his students to exceed. Rated 4 difficulty just because the subject was fairly new to me, not because of him

Professor Clark knows the subject matter masterfully. The recorded lectures are long (each video around an hour long, sometimes multiple videos per chapter), but provide tons of examples to help you learn. You will love his dad jokes and his sincere, agreeable attitude.

This professor was great. He graded quickly, work was not horrible to do, and he gave great feedback. His tests were harder so you do have to study for them, but the assignments were easy and so were the quizzes. He was a very nice guy too.

This is a sneakily hard class compared to ACCT 2301. Professor Clark is the best choice to teach this class! He is extremely helpful in answering questions and he really cares about his students. I had to have assignments opened due to being gone for a month and he had no qualms about opening those up early for me. Hard class, but best professor!

Clark was an awesome professor. He cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He will tell some dad jokes that he already knows are bad, but laughs at them anyway. Clark has been out in the real world in an accounting profession and wants to share his knowledge with students. Overall, a great professor.

David Clark is the most memorable professor I have had at wtamu, he will make you laugh with the most horrible dad jokes you have ever heard but he is extremely smart and nerdy. You will not regret taking him. He is also color blind.
I really enjoyed his teaching style. He tries to make everyone understand and be excited about accounting. Average an 80 on his tests you can make an A.

I really enjoyed Mr. Clark. Teaching for him is for the joy to give back and not for a paycheck so he genuinely cares for his students and the knowledge he gives them about accounting. I definitely recommend his class. He has several options for the way he lectures in order to help his students succeeded
Great professor! He incorporates every learning style into his lectures to help everyone understand accounting.

Dr. Kuhnert is absolutely incredible. I've worked with her for a few years now, and she's been nothing but fantastic every time we've interacted. She gives clear, concise feedback and her lectures are easy to understand while still being informative. She's a character in the best way possible. Get ready for lots of laughs while working with Dr. K!

Not sure why there's no recent reviews of Dr. Kuhnert. We all love her. Has a lot of experience in the field. She knows the best way to do things, and the best ways to say what she wants you to do. Absolute joy to be around and under. Sometimes we just chat after class is over. You will learn a lot with this instructor very quickly.
Best and most helpful professor I've ever had. Genuinely interested in you succeeding inside and outside of the classroom. A teacher that every teacher should aim to be.
Dr. Kuhnert is a great teacher, very helpful, knowledgeable and she's pretty funny. It's a quick five weeks so be in class, do the homework, and you'll do fine.

Dr. Kuhnert was a and continues to be a great mentor for me and my singing career.  She was a very dedicated professor.  Dr. Kuhnert worked very hard to make sure that I was getting what I needed to get to my full potential!
She's an amazing teacher, I miss her
Unprofessional
A life changing influence.  If not for the expertise and guidance of this incredible instructor, I would not have stayed (and graduated) as a music major.
No Comments

Mr. Clewett is fine for a math professor, but primarily only teaches one method on how to solve things. If you're good at math you'll be fine, but there is a lot of homework and a class project. He also gets off topic now and again.

He has been a wonderful teacher and I would definitely take him again! Although the material has not been easy, I have enjoyed it. I wish there was more of a review for the test but there is so much to cover in such little time. Overall, he was great!
Mr. Clewett is the reason I passed math. He is amazing! He always welcomes students into his office if they have questions and you can tell he genuinely cares.
Mr. Clewett is one of the best math professors I have taken, he made me understand math which is a big deal because I dropped out once before because of math.
Great teacher! Highly recommend!

Thorough and to the point. There is homework almost every night, but only around 12 problems each. Do ALL of the homework and you're golden. If you have problems, he's more than happy to help! Otherwise, check out the math lab when in doubt. Best math teacher at WT by far.

This is the easiest class I have ever taken! Highly recommended. Pretty interesting. Teacher is a jackass but can be funny. He also is pretty weird. But class is beyond worth taking. If you need a math credit and you want something useful that is generally easy and doesn't require a lot of work - this is perfect if it's offered in your degree plan.

Although I do not feel that I have a strong understanding of the material, I will easily make an A in the class. You will probably have to go into office hours and ask questions a lot if you want to be able to do well on quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Clewett is very passionate about teaching, and wants to help her students have a deep knowledge of the course. Her teaching style is very fast paced and conceptual. She can come across very intimidating and strict, but she is always willing to help confused students.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She's a very rude teacher, she cussed at me and threw an eraser at me once because she thought the way I learned and understood subject matter was invalid, news flash not everyone learns the same way! I made a B in her class and at the end of the semester I went to talk to her about my final, she gave me a lectured on how terrible of a student Iwas

This professor gives many chances to get your grade up. When I took her class she understood that most students are not physics majors and wants you to try to understand the concepts at hand. She enjoys student participation and attempts to explain the concepts in a manner that applies to student life. I will go out of my way to take her classes.
She is an awesome professor. Though she can be very angry during her lectures, she cares a lot about her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Shes an great teacher and sometimes has a temper, but it gets u to do what she wants, i cant wait to take her again next semester
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Easier test. Hard homework. She likes interactive students.

Be ready to interact with her in class - she likes participation. Do the homework even if she's not going to grade it, test questions often come from those. She's willing to spend hours helping you during her office hours if you are clearly putting in the effort, and will walk you through problems. Really cares about her students.

Although the class was very easy for me, it was difficult for the freshmen. This very rude and unhelpful professor requires attendance and records it every day. Unfortunately her lectures are totally useless. The most annoying thing is that the tests are nothing like the homework or the lecture problems, so you have to really know the material.
She knows the subject matter well, but can not always communicate it for the entire class to understand. She is reude an degrading. Do not wear your feelings on your sleeve. Read the textbook...

Intelligent and intent on in class interaction- her personality may at times come across as intimidating, but her heart is for her students success. She is more than willing to help you if you show you are actually putting in an effort. The course itself fast paced, math intensive, and requires a LOT of out of class study to get a good grade.
She's a little crazy, but just go with her obsessive compulsiveness, and you'll be fine.  Lots and lots of homework.  She is super helpful outside of class.  Not an easy A.

She gives tests after a few chapters, and spends the first 30 minutes going over Texas Tribune. These tests are true or false, and gives the study guide the Thursday before. She's not afraid to share her opinion and politics and willing to debate.

Okay at first she's a little odd, but honestly her class is so easy and all tests(but one) is online, final and midterm was online. Term paper was very easy and grades easy. Sometimes she can be funny but most of the class is on their phone the WHOLE lecture. and she does take attendance

She only spends the last 5 minutes of class teaching the rest of the class is for her to share her opinion on political politics and starts stuff with students who don't agree with her view points. I would not recommend taking this class at all.

The class is really easy. All tests are TF with the test questions given out a few days before taking it. You have a 3-page term paper that as long as you write above a 9th-grade level you will be fine. Very opinionated and strong in her beliefs, but doesn't drop your grade if you have a different opinion.

She reads from the textbook, all tests are online and are true or false. The study guide is the test and she gives it out a few days before the test. You have to write an essay for each test beforehand and paste it in. Easy grader and let us out of class early
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Sit in the back. You'll thank yourself later. Very nice lady lecture is read out of the book. Study guides are the exam, and the exam essays are to be written before the exam date and are only one page, double-spaced. True and false only. The term essay is super simple. She doesn't give anyone a bad grade because you "at least attempted it."

The tests are all online and are just true or false, and she shares an in-depth review. Test days she doesn't make you come to class. The "tough" final paper is three pages double spaced and you have the whole semester to complete it. Your only other grades are test with an essay you're required to write with the test. Always let us out early.

She is awful. When writing the midterm essay she grades like a fourth-grade English teacher. She takes off for capitalization, punctuation, and likes to take off even if your sentence is correct but she wanted it worded differently. She constantly bashed students with different political opinions and tried to segregate vaxxed and unvaxxed students.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Mrs. Stravato is very opinionated, but she does not grade by her thoughts she grades by the facts. A textbook is very heavily used in this class and a test is taken after 1 or 2 chapters, the tests are very easy and she gives you a review before each test. she is very easy to work with but attendance is very much mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: A former comptroller in the state of Texas, Professor Stravato KNOWS what she is talking about. While the reviews are literally the test, you will remember everything you studied. Make sure to show up to class to hear amazing lectures, amazing point of view discussions, and overall bashing of Texas' government (which is hilarious). Must take!!!

MUST TAKE. Stravato is quite the character. She is outspoken, and not afraid to make her opinions known. Very up to date with everything going on in Texas government. Reviews are literally the test, so it is almost impossible to fail. You will love the class and enjoy it.
Very easy class. Her reviews for the tests basically ARE the test. Expect tests pretty often, but they're very easy. I normally just studied the morning of and got a high A on the tests.
Ms. Stravato is amazing! She kept class fun and interesting with her blunt humor. Her tests are extremely easy. I would highly recommend!
Professor Stravato is by far the easiest professor I've ever had. If you can put up with her blunt opinions on controversital topics and rants about the government, you'll pass easily.
Really easy class, but also insightful. She was a funny lady that keep you up to date on local events. She's awesome!

A wild eyed liberal and feminist!  Admittedly, she is funny, but the content she speaks of so vehemently is concerning.  I thought I was registered for a government class, not the ravings an obviously sad and angry woman. I could not spend an entire semester listening to her.
I love her! she is so funny. I agree with a lot of her opinions and enjoy her stories. She can appear abrasive to some people, but she really doesn't care. Minimal studying. Study guides=tests.

Easy. I think she likes sharing her opinions...A LOT. But its pretty entertaining. If at least one person speaks up about a conflict in class things get pretty interesting. You wont even have to study for this class. If your just trying to get your credits and don't care about Political Science take it! Study guide is identical to the test.
I enjoyed the class. She makes sure that you are informed on current events. Great class and the work is easy. Just tests and one oral report that is easy to do and give.
Really opinionated...
texas gov. easiest class i've ever taken. just read study guides!

Dr. C is an outstanding professor who genuinely cares about students and provides excellent feedback. Her lectures are easy to follow, and she explains the material well. She has clear expectations for assignments. I am retaking her for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. C is amazing! She is very helpful and always wants you to succeed. She will always have practice questions after each lecture which helps you understand the material even more! Instead of a Final test we have a final project that seems very manageable and simple. I would absolutely recommend taking this class!

I took CIDM6300 online with Prof C. The class was fun and interesting and kept the assignments to a manageable level that made sense for the material we had. She is tech-savvy so her lecture recordings were easy to watch and didn't have weird transitions or distracting stuff that sometimes happens. If you have to take Stats I recommend her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: She re-uses old test questions on each following test.  Just type them down and you'll be good.

She is amazing!!! Anytime I had a project, she would always be available to look over it and give me feedback before turning it in for a grade. She also lets you use your notes on test and quizzes. And she is a nice person and actually cares about her students. She also gave us free cheezits for a lesson. 10/10 would recommend and would take again!

Dr. C wants her students to succeed and it shows. I took her summer grad course, and at the beginning she gave us this schedule she recommended we follow, which helped a ton. Her course was easy, her assignments weren't hard but they weren't difficult. She's not a tough grader, I always got full points on assignments. Highly recommend!
Dr. Crisostomo is one of the best teachers I have had during my college career. She understands the students very well and has a great teaching style. I would recommend Dr. Crisostomo.

Hands down awesome course. Lots of resources. Teacher is available frequently. Lots of study tools and assistance. Class was informative, and hard at times but honestly so many resources and assistance makes it easier significantly. Best online class.

Her style of teaching is really accessible and doesn't force you to constantly write down notes. She is very personable and will always help you if you need it. Nothing in this class is particularly difficult or time consuming.

Dr. Crisostomo is one of the best professors I have had. She makes sure you have everything you need to succeed. If you show up to class and apply yourself you will do well. She is super approachable and willing to help you with whatever you need. Loved her class!

Professor Crisostomo is literally the best professor I have had in my educational career. Her goal is to have you learn the subject. She offers amazing feedback and is willing to review your work before submitting it. Her exam reviews make everything click. She is not trying to trick anyone. I could go on and on about how amazing she is.

Out of my two years of college, Dr. C has been my absolute favorite professor ever! Attending the classes definitely help you understand the material but her lectures are the best and she always makes them entertaining and explains everything so well! If you have the chance to take her DO IT!! I always looked forward to going to Statistics!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great videos, prompt feedback, straight forward. You do the work, you'll get a good grade.
Great teacher! Excellent video instruction. Loved her live YouTube events where you can get direct feedback on questions. I was able to apply immediately what I learned in this class at work.
This was the first stats class I'd ever taken (my undergrad wasn't in business), I was very nervous in the beginning, but became very confident as the course progressed. No surprises.

Dr. Crisostomo made a dry subject come to life. Her quizzes were not counted toward the grades, but if you did them you were able to easily get through the exams. The textbook she chose and followed was very clear, with great practice questions.

The best professor I've had to date in my MBA program. Excellent recorded video lectures were incredibly helpful for taking this course online. All course materials and communications were clear, logical, concise, helpful, and timely. The textbook was OK, but I felt like I learned a lot more from her notes and video lectures.
No comment
This man has done so much for me as a person and I owe him everything as a professor
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Stephen Crandall is the Loml. Great prof. Better man.
Stephen is great to have in class. I've taken 5 courses with him and feel like it's truly made me a better actress. He is always willing to help you outside of class. He cares about his students.

Stephen is a great teacher. He really cares about his students and will help you if you need it. Participation is key in class! Be open to every exercise and project and you will really enjoy this class. He really helped me become a better actress.

I didn't find his "exercises" helpful in becoming a better actor. I actually learned more from the book than I did from him. Breathing exercises? I didn't sign up for a yoga class. He's a good guy but I didn't learn that much. Plus he cancelled class like 4 times which is a lot considering class was only 2x/week. Money's worth? Not really...

Note: This is for EPSY 3302 which is not listed here.

Dr. Hughes cares about her field & provides useful information. The course is scheduled 2x weekly & we only meet once a week. If something happens on the 1 day she wants to meet, we just don't meet. We've met less than half the scheduled classes. Classes are just repetitive PowerPoints.

Professor Hughes very much accommodates to students who are taking this class as an elective. The final was easier, the notebook was easier, everything overall was easier if you communicate to her that this class is strictly for an elective. 10/10 would take again
Not only a great educator, but a great person. She is extremely knowledgeable and so humble at the same time. Class act, and knows her stuff.

This class is a methods class. I have taken Dr. Hughes in several other classes. I like the way she presents things online. I wish she would open every unit in the beginning. But I like the way things are laid out in the folders. Pretty decent difficulty level. However, at this point in school one should know how to do everything she asks.
Dr Hughes cares about her students learning and is very resourceful.

Goes into great detail and defines everything to a T. The class is already difficult, so he does a great job of guiding you through the material, but if you dont work hard. You will not pass. Know the problems on the homework and you can pass the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Took him for 4 classes. The key to his proofs classes is to know how to do every proof forward and backward on the HW and NOTES! It took me a semester and a half to realize there is at least 1 proof from the notes on a test WITHOUT FAIL. Fixing that jumped me from a C in 3325 and 4310 to an A in 4341. The old tests may get you a 50 on a good day.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor does not use blackboard to enter grades. You will have to look up your final grade. Graded by 4 tests only.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: His teaching style if straightforward & simple. In order to complete the homework assignments you will need the notes from his lecture that day. Your exam grades are what you will mostly be graded on, the homework will not matter as much. Sometimes he tends to give too many definitions instead of useful examples to do the homework. He's very nice
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you're a good student and stay on top of your homework, Dr. Comb's classes should not be hard. The tests are HEAVILY based on the homework, so make sure you can do every single problem. In Cal III the first test is the hardest. Read the book (Thomas's Calculus) because he doesn't cover everything in lecture. And ask questions!!
Do your homework! Study hard! NEVER leave a question blank on the tests. Don't be afraid to ask for help. Don't give up. I love him; he's my favorite. <3
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The lecture is already hard by itself so I don't blame the professor. A good thing about him is that he's gonna grade every part you made, so you will get some partial credits even if you did not find the final answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The course I took with Dr. Combs was a delight, especially when compared to other upper level courses I've taken within the department. This does not mean his classes are easy, they're not. But he gives you every opportunity to succeed and explains concepts well, while staying organized. Tests are tough, but fair. Work hard and it will pay off.

Focuses on his "videos", doesn't teach, he writes "office hours" on the syllabus, that means he'll be in his office then right? Wrong. Wasted my time in this class. Very disappointed for this man getting hired.
No Comments
Great prof, knows his stuff. Clearly defines what he expects and challenges students to think.

Susan Coleman is a tough professor. Tough, is a good foundation for criminal justice students. The student will recognize how valuable she is as an instructor once they obtain employment in their chosen field. She most certainly inspires students and truly cares. The best preparation one could have. Five thumbs up!

This professor changes the rules to suit her ! If you are a woman of color any color other than white please avoid this professor ! She doesn't have her PHD in anything and has short man syndrome! She is mean condescending and flat out treats her students like they are beneath her.  Avoid this professor !

No professor is successful by being condescending and dismissive. This professor not only lacks interest in her students, but fails to follow the text. Her instructions are vague. I've never seen so many students drop a graduate level course

Guidelines and expectations are not clear. Grades are not provided timely. The day I took my final exam, I was still missing three grades for assignments completed over a month ago. Horrible communication with online students. Very rude and abrubt and seems to have no interest in truley teaching us anything.

She lectures for all of class, every class.  Her tests are based off of both the material she covers in class and the material from the book she doesn't have time to get to during lecture. The study guides she provides are an accurate representation of what will be on the test.  Reading + Studying = Success

Welcome to university study folks!  I have had every class she teaches with exception of one.  Yes she is demanding, yes she uses socratic method in class and yes she is a great professor. If you do not read you will not make it, do the work and you will be fine.  She is willing to help students in any way she can. Cares about her students success.
Very tough, and teaches all classes as if they were all JD classes!
Teaches all her classes as though they were law school courses.  Very unapproachable and blunt.  If you can avoid her, do so.
Very hard grader for her freshman courses it is ridiculous.

A very petty and ineffective educator. Cares more for her opinion and pride than the education of her students. She does not follow grading criteria that she makes. Does not look at papers for academic value but whether or not she agrees with them
No Comments
No Comments

Dr. Coleman is a decent teacher not too demanding, however she gives off the feeling that she hates her students. NOT A GOOD ACADEMIC ADVISOR. As far as classes go, if you pay attention and read the text, you'll do wonderfully.
Pointless class. Only four grades- all tests. The test are timed leaving you with hardly any time. Should not be how an online class works.

It's an easy class to follow as far as an online selection, however he does not give you many grades. There are five in total discussion boards and five test as well I believe, there is extra credit offered which is great but in my case it has not helped tremendously.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: (National GOVT online) NO! Stay away! Most that get good grades CHEAT by GOOGLING. Exams are extremely specific, don't bother taking notes. About 1 minute per question. Very stressful exams. Get a PDF of the book and ctrl+F to find information (how I survived -exams are open book). 4 2pt extra credit quizzes available towards the end.
Didn't use the book at all, there's only a couple multiple choice exams for the online class and that's the whole grade. It was super easy.

Nice professor, however hates it when students are not paying attention and are on their phones during lecture. Will tell you that any questions you have for him not about lecture will be on the syllabus. Class & exams were very easy, gives extra credit points and easy questions. Tests are online and open for one week. He likes to kid around a bit.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very helpful. Online tests not difficult and can be googled easily. Voice not monotonous. Loves what he teaches. Very personable & works with athletic schedules well. Lots of extra credit opportunities. Can literally miss entire tests & pass the class (he admits to that). Tests open for 1 week online. Makes boring class interesting. Great teacher!!

This class is not easy at all, but it is one of the most fundamental ones for political science majors. The amount of theory you learn will help in almost every other class. Dr. Commissiong is brilliant, but his lectures are almost impossible to follow some days. Don't let that discourage you; just read and try to follow along until you understand.

I would not recommend this prof if you're taking PoliSci online. It is quite apparent that he does not like online teaching. Seems like he goes out of his way to make things more difficult. His tests are directly from the book. If you stay on top of it, you can do well. His discussion topics are super difficult too. Plan to devote lots of time!!!

I have him for an upper level class and I really like his class,I am taking another next semester. He is nice to students (I have seen him around campus and he is always polite), and engages the class. I was surprised to see some of the reviews.  I am guessing it's due to the fact that online classes in general present more problems than in person.
DO NOT take this class if you can not read and retain information. Too hard!!

This teacher is very interesting and the class is easy if you're good at reading and retaining the information. Show up to class and look half way alive to receive a helpful attendance grade, no need to pay attention. Nothing he teaches do you need to know. Only test. They're online, you have a week to take and are 100% over book reading. So read.

This professor is extremely rude to his students. I took his online class and asked questions via email and was always answered with some form of "you should've known this, this is common sense" response. His tests are directly off the chapters, nothing to do with lectures at all. Very difficult class to take online

I would recommend not taking him. From day one I was shocked at how he taught the class and how he treated the students. Every time I had a problem I had to consult with IT, and still then he couldn't give you the benefit of the doubt. All lectures are not on the tests. And the tests will kill you if you dont get an A or B every time. To hard!!!!!!

DON'T TAKE HIM. I almost filed a formal complaint. I took his online class and had to get a tutor. His tests were impossible and he was downright rude when I asked questions. I knew someone who took his class after I took it and she was as desperate for help as I was.
Teacher requires attendance and usually gives extra credit when you attend also textbook is used. Open book tests they are hard but read and take NOTES. Should at least get a B

this teacher teaches but all of his tests are open book...they are not easy but if you READ the chapters you shall do fine. Also attendance is required for his class. Sometimes it can be boring but that is what college is all about. He lectures for knowledge and al of his tests are based entirely on textbook materials

The tests are still tough but if you need help she will be there to help you along. I definitely recommend taking Connie's class if you have to take this course.
She is a good teacher and coach, I would recommend her class.
Wonderful professor! She truly cares about all of her students! Connie is by far my favorite professor at WT!
She is awesome and fun. Makes us work very hard to get the job dont but allows us to have fun as well. And a debate team would be VERY fun at WT
she is an excellent coach and teacher demanding that students be up to par and at the same time willing to spend the time to help them meet that demand.

Professor Cooley is a favorite among students. She provides notes and guides for all her tests. Her instructions and teaching style make it easy to pass the class. I enjoyed Professor Cooley.
My girl Karen keeps it 100. Straight G.

Dr. Cooley Is such a sweet professor! She has such a heart for teaching. She is always willing to work with you. Her assignments and tests are all online. Attendance does matter as she has a attendance sign in sheet she passes at the beginning of class and she enters a weekly grade for attendance. Would definitely take her classes again!!

Professor Cooley is incredible and a wonderful person but her class can be difficult. She does everything she can to help you and is always available through e-mail. There are only three assignments and a couple of exams so you need to do well on exams to do well. If you have the chance to take any of her classes you definitely should!

Professor Cooley is honestly one of the best Professors I have had. She is a ton of fun, super honest, and all around a great teacher. She is willing to help with anything you need help on, and is easy to reach outside of class through email. Intermediate 1 is a make it or break it class for accounting majours, and Cooley definitely makes it fun.

Professor Cooley is amazing for accounting. I am not great at math and knew absolutely nothing about accounting going into this class, but I came out with an A in the class and it was not stressful getting it. She really wants the students to do well and is very open to helping you with whatever you need and is very nice about it.

reviews.comment: Extremely kind, attentive, helpful, and respectful. Cooley is THE best teacher I have ever had throughout all of my education. Review the outlines, workout the sample problems before exams, and you'll do great.

Professor Cooley is one of the most respected, helpful, and student-friendly professors at WTAMU. Her accounting lectures are awesome, and online students feel like they are getting the in-person experience by how she teaches. She is quick to help you if you have questions and goes out of her way to guide you through any confusion.

The BEST professor I have ever had. She cares about her students and wants them to do well. She gives out handouts to students to help them and does a review for the test. It is still a tough class but she does everything in her power to help you! Easy to get ahold of outside of class too. Awesome professor!

Professor Cooley is one of the best professors I've had. She's knowledgeable and she cares about her students' success. I highly recommend taking her if you're looking for a class where you'll learn a lot from an amazing professor.

This class was fun and easy if you're a math person. She drops 1 exam including the final and some cengage assignments as well. If you have any questions about the material or about the career she is more than happy to help you! Wonderful class!

Professor Cooley is an amazing teacher. Her lectures are fun and easy to understand, but don't miss a lecture or you'll be lost. Be sure and take really good notes, write down everything that she does and any extra questions.

Karen Cooley is easily the best professor WT has to offer. She genuinely cares about her students and wants them to succeed. As far as the class, come prepared and pay attention in class. Homework ensures youll do well on exams. Practice, Practice, Practice on in-class examples to prepare for exam. Use tutor lab to check homework!

I really enjoyed Ms. Cooley. She likes to lecture and she makes sure that her students follow along and understand the material. She is a great professor, be prepared for online homework and 4 exams, not including the comprehensive final. I would highly recommend her.

Fantastic Professor! She is so joyful even in early mornings. Also incredibly understanding. If you're late on homework, just talk to her. I love that she talks about real world scenarios to help students understand. Books are expensive in this class but they will be used! I would love to take from Cooley for all my classes.
Great professor!

Ms. Cooley relates the learning to the real world, so you can see how it will actually be used. She came to class prepared to teach and would answer questions in detail. She has a "fun" question at the end of tests and fun facts before every class to lighten the mood. Accepts late work if for some reason you fall behind. Emails back quickly.
Shes a super nice lady and she lets you make up work and shell work with you. Its hard to pay attention in class though. Make sure you dont zone out or youll be lost forever
Great professor!!
I love Ms. Cooley.  She is absolutely one of the best professors in the COB.  I really think she is good and a lovely person.  She knows accounting too.

Allows you to make up all homework, grades the tests and has them posted within hours, and you get lots of points for just showing up to class. She is funny, makes class as simple as possible, and will help in any way she can.

Good teacher, all homework is done on a website you have to pay for as well as the book. She is fast to grade and give feedback for weekly posts. Exams are not easy 50 questions each (3 exams) no extra credit in this class! She seems like a nice person.  You need to study hard for the tests and practice a lot with your HW.
I wish I could take Professor Cooley for every class. She is so good at explaining concepts and giving real world examples.
Professor Cooley is the BEST professor I have ever had.  I changed my major to Accounting because of her influence and inspiration!
Really sweet. Straight to the point. Tries to make it interesting.
Cooley is a great teacher who is always willing to help you out!
Absolutely loved having Cooley! As long as you study what is on the review and the chapter outlines that we go over in class, the tests aren't bad!

This course is very tough, its intermediate accounting for pete's sake. Just show up to class, use her notes and write anything extra you think you would forget. make sure to study for tests and just make sure to take it one step at a time. Karen is never going to turn you down if you need help and she will explain any questions you have!

This teacher is a goofball and just the sweetest funny lady. she will help you in any way she can and understands that her students are people and genuinely wants to do anything in her power to help you! Plus she makes the material seem SO  simple!

Prof. Cooley is hands down one the best professors I've had at WT. She is so nice and understanding. She is one of those professors that you can tell really cares about the students and will work with you. If you are not an accounting major but need to take accounting 1 and 2, make sure you take her.

Karen Cooley is one of the best teachers I have EVER had. She cares about each one of her students, and really takes into consideration that accounting isn't for everyone and really teaches accordingly. If you're not an accounting major, don't take anyone else!
Cooley is a phenomenal teacher!  Very interested in each individual student, incredibly helpful.  Love her!
She's a really good professor.  Take her! :)
Really good intro professor.
She is an amazing professor and advisor. She is hard, but you will learn. She is extremely helpful and will talk you through anything.

Mo is a great professor and she is very understanding!! I would recommend taking taking any class she teaches

reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Denton is awesome. While it may be impossible to make some material interesting and exciting, he is always trying to keep the class engaged and interested. He is incredibly funny, caring, and very supportive when working with students' personal issues. It's impossible to fail. keep up with assignments and attend, you wont have trouble.

I loved this class, it was so knowledgeable and I learned a lot from Professor Denton. My only complaint is that he says attendance isn't mandatory, but he has guest speakers without any notice and then gives you a 0.

Professor Denton tries his best to make the class fun, and has a great personality. Although the lecture gets boring it is a fairly easy class. There is a group project, a midterm, and a final. The quizzes are due at 9 pm so make sure to remember them. The tests are easy, and the midterm can be fun as long as you have a good group.

Denton is a fantastic professor who definitely cares about his students and their success. However, this class is one that's really difficult for any professor to make fun or entertaining in any way. Definitely a class where participation matters, and attending lectures are important to making sure you pass. Go to office hours and make friends!

reviews.comment: This course was so incredibly boring but it's required. His teaching style does not mesh with me at all. This was the least important class on my totem pole this semester. reviews.comment: I took his child development class. The lectures were very interesting and he always has jokes ready. There is a group project at the end of the year that is a pain and another project for midterms but he also has a midterm and final test. Overall the class was interesting.

I enjoyed this class, but it honestly was a lot of work. There was a weekly quiz, group project, and a midterm and final. The weekly quizzes got old fast, and sometimes they were really hard. The midterm and final were pretty easy. His teaching style is unique, but I would recommend him to someone.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: There is a lot of reading but it's not too much if you manage your time wisely. I would definitely take him again.

Great teacher and person. Explains everything very well. Some would say he requires a lot of reading, but honestly, if you just pay attention in class,(which isn't hard to do) you probably don't even need to read all of the assigned reading material. Highly recommend this class and Professor Denton! :)
Loved his class he makes it fun and has very good and clear examples. Its best to try and go to every class because he covers a lot of material.
Class is really easy. Online Quiz every week but its easy. Final is from online quizzes. Mr. Denton is really nice and the class is interesting. Recommend this teacher.
Super cool lady, lectures were easy to follow and I actually wanted to show up because of her lectures. Pretty easy to get an A if you show up and study a little bit for your tests.

Decent professor. She seemed to be very knowledgeable, but sometimes she would teach her opinion which I didn't appreciate. Her tests were pretty hard, but lectures weren't terrible. No homework, which was nice.

reviews.comment: Dr. DeButte posted a lecture every week which was a PowerPoint with voiceovers. There's an optional textbook that I didn't get. She held office hour zoom calls every week to answer questions.

Dr. DeButte is best professor I have ever had. She is very energetic so it is very easy to pay attention in her class. Her exams are exactly like the review and she provides a lot of opportunities for extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She was so funny and always tried to make lecture interesting with fun videos and sometimes interactive slides. As long as you went to class you were fine, I never touched the book once and she even gives a very detailed review for the tests. Also, her tests are extremely straight forward and very east to obtain an A on.

Professor DeButte makes the lectures really fun and loves her job! The exams are hard if you don't review slides and take good notes in class. The final is completely accumulative. The section exams don't particularily follow the review, but the review is helpful. All exams are multiple choice with 3 short answers. Exams are based of lectures only.

I liked her classes a lot !! She is one of my favorite college professors Ive had so far. I have ADHD so I am terrible at paying attention to lectures but hers are interesting enough to be manageable. I personally did use the textbook to study, but you can absolutely do the class without it. Ive taken health & forensic psych from her so far.

De Butte is fantastic! She makes her lectures SO engaging. And she's super joyful and just happy to live life. For exams, study the slides. She grades mostly from her lectures, so take good notes. I found it helpful to print out the slides before hand to take notes next to. I'm not a psych major, but she makes me almost want to switch majors!

I took 4 classes with Dr. D and she is a brilliant neuropsychologist-- but her classes are not challenging. Always ask for opportunities to work in the lab if you want experience. Print out the power points before class and take notes along side them during lecture. She doesn't mind her lectures being recorded which is helpful during reviews.

Dr. Debutte is fantastic. She gives AMAZING lectures and has a wonderful attitude. She is always upbeat, even though she taught an 8am summer class. She didn't use the books very much, study guides are just like the test. Offers lots of extra credit.

AMAZING professor! If you go to class and take notes, it is an easy A. You do not have to use your book because her lectures are very detailed. Literally the only thing you have to do is go to class and take good notes. She is very knowledgeable and passionate about psychology which made her lectures even more information as well as interesting.

If you attend class you don't need the book because her lectures are extremely detailed and she gives you everything you need for tests and bonus question answers.  This is a no frills and very efficient class, Dr. D is very respectful of our time as well as hers, no busy work or excessive need to prove her position. Excellent instructor.
She is great!!! Lectures are interesting and keeps you entertained. Three exams and one project is a piece of cake, if you study and try at least. I will definitely take her again!

Took her for 3320, 4324, and 4360, and I'm taking her for 4325 this fall! Her tests are fair, the study guides are excellent, and the textbook isn't necessary; I've made 3 As without reading a chapter. Only problem is if you're not a strong writer; she's not a tough grader, but you usually have a lit review worth 30-40 percent of your grade.
Dr. Debutte is AMAZING! She is such a sweet lady and very helpful during class with examples and explaining.
She's one of my favorite professors I've had so far. She cares about students as individuals and she's really into teaching so the lectures are never boring
Dr. Debutte is an excellent instructor.

Great teacher and intersting class. She teaches off of powerpoints which she puts online along with reviews, but takes attendance daily. She prepares you very well for the tests, but sometimes goes too fast during lecture. There are many extra credit opportunities.

kept class very interesting. explained things very well. tests were extremely easy if the terms were studied. reviews were almost the exact same as the tests. allows bonus points. overall an amazing instructor!

If you miss a class you will get behind, but she is very easy to get a hold of, gives you grace when needed, and communicates very well. There are so many grades so if you miss one it's not the end of the world. Allows a notecard on tests. Overall very pleasant and sweet.
She is a great teacher. She gives you printed notes. She gives great lectures.

I had Ms. Bodkin (use to be Payton) twice! I am someone who has struggled with math my entire life. I got an A+ in my college algebra class thanks to her. Her teaching is so clear and thought out. She does not make it harder than it has to be. She is super nice and provides reviews that are similar to the test.

Amazing professor! Shes super sweet and very understanding! The class itself was not hard for me at all, and I believe thats because of how well she taught us! I would definitely take her class again and would so recommend her as a professor!! I enjoyed coming to her class every single time! Shes the best!

Professor Payton is absolutely amazing. She is super nice and will help you if you do not understand and she explains each problem very thoroughly. Textbook is required because of homework but it is nothing too hard. It is important to pay attention in class because the examples she provides will be similar to what she will put on the test.

Easy A if you show up to class and take notes. Easy homework due every few days. I am not a math person, but she explained things well enough for me to get an A (something I've never done in a math class before.) Would recommend.

The class was not bad at all. You take three tests and the final is optional to replace your lowest test grade. The hardest part is writing a long paper towards the end of the semester. Though, if you meet the rubric that is give you'll end up with an A or B for sure. I like taking his classes, you are to pace yourself and do what you need to do.

The class was pretty straightforward. There were three tests that you got two attempts on each. Then an essay that was 3,000 to 8,000 words. The paper was the hardest part of the course. He likes you challenge you and make you think about it all. The book is on the library website for free. Overall, glad I got to experience the class with him!

reviews.comment: Class was very straight forward: read the assigned chapters for that week, then take the test. Would definitely take another class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Great professor and excellent lectures. You really do learn so much from him throughout the semester and he makes it as student friendly as possible so that you can get the course work done. I have taken many other classes of his and I would hands down say he is the best professor I have ever had!

I think Dr. DeArmond is a great professor. I took him twice, and he is amazing. His lectures are outstanding, and we even got to meet prominent business people. He is very friendly and caring. He expects you to do the work. If you don't do it, you will not pass. I took Fin3350 and 3335 with him.

I am currently taking this class. First three weeks of class, and I had already started a working budget for my family. I had a major issue with my schedule due to health issues of a close family member. I emailed him and he worked with my schedule. He was also very positive and helpful and even encouraged me to finish strong. Take him!
I have always enjoyed interacting with Dr. DeArmond. He is engaging and has a great sense of humor. His sock fashion is interesting, to say the least.

Dr. D is by far the best teacher I have had in my undergraduate or graduate studies. He works very hard to make sure that all work assigned is applicable to the real world and spends countless hours trying to make boring subjects more fun. I can't imagine why there are any negative reviews on here about him... do your work and quit crying people.

I have no idea why he would receive low ratings.  I think he is a great professor.  I loved taking him.  He had interesting lectures, and was a caring professor.  I had one friend who chose not to do the final project and made a zero.  That is what happens when you don't do your work, hello.  He is a busy man, so doesn't always answer emails.

Awesome teacher...willing to help and work with the students and their individual needs!

great class extremly excited about teaching, a must take professor

Professor was moody and equivocal. Overall the content was good and there is a lot of reading. It was manageable and interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: RUN! I had to take her ethics class online because she was the only one who taught the class.  She had a baby in the middle of the semester and expected all of us to be understand.  I was .04 away from an A and she gave me a B.  Her course is very dense and the test questions relate to a single sentence in the chapter. WORST TEACHER EVER!
Run away people! Don't take her class unless you want a C+ or lower than that.

Lots of group projects and tons of reading every week. Textbooks have no traditional structure and Dr. Hammer does not providing guidance on what to focus on. Students prepare all lectures, but professor provides no feedback to students. Just by signing up, you lose 5% because no one is perfect according to Dr. Hammer. Worst professor ever!! Run!!!

With 6 group projects and two textbooks, including 4-6 chapters of reading material per week. One of the assigned textbook (Kahneman) is not about ethics and would be more suitable for a psychology course. The other text (Thanu) is poorly written and only takes into account the worst case scenarios. I will avoid this professor in the future!

Dr. Hammer is not a bad professor. Group discussions are due by midweek and replies to group discussions are due by Fridays. Because this is an online class quizzes and test are mostly from what is read in the book. You do not have the option to view the quiz after you have completed so you will not be able to see what questions you got wrong

Took the class online. Expect her to grade your discussions pretty hard. Even though she expects "3-5 sentences" for discussion posts, be prepared to write up a couple paragraphs if you want a decent grade. Chapter quizzes are 5 questions each with a time limit of 10 minutes.

Read a chapter a week, do online timed quiz/test and every other week or so have an online assignment.  Very clear and to the point but you gotta pay attention to the reading other wise the big tests are HARD
Good course if you have good study habits, and want a challenge. If you have problems retaining information, and/or expect a free ride (like the poster below) skip it and find an easier Instructor.

This class is a very hard online class, there is no study guides.  You must do a very close reading, practically memorize the book and professor is not very helpful. He makes the tests hard where their could be more than one answer, and you have to pretty much choose the one you think is best. Way too hard for a basic history class!
Her classes will make you better if you really work for it. I don't think I would take it again because she's a tough grader, but it was okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is the worst Professor Ive ever had.

Professor gives really clear instructional videos and provides the book for the quizzes. The content is clear as long as you put in the time and effort to try. BEWARE of project due dates. Assignments due are listed weekly, but the projects are not included in this list. If you miss, she does not accept any late work and your grade will suffer BAD.

Dr. Wyckoff is an extremely tough grader. There are four major assignments and two exams. The assignments are worth the most, however the exams are 15% in total. She grades extremely hard and both exams are difficult. While she provides a review for the exams, they truly do not help. Plus, you do not learn much from the lectures. Do NOT recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Meljac cares about his work and students. However, he didn't take all lecture opportunities. The last half of the semester was a study hall. He had 3 major papers due on the same day. He changed due dates for 2 papers multiple times. He kept pushing back dates but being upset when nothing was turned in. He'd apologize then be upset again.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Meljac taught with Dr. Von Lintel for this class and they both did a great job. Dr. Meljac didn't grade harshly at all and was always available outside of class. You could tell that he really cared about what he was teaching.

If you want a class where the professor remembers you and communicates with you well this isnt it. I tried to meet with him and turn in my grades and he kept giving me 0s instead of telling me what was wrong. This professor also couldnt determine weather he wanted to keep online or not. I payed for an in person class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had him for ENGL 1301. I liked the class at first, but I had a hard time enjoying it by the time the semester ended. We had to write a memoir and a literary analysis for our final portfolio. I hated the literary analysis, and his feedback was quite harsh. The class was also hybrid, which I didnt know it would be. I didnt enjoy the class.

reviews.comment: Dr. Meljac is a great professor. He really cares about his students and wants to make sure that you are getting the most out of this course. I have NEVER had as awful of an educational experience as I did with this professor. He seems rigid and is not willing to work with students even in the middle of a global pandemic.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Meljac is not the professor to take if you value communication between you and your professors. Regardless of your effort in the class, he believes that he is above communicating and clarifying with his students about assignments. If you want an understanding and empathetic professor, find anyone else. I will never take another class with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Meljac really is the best! It's easy to see that he cares a lot about his students and he is very understanding. I have had nothing but a positive experience and I honestly wish he taught all of my classes

I took Dr. Meljac during my first semester and I was terrified to take an English class. But it wasn't too bad, it was really fun! if you have trouble formatting or correcting your paper definitely go to the writing lab, they are helpful and Dr. Meljac is also available outside class. He is there to help you not fail you BUT YOU HAVE TO TRY!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Meljac is a fun, caring professor who is passionate about what he teaches about. He's generous and interesting. He cares deeply for his students and is inclusive, entertaining, and not-too-difficult. He's willing to work with you on anything you might need, and is easy to find during his office hours.
hard grader
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Honestly the best English professor I've ever had! As long as you speak up a bit in class ask questions and do your assignments you'll be okay. There are a few quizzes that he allows you to make up if you miss one. The hardest thing for me was the final paper but he was so understanding and helped me the whole way through.
Best teacher Ive ever had. Made English class tolerable

He is wonderful. I enjoy his class. He has 5 quizzes, 1 midterm exam, 1 major paper and the final. Quizzes will be easy if you read stories before class. The midterm is a take-home paper and the final you can open the book. You should come to class because everything we discuss is in exams.  He grades hard in the major paper, so you need to focus.
Dr. meljac is wonderful espically if you are not a fan of english. 4 essay, take home midterm, class discussion. Very helpful! highly recommend taking for english 1301,1302

Dr. Meljac is the best! He is very passionate about his students and teaching. If you need the help, he is there for you and won't let you fail. Clear instructions, and not a tough grader. Participation really helps and he also notices those who show up and try. Wonderful teacher, never liked English until I took his class.
Likes discussion in class, read your book, will work with you, never really angry, after 5 skips lose a letter grade

Professor Finchum is a wonderful lady but she is difficult to communicate with. I took the online course and could not get a response to questions I had within a timely manner. There is a major group project that requires a lot of collaboration with your team. Start on the project as soon as possible. It is a large percentage of your final grade.

Would not recommend taking this class. If possible take another professor. Not very communicative with students. Goes on long tangents that image irrelevant to course material. Difficult to understand what is wanted on assignments.

Professor Finchum is a fantastic teacher who backs up textbook reading with videos over each chapter. A major part of the course grade is the group project, which absolutely solidifies what you have learned throughout the course. Assignments include chapter readings, discussions, exams, and 3 drafts of the group project.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Responsive, helpful, fair. I disliked the group project (I typically do all the work) but the grades reflected that in the peer reviews. Smart lady with practical experience and she cares about her students. If you have a problem, let her know and she'll work with you. Would recommend and retake her.
Her exams are HARD!!!

Dude, this class and this professor were horrible. Finchum's chapter tests were impossible and the group project was a nightmare- not because of the group, but because of her grading. She also makes the class time feel really awkward. In order to pass the chapter tests, you have to know the textbook verbatim because the questions are SO particular.

This instructor is ridiculous. Discussions are graded hard and shes never pleased with your work. Quizzes were 40 questions for a QUIZ! That is how long tests are. The term project is completely pointless. We did EXACTLY what she said on the feedback from the draft and still did bad. I got a B because of that. She never replies to emails. Good luck

I took this marketing class as a "blow off", but it ended up being my hardest class. She was one of the toughest graders I have ever experienced. There are 8 quizzes which are relatively hard, 8 discussions that are HEAVILY graded, and a group term project that graded even tougher. she gives helpful feedback AFTER she has graded your assignments.

Prof. Finchum is a very kind lady, but her coursework is difficult. I'll make it out with a B, but that will be my best efforts. Discussions , I feel like she is just never satisfied with my answer. Quizzes, answers are mostly in the book (hardly online); however, the online Cengage book sucks. The group project will be hard, but which one is not?

Professor Finchum is a fair professor. Do the work and you will be fine. I enjoyed her course the first time so this is actually my second from this professor. This course has a group project so that can always be hit or miss depending on your partners.

Tough grader - no extra credit. Huge marketing project that should be assigned for 16 week courses is expected of you, even during the summer 4-5 week course. Be ready to work - still got a B. A few people dropped the course due to difficulty on group project which is 1/3 of your grade. Good correspondence - discussions take a ton of reading/time.

Although the professor communicates clearly, the work load is extremely heavy (at least for the summer course). She has it well structured but there are multiple quizzes, in depth discussions, and group projects WEEKLY.

She is a good teacher and truly does care, however she is a bit tough on grading the discussions and they can become confusing because of how she conveys the questions. She does give good feedback and wants you to succeed. Work in a group for the marketing plan, it will cut your work in half. Overall, I would recommend her.

Solid curriculum for the online course, the semester project had real world applications to my current job, her lectures were concise (15/20 min) but extremely clear and a good segue into the chapter material. Outside of class she helped me source material for an interest I had, overall a very positive experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Would take again

reviews.comment: I'm upset with the amount of extras we have to buy with this course.  Expecting us to buy online homework things, and 'clickers' just because he doesn't want to grade homework seems a bit lazy to me.  The most important purchase isn't one listed, though: Physics for dummies. You will be teaching yourself.

Boring. Teaches irrelevant things then tests the difficult concepts. Misses class frequently. He missed two classes this semester without sending any kind of word out. I commute 30min each way. Would be considerate of him to pay us the respect we deserve.
Not a good teacher, good person, but not a good instructor.  Always late or gone, not enough time on exams, grades each test different.
Something about his voice puts EVERYONE to sleep. Even those in neighboring classrooms and towns.
No Comments

He was extremely tough to learn under. He was extremely restrictive in what you could and could not make for class projects and was rather verbally aggressive. I wish I had known then what Title IX was because I really could've used that assistance as his student.
If you didn't kiss his rear you weren't getting pas a C.
His art was bad and he wouldn't know talent if it hit him in the face.
Unnecessarily rude. He makes fun of students and delights in insulting others. Unprofessional, harmful environment.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Frish is my toughest and most direct instructor. His class inspires me to be a better artist as well as a better human. He grades hard and does not bull s with ignorance. It is hard to get his stamp of approval but when you do it makes your entire academic career. I absolutely suggest him if you are serious about a career but be prepared.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's a tough teacher, but he's honestly in it for the students advancement. Everything mean he says or does is to weed out the lazy students so he can focus on getting the serious students moving forward

Very tough professor! He said he would not like our work.  He does just about everything to get on your nerves to test your patience. He wants to build your character for criticism. During critique he will draw on your work so get ready to do it over again. Take a lot of notes! Work outside of class is expected and your grade will be reflected.

Great professor honestly. The lectures are a little confusing and can sometimes get off topic. Tough skin is needed for critique, but you honestly can't take it personally.  He is ultimately trying to help and make you a better artist.

Scott Frish's classes are unquestionably difficult; he teaches a difficult subject. However, if you listen, ask questions, and can handle being told you need to move in another direction, you'll do fine. He's a brilliant man who is a bit difficult to take at first, but is well worth the effort. I learned SO much from him!

I started my BFA Frish's first year of employment at WT.  Being an artist with a different approach to his landed me on his naughty list. I respected his authority and honestly tried to learn from him. He proceeded to pick favorites and talk down other faculty and students (some were great artist) just because they did not subscribe to his "sayso".

This pretty much says & does whatever he wants & doesn't care who gets pissed off. Best thing to do, don't let him get to u. I think he tries to put students through a trial -see if u can withstand criticism. He is slightly partial to certain student. Try ur best to get on his good side -u'll be rewarded. Take good notes! & god forbid u miss class.

S. Frish takes interest in only those that pledge their allegiance to him, otherwise he'll either try to ruin you or ignore you. He is very unprofessional in the way he deals with other faculty and students that cause any friction for him. I suggest that students should try to stay in good enough standings w/ him in order to pass required course

Professor Francois is kind and cares about his students. His class is made up of assignments that are open book and not timed and exams that are similar to the assignments. If you watch his videos and take good notes for the calculations you should do well.
He's very helpful and explains things that anyone can understand.

Francois is a great professor and very caring. I did not find this course particularly difficult in the coursework, but the concepts were very interesting to learn still. Francois provides video recorded lectures which really help with the calculations. I enjoyed this course and did well.

Had to write assignments and two papers (projects) for his class and take several exams. Projects were graded too harshly with no feedback and can bring your grade down. Instructions were confusing and didn't help even if followed exactly. Exams were a little difficult even if you read the chapters and notes provided. Little learning involved.

Took this class over intercession, maybe the professor was too busy with the holidays, but I found him very unresponsive. Asked for guidance on the tests and got no feedback, no study guide was provided. Professor put in the minimum effort. Waste of my time and I learned nothing from him. Its an easy enough class, but isn't the point to learn?

Take Dr. Francois and you will be happy you did. So easy, I took him over intersession with no problems. The paper is short and the tests are easy, study using internet test banks and be able to do the calcs from the handful of lectures he posts. If you are looking for a break in your schedule this is it.

Two tests and a paper. His tests come right out of online test banks, with a couple sims. He doesn't give much instruction, other than a few web based lectures. No study guidance, so just do the calculations he goes over in the lectures and go over test bank answers you are golden. Won't learn much but it's an easy A or B.

This class was way more enjoyable than I anticipated thanks to Dr. Francois. He really cares about his students and wants to help them understand. Watch the video examples he provides and follow his study guides. He is very straightforward. Amazing teacher!

I was worried to take a stats class online but Prof. Francois was great! He provided videos of actual examples similar to what would be on the test. It felt like being in the classroom and he was actually teaching--hard to accomplish in an online course! His tests were very fair. Awesome professor and class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Jason is my favorite prof so far. He is an amazing teacher with real care for his students. While it is not mandatory to come to class, it will help significantly. Take this prof!! He is the best, you just have to try!
By far the best professor I have taken a class with!

Jason was the best! I loved his class, I loved the way he lectured, he was always available if I needed to meet with him outside of class. He was a great professor, he saw us as people who he wanted to succeed rather than just bodies in his classroom. You won't regret taking a class with him.

He wants you to call him Jason or he says you "won't pass" and he wants the students to feel free to call or text him if they have any questions. He really wants everyone to succeed and he prepared the students well. He was an AMAZING professor and I'm very sad to be done with his class. I would totally take him for a class again. Great teacher/guy

Jason is the BEST! You don't need book, exams are straight from his fill in the blank notes(attend class). Exams are long and only a few matching with the rest all basically short answer. YOU MUST KNOW YOUR STUFF TO PASS. Discussions are easy, group project was easy, as well as individual project. He makes class fun, and interesting. TOUGH class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Took this course as a requirement for the MBA program. This course is not for the faint of heart. There is a lot of reading that has to be done on your own and you need to be good at self discipline to get through all the materials. The tests are tough but you should be able to make up points with homework, discussion boards and the final project.

Homework does not prepare you for the tests which are a big part of your grade. Final Project is unrealistic as the readings does not prepare you to succeed in her class. Does not provide grades in a timely manner. Two weeks after class is over and grades are still not posted. AVOID AT ALL COST - spend your college dollars elsewhere.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Tests questions are in story mode. This could work if the books chapters worked the same way, but they don't. The tests do not match the book. The final project is what determines your grade and it's a written project?? I written final for a fundamentally mathematics class?? Exactly! You end up with an opinion grade at the end based on her feelings

reviews.comment: Do NOT take this class with this professor if you don't have a strong background in accounting. This subject is important for my major so I dropped the course & will take it with a different prof.

reviews.comment: Very tough tests, lengthy online homework, and not a lot of assignments to recover if you're struggling. HUGE project at the end, so start early!
