reviews.comment: Tests count for most of grade, but too few are given. Tons of homework each day.  I had an A until the last test.  I made a C on it, and that lowered my grade to a C.  Just to give an example of the ridiculous grading system.  No curves whatsoever.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Great teacher!! She was funny and made it so much easier to pay attention. The class was pretty easy as long as you studied.

not a good choice to take if you want to be taught, not just expected to teach yourself out of the book- which is very expensive. this should be an online class because all assignments are online & she does not teach or help in class but expects you to be there for attendance, test are hard and are not like anything you work on in class or online.

She is a cool teacher and is willing to joke around in class. But be warned Auditing is about as boring Tax. Also it is nearly as hard and the book is horrible. Other than that Dr. Friske makes the class rather enjoyable.
very good professor.  old school and demanding.
No Comments
smart and well researched.  he has a habit of pacing while he lectures but overall very good professor
he is a great professor.  one of my favorites at WTAMU.  an inspiration.
grades harshly

She is very passionate about her area of study and really enjoys interacting with students. However, the first day of class she says she will not give you her opinion but will only present the data. This is incorrect. She is not open to anyone having other opinions and will require you to agree with her opinion in tests of you want a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr Garza is very educated and passionate in her field. She is very relatable and so nice, her lectures are great and she isn't a hard grader. We had a few tests and two papers, where she was clear on the instructions and grading rubric. For tests, she gave a study guide and opportunities for extra credit. Definitely recommend taking her class.

Dr. Garza is very sweet. I didn't touch the textbook and did fine. The important thing is to come to class and listen and read her powerpoints. She does give random attendance extra credit so another reason to come to class. She responds to emails promptly and is easily accessible outside of class. She is a slow grader.

Dr. Garza is the best professor I've had in a while. Her class requires critical thinking, but hey, this is college people, it's an honor to know that she holds us at this level of intelligence! LoL There is a lot of reading required, but she gives great feedback on assignments and always answered emails and phone calls. 2 thumbs up!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Garza is the most engaged professor I have encountered in quite a while. There is A LOT of reading for this class, and her assignments require critical thinking - I think that's what made the class so rewarding! Read you assignments and put your thinking cap on and you'll do fine. She is a very fair grader and gives great feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: This woman has been the most empowering, not only professor, but teacher and mentor.  This woman will most likely not keep up with her own syllabi dates, but it is because she gets so passionate about what she is talking about.  So if you want a class taught by someone that loves what she teaches about take her! May be late grading. Grades fair.

This course was super disappointing to me. After the first couple classes i expected to love the class. Following the first test my view changed, she grades very hard, tests are lots of critical thinking and you have to agree with her opinion!! Your grade is basically based on your 3 tests. If you're a strong willed republican, find another proff,
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Garza is cool and fun to listen to. She makes it fairly interesting. She randomly takes extra credit attendance and gives extra credit assignments. Take notes and read your text and you'll be set.

Garza is a great professor by far my favorite professor I have had in my four years in college. It is very important you go to the lectures and pay attention if you do not you wont pass (she gives random attendance sheets for extra credit). Her tests are difficult if you dont pay attention, so mainly show up to class. AWESOME professor!!no textbook
This prof will do anything to make sure you are prepared for real life situations. She is enthusiastic and dedicated to academia. I hope to have this professor again!
You don't actually have to learn anything, just regurgitate her opinions.  Whatever happens, do NOT disagree with her!  I thought sociology would be more interesting than it actually was in class.

I took this class over the summer (6 weeks) and it was hard!!! There was a lot of reading involved. Get ready to do some serious calculations. I am glad that I did not take this class during the regular semester, 6 weeks were more than enough. The professor is wonderful and super helpful, his lectures are amazing.

reviews.comment: He is great professor but you have to work for your grade. He is always willing to help and replies fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Best teacher I have ever had. Professor Gallardo truly cares about his students and will go above and beyond to help you succeed. If you take his class you better be ready to work.

Received my first B because of this class. Professor Gallardo records an hour-long lecture each week basically reading straight from a PowerPoint. When I reached out for help all I received for feedback was "it's in the book" or "it's in the video." I quit asking questions because I did not feel like Professor Gallardo wanted to help me succeed.

I would have had an A but got sick w/ COVID and tanked last exam- entirely my fault. This professor is great, understands it is a difficult class and works with you. He hosts lectures online and then posts video for us to watch each week. Exams are difficult but if you do homework and quizzes then you will be fine. GREAT professor for hard subject.

Professor Gallardo is an incredible professor. He is supportive of his students and is not "out to get them". He wants everyone to succeed. He is unbelievably fast at responding and he is available outside of class. He is willing to go above and beyond to help a student. I can't say enough good things about him!

Loved him! Subject matter was relatively difficult, but he has practical knowledge which is A+. He was prompt in responses and clarifications. I just wish he didn't rely so heavily on publisher questions. He kept having to contact publisher because he couldn't deduce answer either. Top 2 students get to skip final. Be prepared to work.

If you are taking this class get ready to write. I took it for a summer class and we had major papers every 5 days. It was a lot to take into in a 6 week class. I learned a lot, but I did stress myself thin. Take at your own risk.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class is tough. Do not take it if you want an easy A. There are essays, quizzes, and discussions on a weekly basis. Either way I learned a lot in the class. If you are planning on taking it get ready to be challenged and write, to write a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I took his summer class, and it's filled with essays and discussion boards (he is a tough grader on them), he does however give you feedback on your papers. I would not recommend taking this class as an elective, if you must take it get ready write!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Gallardo expects a lot from his students. He actually expects you to work and be on top if things with deadlines. His grading is tough, but made me become better writer. If you miss any assignments you are in deep trouble. The only way to fail the class is to not do the work. Would definitely recommend this class.
Prof Gallardo is a tough grader, but is always willing to help you get better. I really enjoyed his Organization Behavior class. Would definitely take again.
This class is very good, but also very tough. Miss one week of assignments and your probability of getting an A depletes. Overall a good class that requires a lot of time to complete.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took org behavior online and it was incredibly difficult. We had major papers due every week and even though I consider myself a solid writer, I received poor grades on every single one. This is my first C in 4 years of college. Not an easy A, avoid if you can.

I really enjoyed Prof Gallardo's Organizational Behavior online class. He is very organized and thorough in his instructions. He's a tough paper grader, but that just made me hone that skill a bit more. He was prompt in answering any questions I had. I would definitely take his course again.

The most hands-off professor I've ever taken. 1) read chapter. 2) publisher quiz. He ignores emails or is slow to get back if he does respond. Easy A if you do the reading. I would take again if I wanted an easy A, but I don't feel like I learned anything from him. I could have just bought the textbook and read it by myself and had the same result.
Hard class for not being a business or law student. However, I managed through and got harder towards the end. Exams and quizzes run from easy too hard.

I'm not a business major and it was pretty difficult for me but manageable. Every week there is a quiz and homework. Sadly need the access code in order to do the homework, quiz, and exams. Exams are very heavy weight graded, I'll make As on quizzes and homework but exams about high B and brings me average down in the low A.

Though I never got to meet him in person because it was an online class, he seemed very nice. He rounded my grade to a B when he didn't have to. It shows he truly cares about his students. As long as you have the book his tests are passable. Homework is easy and quizzes are okay.
Work in the class consists of 5 exams, 4 writing assignments, and 5 discussion boards.

You will have to teach the course material to yourself.  He seems like a nice guy, but I didn't get the feeling that he cares whether or not his students actually learn. At any rate, expect the test questions not to reflect the textbook material thus adding a great degree of difficulty. Avoid the online course, if you can.
This class is so hard! I would not recommend to take. Final is extremely hard and it counts 40% of the grade.  Horrible experience ever!

This  class was incredibly difficult and frustrating. The recorded lectures weren't effective for my learning style. I hired tutors, asked my engineer friends for help, and basically drove myself crazy while taking this class. I worked harder than I have ever worked on a subject and still don't think I understand it.
This class taken online was horrible. The hardest class I have ever taken. I barely passed. And I'll take it because i don't ever want to take this class again.

Only restates his pod casts. Offers nothing to help students learn a different way.  He knows  his stuff but I had no success asking questions, he merely sends you to the book.  I took this online.  I would not recommend a e-book or taking this online.
Don't take this online. He doesn't explain anything. He doesn't show you how to get the answers. Basically he doesn't actually teach the material.
This professor does not explain ANYTHING!!
I hate stats, but his online class wasn't that bad.  The group work really helped with the assignments (and there were plenty of assignments), and the tests were tough but most passed.
Great teacher of stats. Better do your homework though because it is not easy and you will have to study unless you are some kind of math wiz.

Dr. Kelley is so great! He isn't going to hold your hand, you do have to do your homework, come to class and ask questions...and if you do this, you will know exactly what you are doing at the end of the semester. He never seems agitated with questions, or repeating himself. My favorite teacher!
Great teacher, very helpful. Smart guy, he is tough but fair.
A very good teacher. I would retake QBA 250 with him again. Was a good Department Head too.. hint hint
He is a good professor. I learn a lot. However, he grades kinda picky. He marks a lot of points even for partial credit.
The book is helpful for studying for the exams. The exams were difficult.

Dr. Barbee is very knowledgeable and I gained a lot of insight on the topics discussed, especially when he connected the subjects with his own professional experiences. I like the detailed, informational lecture style and the PowerPoint visuals. I learned so much.
Occupational Health & Safety:  good course, certainly useful for students going into the Environmental Science field. Can make one quite marketable.

Hopefully students will gain from the challenge of this class and not try to dumb-it-down with superficial time consuming classroom "activities".  It is disheartening to hear some students say they thought this would be an easy class - I'd rather further my knowledge than to waste my time. For me, this class was time well spent.
Occupational Health and Safety course.  Excellent instructor, communicates clearly and effectively. Will make time to assist if we have questions!

The professor was helpful if there were problems. I like how he understands that improvement is the most important. He was understanding if the entire class didn't understand a certain concept. Overall, I enjoyed the instructor and would take another course with him.
I really enjoyed learning the content of this course. I really like that it will help me when I become a teacher.
The lectures are long and boring. He does not give your grades back in a reasonable amount of time. The tests are hard and poorly written.
If you've taken just one of his classes (doesn't matter which one) you don't ever have to take any more because no matter what the name of the class is.... you will be learning toxicology.
Great overall class. Just dont expect anything to be given to you when you werent in class or if you never had any participation with any assignments.

reviews.comment: He tends to move fast and can be difficult to understand. We do all work in class so attendance is necessary, but this also means no homework. The classwork is easy, but tests require studying from the book. Dr. Chen is a really caring and will help you out if you go talk to him.
Easiest class I have ever taken. End of story.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Chen is the bomb dot com. He is hilarious even if you can't understand him. He is best understood as a savage. Do the work and show up to class all the time and you should get an A.

He is impossible to understand at times, as well as never capable of fully expressing his ideas and instructions in a way that is comprehensible. However, if you show up to class, he guarantees he will not fail any that has perfect attendance.

What a sweet, intelligent man! He cares about his work. He may go off on tangents but if you read the book and take good notes and attend the SI sessions you should be fine for exams. If you can get Kara Mjolhus for lab instructor, she's the best! Don't be fooled by his age, he has a memory of an elephant.

reviews.comment: Although you have to work for a good grade in this class, Professor Schultz is a great teacher. You must pay attention and take good notes. Always study for the tests or you wont pass. Definitely recommend!

PALEONTOLOGY: I regret taking this class, I should've taken something else. This is class is boring, exams are hard, labs Dr Schultz expect you to do everything perfect. If you don't care about fossils, and all this stuff, do not take his class. You will regret
It can be a little hard to follow his train of thought in lecture, but you will get an A if you read the textbook.

He is very nice, very old man. However, what he wants is about as clear as charcoal. If you are so lucky to receive a review for a test, then what he wants is clear. If not, write EVERYTHING he says. Even the seemingly useless stuff .

Dr. Shultz is really passionate about geology and loves rocks. Going to class is mandatory, and if you take good notes and participate in the SI sessions, it is an easy A. Also, going to lab is crucial for your grade. He gives opportunities for extra credit. It takes some work, but the material is not hard and can be interesting at times.
Goes off topic frequently. Attend SI sessions and you're okay.
He just really loves rocks!

You have to go to class to pass the course. E does not go solely off of what's in the book but also what he has learned from time in the field. He is willing to work with you if you tell him what is going on. Like the others sai it is A LOT of memorizing. But other than that not too difficult of a class.
He is awsome if you dont like science but need a science credit this calss is it. He is funny and easy. Also try to get grant as your lab instructor hes the best
Dr. Schultz is an excellent professor who really cares for his students. He will do anything to help you succeed. If you are not into science, then this would be the class to take!

This is an easy class, but if you get sick or need to make up a test you might as well forget about it.  He does not allow any make up work and told those of us with the flu that if we wanted to take the test we would have to do it while we were sick.

This class was really interesting.  This is one of the easiest science courses I have ever taken.  Alot of memorization, no formulas or math.  The lab for this class is pretty easy too.  Make sure to take plenty of notes.  All you need for tests are the notes he provides.
BORING!!!
Funny Because he thinks hes funny
Good professor but has a hard time keeping his class under control becuase he is hard of hearing.  Lots of chit chat went on during his lectures.

Any professor that says to wait to asks questions till the end of the class is not a good teacher. Was not interested in the students, could care less if you passed or failed. If you get a 69.9 it is a D in his book, WT really needs new chem professors.
This professor was great, he taught me so much and his class was'nt too difficult. His curves are really nice, and if you study you will make over a 100.
This guy will put you to sleep, then his tests are the only grade no fall-back cushion grades at all, just the 4 super ridiculous hard tests.
Class was hard and boring. Didn't particularly like him. Did grade on a big curve though.
Great professor concepts are very easy just go to class
i am just coming back to school after a 3 year lay off.  i have not missed a class and have a very high grade. do the problems in the back to be successful. he is a great guy!

My "C" was due to factors that had nothing to do with the instructor.  His tests are the toughest I've ever faced, but he grades on a humongous curve.  I liked him.  He's strange, but in a likable way.  He's Albert Einstein with combed hair.

He is a very nice guy. Class is kind of hard but not impossible to pass. Requires you to study (not a blow off class that you can just not show up to) I found it helpful to work ex problems in the book at the end of chapters and read when things weren't so clear.
Really cool teacher!
He is great!

I had Dr. Carlisle for both second semester general chemistry and inorganic chemistry.  He is always willing to help his sutdents!!!  If you lack the necessary mathematicals skills for chemistry, his classes will be very difficult for you.  But don't blame him for your lack of pre-requisite skills!
very hard to learn from. I had to get a tutor and did better on the tests after I was getting tutored. I didn't even come to the last 2 weeks of class and learned more. Nice guy but bad teacher.
Carlisle does not explain anything well in Chemistry II and if you ask him a question he make you feel dumb.
No Comments
Pretty easy. 5 question tests, with the formulas written on the board. Cookbook type stuff.

Overall, the professor is great and provides helpful study guides for simple tests. Lectures can be dull but it's easy to get an A with a bit of studying and attention. Extra credit is available. DON'T PURCHASE THE BOOK. I only opened it once and it's too expensive to just sit there.

reviews.comment: I took him during May so it was 2 weeks of accelerated course work. It wasn't bad if you studied and watched the videos on the days you're supposed to. The lab was the main thing that I had to focus on because of so much detail needed for the lab manual. I loved the course material so I didn't find it difficult to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This course is a high tempo class. If you took regular genetics before then it will be like a review. I'm not a science major and took this as an elective science towards my degree and it was like a whole new language. He will round up your final grade if it is close. Grades easy on project and presentations. Reviews are broad for tests. Take notes

Amazing professor! Test are all about 20 questions each, and come straight from his reviews which reflect his powerpoints. Never needed a book for any of his classes. Attendance is mandatory, no cell phones or talking while he is. Lect&Lab have assigned seating but are both easy. Study review and you will make an A. Projects are easy A's as well.
Definitely my favorite professor whom I will be lucky to take more classes with!

He is hilarious dont get me wrong, but sometimes it can be annoying. He is an easy professor due to his tests all basically the same thing. If you pay attention to the review, he gives you all of the answer. His lab final was posted before so pay attention. His lectures are long because he reads his PowerPoint, and then will write notes after.

He is very funny, but he has a seating chart for lecture and lab. He makes you sign in every day and is very strict about cell phones and talking during class. He does a great job explaining concepts so if you listen and take a few notes, this class shouldn't be a problem. I would take him for other bio courses too!

LOVE Dr. Ghosh! He cares about his students. His class it straightforward and informative. You definitely learn in his class, its beneficial for any students planning to take the DAT, MCAT etc... Easy A. No book necessary. Attend class, take notes, and study everything on the study guide. Group projects and tests are super easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Dr. Ghosh was an awesome professor. So awesome I am taking a January intersession, a class next spring, and a May intersession! Attendance isn't mandatory but he will round up an 88 to an A if you were there most of the time. Tests are easy, only 3. 2 quizzes. Group presentation was super easy too. Overall a really awesome class!
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Very funny, made lectures interesting by adding jokes or personal experience. Has no clue how to work technology and his handwriting can be extremely difficult to read, but just point it out to him and he'll make it more legible. There's one group project assignment along with small quizzes and exams. Easy class as long as you pay attention.

Dr. Ghosh is the BEST. He teaches straight to the point, and test are directly from his powerpoints/lecture. Also gives a small review before the exam which covers everything you will need to know. Took him in the summer and made an A, by going to class everyday, taking notes and studying his notes. HELPFUL prof. who wants to see you succeed.
He's an awesome professor that is more than willing to help you in any way he can, you just have to ask.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Ghosh is a really awesome professor. I had him for a summer class so obviously attendance was important. As long as you show up to class, take notes and participate in the easy labs, there's no way you'll fail. He's a very easy grader, his lectures are short and to the point and he's very humorous. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: It is an easy class. You should go to class, take good note, especially what he wrote, follow the study guide and you can get an A. The tests just have few questions with long time to do. Moreover, you do not need to buy textbook. You just need print all the outline and study it. The material is quite short. The lab is easy, too.

Take good notes should receive a A. Took this course during May intersession it was quick and easy. But lectures were long due to it being an intersession course. He does include some funny short stories that correlate with the course material.

If you show up to class and pay attention, you will get an A. His tests are easy if you follow his study guide. His accent can be hard to understand sometimes, but if you ask questions he will help you.

I had to drop his class because 1) it is extremly hard to understand his acent 2)he doesn't reply to any of his e-mails and is never in his office when he says that he will be there 3) when i asked for some help he just told me to re-read and just figure it out for myself.  Thankfully there is a cc nearby that i am going to take the class there.

One of the easiest professors had him for both intersessions (Bioinoformatics and Cytotechnology) tests are easy and only trouble would probably be to understand him, but if u need a 4 thousand level class this is one for u

I took him for the Radio class and fell in love with it. I am not a communications major but I was still allowed to take it. I now host my own special show on the radio. Class does have a lot of outside work but it's still a lot of fun. Every week you go live on the radio and you can make your own podcast.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Absolutely incredible professor and person. Dane will go out of his way for you and help you whenever he can. 10000% recommend

His classes are fairly easy. If you just try, it's not hard to get an A. Textbooks aren't required and it's fairly easy to catch up if you happen to miss a class. He usually lets you know a few weeks ahead of time what days you'll do in-class projects or exams. Kahoots are used for exam review. He's super chill and understanding.
Dane is a fantastic professor! Loved his Video Production class. Would definitely take him again if I had the opportunity too!

Love this woman. Great communication and the most helpful person if asked. Material is basic and easy as long as you read rubrics and due dates which you should be doing anyway lol. She really does want to set you up for success and is a great person to have in your back pocket even after finishing her class
Absolutely amazing person. Truly cared about her students and made the class so enjoyable. This class gave me the motivation to get out of bed in the morning
This was one of my favorite professors. She cares so much for all of her students. There are not many assignments, but if there are they are super easy. She is so helpful and kind.

He is very passionate about chemistry making him a very bad professor. He is not teaching a course so that students will understand or pass but so that they become chemists. His tests are very difficult and grading is weird. He is a very sweet man but not a good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's trying his best, so I respect, organic is really hard. He knows his stuff but isn't very good at dumbing it down. Really difficult tests. He's the one to take if you want to learn a lot, but not the one to take if you want a good grade. Doesn't always answer his emails.

Ochem is a tough subject to learn and teach but Dr McGovern does a great job at teaching the material. He adds his witty/sarcastic humor to help lighten the stress level. Dont forget about the weekly quizzes the points do help at the end of the semester. Took him both for Ochem 1&2

Hes arguably the best Ochem professor at WT. He teaches a very difficult subject but does try to explain concepts thoroughly. I took both him and Shrestha and he was the easier course based on how he explained concepts and recorded videos of lecture so you could rewatch the material. Does not grade homework but doing the homework will help.

This class was truly one of the most difficult courses I've ever taken. The professor seems like he thinks you come in knowing more than I already did and than I think a lot of students did. I would get a study group together right from the beginning and utilize a tutor.

reviews.comment: The subject matter is difficult but Dr. Mcgovern tries his best to help us understand the lecture material. This class requires a lot of studying and effort. He is fair to students who try.

reviews.comment: Dr. McGovern is very confusing when he lectures. Most of the time he doesn't follow what he has on the slides and when he write examples on the board you cannot follow his thought process. I was confused and the only thing that helped me understand was reading the book myself.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Does not grade fair

He's one of the nicest, most caring professors I've had. Chemistry may be boring, but it is easy to make a good grade in this class if you try. He is more than willing to help you outside of class. We had giant curves on all of our tests He drops several of your lowest grades. He works tons of examples in class to make sure everyone understands.

He teaches from a slide show and sounds like he is questioning what he is saying. When some people ask questions, most of the time he has to say he will get back to them because he doesn't know. There is hardly any homework, but it is sometimes hard because he doesn't go through examples in class.

Elem stat methods is based on pretty basic concepts and he does a good job of teaching it. Homework every week but it is very easy. The quizzes you are able to talk to him and friends for help. Exams you get a notecard. This is a very easy class with a great professor.
His lectures are okay, but he goes pretty fast. He is a tough grader and will count off points for a lot of random things. Make sure you study a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Really good professor in general, just show up to class and be ready for pop quizzes. They aren't bad, it can be straight off of the lectures and notes. His lectures are really good and help you understand the math concepts better, just have to show up to class for that matter too, just for attendance grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Professor Lawler is a fantastic teacher! His lectures are in depth and makes sure that his students understand. If you are confused by a concept, he will happily help you. When doing practice examples by ourselves, Professor Lawler will go around the room to check on everyone and if you are doing good, you always get a fistbump! Highly recommend!
I love the fact that he teaches by example. There are different sections in this course but he is very hands on which helps alot.

Professor Lawler is AWESOME. By far the BEST math professor I have had. HW everyday, but its doable. Quiz's about once a week but can work with people around you and helps your grade. Exams are straight from homework and review questions, nothing tricky! He makes something so difficult so understandable and doable. Definitely recommend!

Great teacher, he was very helpful and his lectures are great. He does give pop quizzes once a week but he goes over the answers. You do need to study for the tests but nothing too crazy. Textbook is needed for daily homework.

He is very nice and sweet. I took him in Summer. His class is interesting and easy. The lectures are clear. Before the test, he always gives you the practice tests. They are very useful for you to know how the test look likes and prepare well for it. He gives you many homework, but it is helpful since test questions will be similar to his homework.

Awesome teacher! Teaches everything clear and to the point where we can understand. HW almost every night but he always asks if you have questions before class starts, and it's nothing to difficult. Group quizzes were so helpful! Very kind and wants the best for his students. One of my BEST professors so far!
Just show up, do the homework and you'll do fine on the test. He does a good job at explaining the material.
He is a really good teacher and is there to help you as long as you ask. He even helped with homework questions before class started.
Gives you a very clear explanation on everything. Does give homework and exams aren't really hard, but do study.
Best Math teacher I've ever had. He is so motivating and you can tell he wants his students to succeed.

Charming and very interested his students. Creates a power point of the days work and posts it online. Grades are posted shortly after tests/quizzes. You have to actively try to get a poor grade or not learn from him.
horrible...reason for him getting let go by TX A&M
BEST MATH TEACHER EVER!!!!
He is an awesome teacher that loves to help out the students.  He wants you to make a good grade! I think he's the greatest math teacher here!

Professor Griggs is a great professor. I have taken her classes for BIOL 2401 and 2402. Her notes are fill in the blank format and everything she tests you on is in the notes. The only thing you really need the textbook for is for the figures and diagrams. She also gives extra credit options for the finals. I would definitely recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Griggs is such sweet person, and is very helpful. Her notes are fill in the blank, and there are assignments with groups but are fairly simple. She gives pleanty of extra credit and as long as you study for the tests you will be fine. She will meet with you outside of class to talk about your test grade if you'd like. I enjoyed her class.

Mrs. Griggs is a great professor, and her lectures are very interesting. She gives a lot of helpful hints on ways to remember things, and has a powerpoint that you need to take verbatim notes off of. If you study the figures and the notes she gives you'll do well. Tests can be difficult, but they aren't too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Rohloff is a good professor. This class is a very easy A. All you have to do is do your assignments with effort on time and come to class. You have 4 major assignments and he will give tips on what to fix, fix those and youll more than likely make an A on every major assignment.

He is not very clear with what he wants in my experience. If you ask him a question about an assignment, he carries on and on but doesn't actually answer your question. This course isn't very hard and it boosted my GPA, I just wish he was more clear. He graded some daily work assignments, then a rough draft and final draft of 4 major assignments.

really good professor. Would take again in the future. He helps you with papers and makes things clear to the point where you can write better papers in the future. Also, definitely show up to his class if you want an easy A

You don't need the textbook. I barely ever showed up to his class and had to work my butt off to get an A because I missed the assignments in class but if you show up regularly it should be a walk in the park

Took Dr. Rohloff for English 1302, and I highly recommend! I made a solid A. Only a few assignments and he works with you to get the best grade possible. Loved his class, only one really long assignment the others were simple but you are given more than enough time to complete them.

Hands down my favorite class of the semester. Wonderful lady who will truly make you love communications. Don't blow the class off, really engage, and you will be absolutely fine. One of the best professors I've had and always ready to help with any questions. Don't take anyone else for communications!

Sweetest woman you will ever meet! Take her class! It is beyond easy, she is very interesting, has an amazing life. This was the class I dreaded the most and I loved it. Assignments are easy and she grades easier. She's inspiring. Assignments are very interesting you will gain a new perspective.

I was not excited to take the basic speech class, but Mrs. Gregory was a great teacher! She is so nice and understanding. You should do well as long as you show up to class and try your best. She is very easy and fair when grading the speeches. You can tell she really wants everyone to succeed.
The worst prof. I have ever had will never take her again. Thanks
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I love her, she makes clear power points that all the test material comes from. Attendance is not completely mandatory, but you should show up because shell randomly take attendance grades as well as sometimes give extra credit for attending. Shes an understanding professor but sometimes can be a little slow on email response.

Hope you are ready to reach yourself! Easy to pass but if you need the information for later classes you probably wont have learned what you need. Relies heavily on TAs so very hit and miss. If you have other options, take those

Love her. She really cares about the students. This class can be difficult and at times she does go a little fast, but if you are confused she's always happy to help you in her office during office hours. I learned a lot from her and I felt like I was getting my money's worth when I was in her class. Definitely recommend.

She is pretty decent. Wants her students to succeed and learn. Occasionally goes a little fast in her lectures so I found myself getting lost sometimes. She gives in class activities for the grade book so if you go, it will help your grade so you don't have to rely solely on exams.
She's very caring and tries to make sure you understand all the information. She is willing to help after class and answer any questions you may have.
good professor

Very straight forward. She gives you everything you need to know in order to do well. If you pay attention and take the class seriously, you will have no problem! She is one of the sweetest professors on campus! Very willing to help you if you put in the effort.

This class was hard for me, but got an A, barely. Teaches from powerpoints, not the book. SUPER BORING CLASS! Take advantage of bonus point opportunities, they turn into  percent each of your overall grade at the end of the semester.
Very nice teacher and had some really interesting lessons. I enjoyed her class even though I do not plan to teach middle school.

This course seems to have a broad purpose.  Everything you have learned in other Education classes, you revisit here.  In and out of the textbook, reading online.  Evaluating lesson plans, webbing, etc.  Inconsistent in many ways, but if you keep up with the work, should get an A.

I am currently in her online class for Middle School Reading.  The assignments seem to be either broad or really random. One unit you have 2 assignments, the next unit you have 8 assignments... and it is never the same idea twice.  In a way it is stressful because it is hard to get to know what the teacher wants.  Otherwise, you're on your toes.

This was my college adviser. She was difficult to work with and wound up being pretty worthless. I would suggest finding a different adviser within the education department. I extend my deepest sympathies to anyone dealing with her currently.

LOVE HER SOOO MUCH! she is so sweet, her class is very easy. She canceled class for like a month, and she never really takes attendance. She reads from the book a lot but it all online, she cancels class when you have test. She is very sweet 10/10

Absolutely love Dr. Han, she is so helpful and accommodating. She is pretty flexible with due dates if you just talk to her about whats going on. Don't be afraid to approach her!! Her assignments are easy to follow and if you have questions is is very open to answer any of them.
She is a caring and sweet instructor who teaches an easy class with minimal study time. Some tests are in-person, but the material is not difficult to comprehend.

Dr. Han is super caring and accommodating. If youre ever confused about something shes always open to explaining more and making sure you understand an assignment. Only reason I marked her as a tough prof was because the content of the class was a bit difficult to understand at times, but thats just me.

Dr. Hart is a great professor. She is good at making drier topics more interesting. I appreciate how helpful she was when I had questions or technical difficulties. The only minor issue I ran into was there were multiple typos in exams and comprehension checks which were understandable because of the recent change of class platforms. Great overall!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved this class so much. Dr. Hart is very sweet and passionate about what she is teaching, and that made it SO MUCH FUN. There are lots of readings, but if you enjoy reading it isn't too bad. The assignments were easy, as long as you read the books and watch all lectures. The work load could be a bit overwhelming but time management is key.

Dr. Hart is a great English professor. The projects we did in class were graded a little harshly, but I didn't think they were graded unfairly. We created our own study guides for the midterm and final and many of the things we went over for the tests were not on the tests themselves or had questions we didn't go over, which was slightly annoying.

Lots of reading is required. Has students "create their own study guides" as a group which doesn't cover everything on exams. Studying purely from the study guides is a bad idea. Has projects that don't feel as useful for a Lit course as they would for some sort of comm course. Very passionate about topics and in-class participation is encouraged.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Hart is an excellent literature professor. I've taken several literature classes and I have not enjoyed one near as much as I enjoyed this class. The readings were very interesting and fun, (even though they're a lot sometimes,) and the homework/tests were not difficult as long as you took lecture notes and read the texts. Highly recommend.

Dr. Hart is one of the sweetest English professors I've had! I took her 1302 course during covid so it was all online, the course work is focused around one big research project and she helps you every step of the way with it. She's always available for conferences/office times/emailing and is extremely understanding if circumstances arise.

The amount of time it takes her to grade the assignments she gives is ridiculous considering I had an A up until a week AFTER I took the final and dropped almost two letter grades from PAST assignments (3 or 4 weeks). Heavy course load and little to no comments explaining grading... do not bother taking this class. Poor communication skills as well
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I adored her passion and she was super funny in her lecture. She is DEFINITELY not boring and her class isn't so hard if you keep on top of it. She made me like British poetry and she was a delight!
Hart really made this class interesting. Take notes during lectures! If it's talked about during class, it is on the test.

We had to print out at least 500 pages of stuff to read; it was awful. And she's crazy and hard to follow.

RUDE  Dr. Jean Stuntz:  If you were a house painter and a home owner asked you to paint her house yellow and you painted it green instead, would you get paid?  No. Learning to read and follow instructions is another important skill that we will be stressing in this class. From now on, please do the assignments as instructed so you can earn points.

Dr. Stuntz is clear about what she wants and is willing ot work with you and give you more opportunity if you did not get the grade you wanted i.e. extra credit. Must show up to class because you get more points for attending...
