I took Ms. Mjolhus' GEOL1401 & can't wait to take her GEOL1402. She really cares about student success & loves geology. She is young & georgus which helps us relate to her. She supports athletes when we have practice or games. I wish she could teach all of my classes. She explains it so that I understand and find myself wanting more information.

Ms. Mjolhus is by far the best instructor at WT. She cares, she is passionate about teaching, she wants you to succeed but you have to do the work. I'm a business major & she makes me actually like Science. If you have questions, she's available & will figure out a way that will make you understand. She definitely puts her students before herself.

Ms. Mjølhus inspired me to be a teacher. I was in her lab a few semesters ago. You can tell she loves her job. I looked forward to going to her lab, she made you work for your grade but made it fun so it balanced out. I'll definitely take her GEOL-1402 class next semester! She's funny, beautiful and caring. A+
Kara loves what she does and also is really good at it. Her lab's were great because she is such an in depth person. GO TO CLASS!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is an amazing teacher! She really takes the time to teach her students.
Ms. Mjølhus made me think twice of the world around me. She has such a caring heart & passion for teaching. She goes out of her way to make sure you understand the material and she makes it fun.
Most helpful professor on the campus. Understands the daily struggles of all the students.  Makes you question the if the "cool professors" you had in high school were cool.
She's the best professor on campus. Her passion for the material really inspires you to stop and look around. Plus she's hot
She is very helpful with anything you need. As long as you put effort into the class, she will do everything she can to make sure you pass!
She was a great professor!!! I would recommend her to anyone, just make sure you come to class with your materiel or she will embarrass you in front of the entire class.
It's very easy to get an A in her lab class so long as you show up to class and remain attentive.  She's very good at explaining the material and has a vested interest in your success in her class.

She is seriously the nicest professor on campus, she helps you on your daily work, is always there to talk to if you don't understand something whether it be through email or by phone, she helps you review for upcoming tests in Schultz's Geology class, and she is just an amazing woman and I wish I had a professor like her in all of my classes!
Definitely the most help Ive had in college
Keila is a great TA. She talks really fast but makes lab fun. She's available outside of the lab and encourages you to think. Ask her to help review for lecture exams! Minerals are hard, practice!

Keila is a sweet TA. She gets real excited about minerals and rocks. Sometimes she needs to slow down & act more like a Instructor than a friend (I think she is a bit of a pushover & students take advantage) She will go out of her way to help a student do extra credit, or do reviews for lecture exams
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Overall a good class. He does have an accent that makes him a little tough to understand. Lecture is identical to slides posted (he reads them verbatim but manages to make 5 slides last an hour 15) so don't stress about missing class when necessary. Review is the same as the test with different numbers so I DO recommend showing up to review days.
Just take Dr Shrestha for this course lol

He does have an accent but once you get past that he teaches very well. he doesn't assign homework and the 3 tests are pretty tough, BUT extra credit can be given at the end and he will pick a random day to take attendance for extra credit so make sure you GO TO CLASS

I found Dr. Shrestha very caring and wants students succeed. His exams are just true and false questions from the class contents, lecture notes, and homework. If you want to do better in his class, you should not miss any class. He gives extra credits up to 30 points that will be directly added to your test score.

His exams have very few questions on them. (20 questions) Half of the questions are true or false. I would only recommend taking him if you took physics in high school. He has an accent that is hard to understand.

If you miss several classes, you won't pass. He gives extra credit homework, test correction, attendance credit, etc. which help to pass the class. Homework is solved in the class. Tests are similar to the homework problems. I loved his class.

He is a good physics professor. His class is not difficult but you have to be in class to catch the lecture contents. Exams are true/false and multiple choice questions and they are mostly come from either lecture notes, class note or homework. If you practice your homework, you will not fail this class. Most of homework is solved in the class.

He is a great physics professor. He is very consistent and clear. Although the attendance is not mandatory, it is very important that you are in the class. He solves most of the HW problems in the class and the due date for the HW is given for a week. He give extra credit assignment up to 20 points to boost your grade. He is my favorite one at WT.

He is the worst physics professor here, he focuses more on calling students stupid then actually teaching us physics. He gives exam reviews that have actually nothing to do with the exam so you often have no idea what to study. He often grades the exams wrong unless you are one of his favorites. But often tries to fail people he doesn't like.

I liked the class until after the first exam. Many topics were poorly explained and it was difficult to follow. Homework is easy(he gives some answers in class). Attendance isn't mandatory, but you will fail if you miss. Not a bad class but he is horrible at replying to emails, and often would never reply.

He's pretty middle. He's not super great, but it's easy to pass his class. During class he'll answer questions, though outside of class he's not really helpful. He plays favorites for sure, but it's not going to be that difficult a class. Super hard to get an A, super easy to get a B or C.
Really good professor he just has a accent but after a class or two you get used to it

Dr. Shrestha is extremely caring about his students as long as you put the effort in. As long as you pay attention in lecture, do the homework, then practice it before the exams you should be good to go!!

Professor Shrestha understands that the material being taught is difficult and that many people taking the class are not physics majors. The classes aren't recorded, but the notes are available to everyone. It is very important to show up to class if you don't understand physics. Take advantage of his office hours. He is very flexible with grading.

I took Dr. Shrestha for physics 1. For this class you definitely have to take time to study! His exams are basically homework problems so thats a great study guide! Also, he does say which problems and phrases will most likely be added to exams during lecture, so even though attendance isnt mandatory I definitely recommend you attend every day!

I took 2 classes with this professor. In order to succeed in his class, you simply need to pay attention to his lectures and rework the given homework. Everything you will see on your exams will be given in either a homework problem or discussed in class and his exams will derive from these two elements.

Im aweful at physics but he the hw was easy and the test were very identical. I would every now then miss class and regret it because he takes an attendance grade which can boost your grade not only that he tells you in class what questions will be on the next exam so paying attention and showing up are key for his class !
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Good professor for general physics. Go to class, do the homework, and you will be fine. Make sure that you visit his office hours and introduce yourself. He understands how difficult physics can be and wants you to be successful. The exams are cumulative, so make sure you understand the homework done in class. No need for the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I took his class for phys1401 and it was really easy and so I decided to take him for phys1402 and he was like a completely different person. For example he called multiple people stupid in front of the entire class and he doesnt understand our cultural and social norms since hes from a different country. So if you do take him good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved taking Dr. Shresthras physics class! The material was challenging but Dr. Shresthra provided really good explanations and demonstrations to help us learn. He was always accessible for whatever you needed and honestly wanted to see his students excel. I am taking his physics 2 class this fall and I am actually excited!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Doctor Shrestha wants his students to pass. There are a lot of concepts in physics that are very difficult to understand. However, the professor wants his students to succeed. If you study the homework you WILL pass the test. He gives the students the answers for the homework, but do NOT copy it down. Learn how to solve the homework and you pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Shrestha was a great professor! We go over the homework problems in class so be sure to attend each lecture! Hes super nice and definitely listens to his students! Word of advice, once you get your tests back, go talk to him in his office because he most like you give you a few points back! Definitely recommend taking his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: When it comes to classes this is great one to take especially with Dr Shrestha. Making sure to understand the topics and homework is key to success, and exams are similar to the homework. If you have any questions Dr Shrestha will help you out the best he can. He is caring, understanding and is willing to help out his students whenever he is able.
He was a very understanding teacher and very clear on what will be on the exams. Very helpful on the exams but studying was required.

Dr. Shrestha teaches a tough class, however, he wants his students to succeed and if you communicate with him he is willing to help where he can. The homework is very important to this class, and you need to take your time to really make sure you understand it. I did feel like there was a lot of material covered and not enough time for it all.

It is clear that Dr. Shrestha has a deep understanding for the subject. He is very helpful during the tests and truly wants every student to exceed. The only thing that might come as a challenge is it seemed as if he taught the subject matter as if we have already seen the information before and as if we already have a good grasp on physics.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Sometimes it was hard to understand lecture which made studying for exams difficult, in my opinion. I also felt that some topics werent gone into detail enough, and for someone that doesnt grasp concepts easily, made this course tough for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is very understanding, and does everything he can for all of his students.

Dr. Shrestha was the best choice for this phys class. If you put forth the effort in class, and follow along with solving the homework, this class should be breeze. Definitely not necessarily easy, but Shrestha gives all of the tools to be successful. 10/10 recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Physics two was a challenging course but Dr. S knows the material well and explains it as he can but you have to do your part and study outside of class.

This class was a pretty big struggle for me mainly because physics is not a strong point of mine. Dr. Shrestha is more than willing to help every one of his students whenever necessary. He is very helpful when it comes to the homeworks, and if you dont do the homework dont expect to pass. Never used the book in this class so save your money!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: The class was easy to follow and as long as you go to class and do the homework, it should be easy to pass. Dr. Shrestha's lectures are very clear. He is easy to reach outside of class and he will work with you to get the best grade possible.

Overall this professor is a great teacher and is well qualified to teach physics 2425. The professor gave all the answers to the homework which makes sure that the students understand what going on. That being said it makes it easy just to blow off homework and turn in what is covered in the class. You definitely need to work the homework yourself.
Very great at communicating with students! Cares very much about the success of his students.

Keshav is a very caring professor. He knows the information well and does a good job teaching the material. If you show up for class and pay attention you should do fine. The test can be stressful since they don't have a lot of questions but the questions are always taken from the homework so it is never information that he hasn't gone over.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Shrestha is a very caring professor. He wants to make sure no one is falling behind, and wants his students to all pass. attendance is not mandatory, but if you want to pass, you need to show up. He wont cut you any slack if you're not coming to class. he is a great teacher and loves feedback from the class. He can move a little fast sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: If you attend his class you will pass. He works all the homework problems in his lectures and his exams are basically the homework he gives you (which is like 2-5 questions a week). If you listen during the lectures he even tells you what will be on the exams. He makes sure everyone is on the same page and cares about improving your grade.

Dr. Shrestha is an awesome prof who truly cares about his students and their understanding of the material. He does the homework problems in class and they're usually due the next week, so if you attend lecture (highly recommend) you'll be getting free 100s on homework problems and a grade boost. Tests problems are very similar to HW. Great class.

Easy and physics dont normally go together but in his class they do. The class is set up in a way where the HW is integrated into the lectures so thats very helpful. His tests are almost like the hw just with a few different aspects to the questions and beware of the true and false questions. I will take him again for phys 1402.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: I took Calculus Physics 2 with Dr. Shrestha last semester and the class turned out to be amazing. The class was easy enough if you are willing to do the work. Tests are quite similar to the homework. Office hours are flexible. If you are stuck with homework or have questions, don't be afraid to talk to Dr. Shrestha.

He is a great professor. If you need additional help, he is always available during his office hours. He will help you redo homework and will often times regrade it too. The tests are just like homework. He lets you use a notecard on the test, my advice literally write the homework problems step by step on it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Khan is pretty good at explaining the content in the book and gives us plenty of chances to ask questions if need be. Although attendance is not mandatory it is very much recommended to pass the class. This class is very difficult without the textbook or at least attempting any of the homework. Khan is also very easy going.

Dr. Khan is my favorite!! Super knowledgeable and very welcoming during office hours. He cares a lot about his students and will help them succeed if they are willing to put in the work. There is no excuse to not making an A. If you cant pass the class youre simply lazy

Prob one of the worst professors to take he tells you to focus on one topic but makes the whole test about another his final is 50% of your total grade so you could have an A all semester then do bad on the final and fail
Just do your work

Professor Klaehn was easily one of the best professors I've had. There's a semester-long project with a group, so choose it wisely. He provides excellent feedback and is happy to help with anything. As long as you listen and do the work on time, you will have an A in his class. Gives clear rubrics and expectations as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class was short but full of information. Grading is clear, weekly discussions, and he offers good feedback to get you through!

The group project was a big part of the grade. He has clear rubrics for grading. I found his folder organization confusing. Read everything he puts in the folders!! I admit to being a little intimidated by him, but he is funny and always willing to help if needed.

He is a very good teacher and makes class interesting. There is a big proposal project that is basically semester long. It is a group project but you can "fire" group members. You do get extra points if you show up to class.

Do all assignments, go to every class and you will get an A. He is by far my favorite professor at WT. Klaehn is great at keeping classes entertaining and actually taught me to enjoy writing papers (even tho I hated it in highschool) He is always in the writing center if not in the classroom so he is available when you need help.

I took his Wizard of Oz class and it was so awesome! He is a great teacher and cares a lot about his students. The textbook was the movie and it's important to watch them because that's what the class discussions are over. Because the class was only 6 weeks there was one assignment and it was that you had to discuss your favorite scene. Take it!!

Mr. Klaehn is a great guy and professor. His lectures are funny, but full of information. I learned a lot about technical writing and now have skills I can use in my career. There are several major assignments, but he walks you through each of them and they aren't hard to complete.

Mr Klaehn is an amazing teacher he is sarcastic and that shows in his lectures. He cares about his students and wants them to go far in his class but he will not hand you the A you have to earn the grade If you participate and submit the work on time he is not as harsh on grading with a fine tooth comb He excepts late work but except a low-grade

Mr. Klaehn is fun to be around and makes his class enjoyable even when the content is boring! He also has a really interesting life outside of class that he does mention occasionally, which always lightens the mood.

Teacher is clearly existentially bored - not exactly engaged and it comes across in his teaching style. He is a decent guy - funny, smart - just kind of cynical. He's sarcastic, a bit condescending and stingy with praise. His instructions are confusing and his input is vague. Good luck navigating his disorganized assignments online also.
I loved his class, very helpful. He cares about his students and he's pretty funny and sarcastic.

He is a very good teacher. He cares about teaching and will make you learn. He does have a huge proposal project at the end of the semester that will affect your grade enough to pass or fail. This was one of my favorite classes to show up to because of his occasional funny stories and sarcastic humor. He does quizzes to help those who come to class

I really had a lot of trouble in this class. Got the lowest grade of the year in this class. Would suggest this class for those who struggle to pay attention, But not for those who are not very good at English.

This is a good professor.  He really expects for you to learn and work at a college level.  He will let you know when you make mistakes, but doesn't grade too harshly.  He expects for your arguments to be valid.  I rate this professor highly.

Favorite professor! Easy English class. He rocks!! His essays are not graded hard. Most essays don't have a length requirement, you just write till you think you get your point across. I highly recommend Mr. Klaehn :)
Professor Bruce was by far the best professor I had this semester. She is kind and will help you out in any way she can. I would definitely take one of her classes again.
Prof Bruce was really lenient on grades and when they were due if you had something come up. Shes super accommodating and will always make time to help if you need it.

Dr. Bruce did not provide grades quickly. The online Mimik assignments were confusing. The dates for assignments were wrong on WTClass. The final had questions from chapters that were not assigned. She did not know how to use or update WTClass. Did not respond to all emails. Unclear directions on assignments.

Plans Zoom meetings w/ dogs barking in background- misses most. Uses a 3rd party with an e-book & project; so don't expect any teaching. There was a huge problem with the 3rd party site the 1st day of class. Teacher immediately put the burden of getting it straightened out on the students & completely avoided taking responsibility for the problem.

Took 3 months to get back a single grade- this made it difficult to learn from the class & do the later assignments. Instructions were vague & emailing for help either resulted in more confusion or no response at all. Inconsistent schedule she can't keep up with, despite making the changes herself-- "scatterbrained" is accurate, even 7 years later.

Professor Bruce is very nice and you can tell she cares. However, like others have said, she takes FOREVER to return grades. I took this class as a 5 week summer course and the majority of the assignments took 3 weeks to get graded. It turns out that she is an easy grader though. Lots of assignments for an elective class.

Bruce, from what I saw this semester, has seemed to have had got herself together when compared to her other reviews. If you put in the effort, the class was not hard. Workload was never too heavy, my only complaint is that test drew heavily on things in the textbook (some relatable to the class, some stuff not relatable at all). Read your book!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Unclear instructions. Takes forever to grade paper. Seems she has a lot on her plate to respond back students.

So, this teacher is VERY nice, BUT she makes it very difficult to succeed in her class. I get the impression that she is too busy to have online classes, she takes months to grade assignments, which is really unfair to students, because it doesn't give them the chance to improve and learn. She is a tough grader. Work load becomes heavy in the end.

I have had the pleasure of having Professor Bruce for more than a few classes.  She is not scatter brained, most people don't realize how much she has on her plate.  She is involved in numerous things and does them all well.  It is the students who need their hand held and need constant attention are the ones who seem to struggle the most.

Summer session class.  Fair amount of homework and assignments. After the class ended, there were 7 assignments that still weren't graded. Some of those ungraded assignments were part of a larger project. Having had those assignments graded and feedback provided would have been helpful in fine tuning the final project.

This instructor is so scattered brained she does not remember what tasks she assigns. Her lack of understanding what the industry is sets students up for failure.  She does not treat students as adults, but as children. When emailing this professor always have a CC and document her.

I read a few of the old remarks about Professor Bruce, and it seems she has gotten much better at her job.  I had her just this past fall and, while not always clear, she would always answer my questions as fast as she would.  She has given good feed back on all my papers and assignments.  Lots of growing left to do in her teaching style though.

Fairly good class. Very into the students. Although she sometimes didn't answer emails promptly, she was lenient when it was necessary and stern when otherwise. Was very one on one. I would suggest this class

Terrible professor!! Very unclear on what is wanted and will NOT take the time to answer any student's questions. Overall, worst professor I have taken at WT!! I DO NOT advise anyone take any classes offered by Kim Bruce.
Will never take a class from here again. Plays favorites and doesn't want you to succeed.
This class was very unrealistic. The schedule was not stuck with and the lessons were always changed.
Mrs. Bruce, is a failry new teacher. Her class seems easy at the beginning of the semester, but gets complicated half way through. She would do anything to help you succeed.
No Comments

Very clear instructions. Read them or you will fail. Quality assignments, and feedback is given on how to improve the next discussion post. Very impressive for an online course at WT. Responds to emails in seconds.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Her instructions are incredibly difficult to decipher. Her expectations for a principle level class are far above any other classes at the same level. I genuinely never knew what my grade was going to be because she grades you badly for even a tiny mistake. I have loved every teacher I've had at WT A&M except her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: 18 chapters covered, slides provided as an outline, 3 mandatory posts(must be in APA style 7), one for extra credit, 1 group project with clear instruction and requirements, 2 quizzes scheduled right before each test(test bank questions), 1 product review paper, one easy certification required. Effort required, but overall very manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If you contact Dr. Khandelwal she will get back to you immediately. Expectations are very clear. Gives rubric. Valuable learning experience. Provides very detailed comments if she disagrees. goes back and forth discussing them. Lots of reading, project, paper and discussions but satisfying experience. Better than two other professors I took at WT.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Very little feedback. When commentary was given, was a bit snarky. She provided rubrics, but didn't grade off of them. I got 95% in the class, but feel like all I did was go through the motions. I didn't even need to read PPTs as book was sufficient. She is reasonable when you email her with questions though. Annoying, but not difficult class.

Very knoweldgable, approachable and helping. Provides a lot of good feedback that can help you improve on assignments. She helped me with my start-up when I approached. But class requires a lot of hard work. If you won't read you won't pass.

great professor. very accessible. promptly answers emails and other questions. examples and assignments deal with current issues and are thought provoking. makes you "earn" your grade. group projects are great. highly recommended
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: This is the laziest professor I've had in all m educational career. She doesn't even grade her own papers, yet won't give feedback unless you request it. She provides ZERO supplemental material, only the book and the publisher's slides. What a wasted opportunity from a professor who just doesn't care.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There are 4 tests, 3 papers, and 2 discussion posts for the whole semester which is not too hard at all. The papers were long and annoying, but the tests were easy and short. Only 2 discussions were for a grade and she offered a lot of extra credit. I would take her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: The professor is clear on expectations. If you do the work and you do it right you will be fine. Not graded on a ton of items so you have to make them count.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Seriously one of the nicest professors at WT who would provide feedback and is willing to work with students . Very knowledgeable and has industry experience. I was able to use the course material even after I had left WT. Work load is not horrible. Work on your projects in a timely manner. Very detail oriented. No short gun approach for this clas
Important things are announced. Read the instructions carefully and look at the rubrics before turning in the assignments. I will certainly take her again
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Avoid her classes. Useless lectures. I am better off reading the book. Or finding a better teacher.

The best thing about the course was that she would respond within a few minutes. Never felt stuck with assignments. Very willing to help and understanding especially for non-traditional students. Will take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Very inspiring. Do your homework, follow the rubrics. Otherwise lose points. Work is spread through the semester. Helpful instructor. She is available outside the class. Spends time on clarifications if any. Exams are cumulative.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The work for this class is manageable, not excessive by any means. The tests are cumulative. She is a hard grader and often times looks for you to write specific things on the essay for exams. You must follow the syllabus and rubrics to do well.
Won't take her classes again. Ridiculous amounts of homework and poor teaching techniques. AVOID!

Very test heavy but very poor lecture style. Course materials provided by her are inadequate but the textbook saves the day. Kind of threatening (do it or else). Felt like a school class instead of teaching professional graduate students. Will avoid this teacher and her classes in the future.

Demanding course but very happy that I took her. Will take her again. She remembers names and small details. She was inspiriring and provides extra credit opportunities throughout the semester. Aghhh! no extra credits at the semester end. Loved the assignments,and as a non-taditional student, I really appreciated the time she gave me
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Reading intensive. One paper, powerpoint assignment and case study for major part. Prof is very responsive. Email her, and she will respond in 24 hours. Challenging class but I learned a lot. Syllabus is followed thoroughly. There are extra credit opportunities. She provides feedback and is available to clarify. Downside- she will not curve grades

Aggressive grader. She will deduct points for using the additional grace minutes offered for test and exams. All exams are cumulative and include an short essay. She provide basic outline and encourage us to be creative on power point, then she deduct points for things not indicated on her outline. Slow to grade homework & email responses.

Marketing is supposedly an enjoyable topic. Dr. Khandelwal made it horrid and laborious. Numerous assignments that were unnecessarily time consuming. She is unusually strict with her classes and almost threatening. Obviously, this teacher has knowledge in marketing but not so much about teaching. Never again. Best avoid her lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: I've never read so much for a class before. I took the condensed summer class, which probably only made it worse. 10 chapters worth of material for the first quiz. Each quiz was cumulative and closed book. Very difficult. Understanding teacher though. Very willing to clarify.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Loved Dr. K! Responds to emails promptly and follows up after responding to you. Gives great feedback. Weekly forum posts, and responses to peers. One major paper due at semester end. Textbook is easy to read. Quizzes are easy. Just do the work and participate and you'll get an A. Material was interesting and useful.

This class is NOT difficult, challenging but not hard. It is a lot of reading and about 4 main assignments that took some time but other than that, there was not a lot of "busy work". You learn a lot and she responds quick to emails. The quizzes are easy if you just read and she grades fair but leaves feedback so you can improve on the next one.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Unusually high amount of textbook and other reading assigned. The large papers required significant work and were graded aggressively. The group presentation and case study also required significant effort and were graded harshly. It took a long time to get grades back. Actual teacher instruction was minimal, but thankfully the textbook was good.

reviews.comment: She was pretty fair, although Marketing is not my strong suit. The papers were quite difficult. Overall, not very rigorous outside of the big assignments.

Interesting course
Very helpful instructor.

One of the best teachers ever!

No Comments

No Comments
