I went to class everyday and was active in discussion, but I struggled greatly. He is a great guy, I just do not agree at all with his teaching method. I feel like he just talked a lot but did not truly teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Adore him! His lectures are very loaded and the powerpoint are skimpy so attendance is STRONGLY recommended. But he makes learning fun and is a blast.

He degrades students who ask questions. He decided he didn't want to teach from the textbook that was chosen so he taught from a different one without telling the students. Everyone is mostly confused. He talks really fast and tries to seem cool by cussing. All Qz and HW are online and make 0 sense with class material. Tests are multiple choice.

Rebecca Conway is pretty knowledgeable with theater and uses her knowledge to help her students. She can have a dry sense of humor, so wasn't sure how to take her sometimes. Overall- good class; not too hard.

First of all, a warning: If you want this to be a cakewalk course, don't take it with this instructor. She assigns a lot of work and takes her time with grading. I had to wait a month for one assignment to be graded. Also, don't disturb her during her office hours; she was very unwelcoming to me and at least one other student (that I know of).

What can i say about mrs. conway. she is the ideal teacher no person would ever want! although i got a good grade out the class, she made it incredibly difficult. too much writing for a stupid theatre class; more writing than in my english class. nobody did the extra credit because NOBODY knew what the damn extra credit was. she doesnt listen also!
No Comments

Dr. Rausch is very informed in the realm of political science, and he pushes you to get well informed as well. You can tell that he is passionate about what he teaches. Quizzes and tests were a little difficult, but if you read and study you should do well.

Get ready to teach yourself!! This professor does not seem to know how to teach. This was by far the hardest class I have ever taken, and he was so off topic that it made it very hard to follow what he was saying.

I took Professor Rausch the fall semester. I felt everything about the quizzes and tests was very clear, and ended up enjoying the class. He answers emails. I thought the paper assigned to write was a bit confusing, however I am not used to apa format. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Had to practically teach myself which is really hard for a statistics class. He seemed to know what he was doing just not how to teach it. All writing exams and when he graded it and docked points, his comments were irrelevant to the questions asked. Emailed him about it and he doubled my grade which isn't something I should have to do. Don't take!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He encouraged critical thinking, and always offered facts and unbiased sources to empower students. I enjoyed his clever jokes and comments, as well as his reading suggestions with fascinating content. Dr. Rausch took my political science phobia away!

Rausch gives you 3 assignments, a quiz, and discussion board every week that is due on Wednesday. I like the way his class is set up. I have learned a lot from it and I would take it again if I had to.
Took the online class. Be prepared to teach yourself everything you know from the textbook, which will not match up with the lectures that he found online.

This was the hardest class Ive taken up to this point. Be prepared to read, re-read, then read again. There was a lot of times there would be textbook readings but video supplements from YouTube that would show a different way than what the textbook stated. I was docked on an exam for using a different method shown by video than what the text had.

You will need to read the chapters and it is not a waste of money buying the book for his class. (I hate when a teacher makes you buy a textbook that you never use!). Was an online class so not sure about his attendance policy. He knew his information and I really enjoyed the content from this course. Fair grading and quick replies from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I like his classes, I learned a lot but the only thing that makes me not want to take another class with him is the Examity midterm and final exams, I hate to have to take proctored exams!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Good prof. Responsive when needed for issues

The class is great UNTIL you get to the group project portion. If you live on campus and take this class in person it would be a great project, taking this class online and having to do a group project is a nightmare. I actually wouldn't take him again for this reason even though the rest of the class was great.
Took the course online and enjoyed it. The topics were interesting and he does a great job communicating with students.

I took his online class for state gov. It was a lot of work. Not necessarily hard work, just time consuming and a lot of it. Like every one else said he THINKS he is funny. I also took his intro. To poli. Sci. Class, the first day he showed us a YouTube video he made of him walking to class. He tries to connect with his students but really just looks more like a big dork.
One of the best professors at WT.  Very clear and organized and you will learn from him if you keep up and do the assignments!
He's helpful and fair.  Tries to make assignments interesting.  Not so bad if you can handle his humor.
Really fair teacher. Took online class. Excellent communication
A little goofy, but an overall good Professor.
Hard work but you can make it!
Took the class online, Very easy to follow instructions.  Gives chances for extra points, and most assignments are not very hard.
He is capable of making Social Science Statistics tolerable, is there any higher praise? I appreciate his attempts to make class less dull and liven it up.
No Comments

This was an online statistics class. Dr. Rausch made this class easier to understand than the book did. He is a pretty good guy and a pretty good teacher. His humor is really dry and you have to appreciate it to like it. I would defnitely take a class with him again as well as reccommend him.
Online classes take a LOT of work!  Plus, he thinks he's funny.
amazing teacher! so kind

This course had not one lecture. You are just going to fend for yourself and wing it. No effort or teaching occurred, and you feel Rhodes does not care about the students since the material isn't taught. In addition, it speaks volumes to the Nursing Program at WTAMU if this is the caliber of professor that is retained and utilized.

I do not recommend Tamara Rhodes for Pathophysiology. She was merely a facilitator. There were no lectures, just the book and preformed slides along with irrelevant supplemental material. She was slow to respond to requests for help (2-3 days) if at all. Class material was often posted after due dates. She is not a good instructor.

In the beginning I was so sad that for personal reasons I had to take this class online,but never though that I would feel terrible in every week that passed because of this instructor.She never cared to make not a single video for us,she never cared to give us any adviceces.She can be smart in labs but please let her stay away from teaching.

You definitely needed to be in class to understand the tests. There are only two test and both are 4-5 essay questions based on what we talked about. He encouraged critical thinking through class discussions and debates. He was amazing at encouraging students to be free thinking.
He encouraged critical thinking. He challenged each student to think for themselves and outside the box. He has a fun personality. Being in class is important because he never posts his lectures.

This is the most difficult class I have ever taken out of high school and college, hands down. The exams are very tough. The average on our second exam was a 46. One good thing is that 60% is a C, 74% is a B, and 87% is an A in this class.
A 60 is a C in this class. He gives extra credit and 100 points for attendance if you go everyday. It's stats. You have to put in some extra work. He's always available if you need to meet.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He teaches statistics. He makes it very clear that you have to put in some work to pass. He has voluntary Q&A sessions that are very helpful. You have to have a 60 to pass, and gives extra credit. He was always available if I needed help, or was freaking out about passing. He makes a lot of jokes. Tries to make the subject fun. He's a good guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: By far the worst professor WT has. Loves bragging about being a drunk. Love seeing you fail. I went one of his Q&A and he acted like I'm to stupid to even begin to figure anything out. He treats me like I'm a pile of crap!!! He does not make anything clear or understandable.
For a technology professor you would think his website would look better whatever is going on it right now. Also a major douche

All assignments and materials for the IDT program are on Google Drive and you will have forever access to the material which is amazing. The only problem is, it's sorted by document type instead of by class, which makes it very hard to find anything.

The video lectures are very helpful if you watch them you will not be lost in the class.  If you ever need any assistance the professor is very prompt and always very encouraging. He comes across as really wanting for the student to succeed.  I would highly recommend the Instructional Design and Technology program.

Dr. Rose is a great professor! His lecture movies are very helpful. If you do your homework and final projects you will do well in class. He is very prompt with his responses so you are never confused. I would recommend this professor and the Instructional Design and Technology program without hesitation. I am pleased with my choice of Master's.

I learned so much in this class. I love the video lectures. If you have any questions Dr. Rose always gives a prompt response. I mean it when I say prompt. I have enjoyed all of the classes I have taken with this professor. I would highly recommend the Instructional Design and Technology program at West Texas A& M. Very satisfied so far.

He is extremely helpful and the response time is amazing. You get a prompt response to your questions. His videos of the assignments are very good resources so you will not get lost in his class. I have enjoyed and learned from all of the classes I have taken with Dr. Rose. I would highly recommend taking this program. It has been worth my time.
Clear films that I will reference beyond this course.  Excellent, quick, and specific responses.  He is clearly working hard to make this course (and others) real-world applicable.
Very helpful and quick on responses.
Very helpful. Expects work done correctly and has some complicated assignments.  Very prompt on emails, grading and phone calls.

A wealth of knowledge and the epitome of the word professor, as in one who professes his study. Kazmaier is the embodiment of a scholarly biologist. Loves to get into the field but has overloaded himself with responsibilities at the university. Lucky for his students! Take every class that he offers. Kaz is really too good for WTAMU. Use it!

Dr. Kazmaier sat on my thesis committee. One of the most competent scientists I've ever met. His courses prep you to be a wildlife/conservation biologist. He creates opportunities for students & really gets you thinking independently. He's an introvert, but I've seen firsthand that he really loves his students. Undergrads: TAKE HIS CLASSES.

Dr. Kazmaier is one of the most intelligent people I have ever met. Have a question about any living thing? He can probably answer it for you. You will have to work for your grade, but you will not walk away without learning.

Kaz is a genius. Well-rounded and delivers great courses. Content heavy but NOT difficult. Willing to help you 24/7. Teaches you to be a wildlife biologist. Very opinionated but teaches courses that help develop your own. Great scientist doing lots of research. Introverted but very nice. You want to take his classes. 100x better than Matlack.

Great professor, explains things well and multiple times so if you attend class and pay attention it is simple to learn the material. Can get dull sometimes, but if you put in effort and go to class you'll pass. Doesn't use a powerpoint to lecture

Best teacher ever. Hes so busy and teaches so many classes but still makes sure he has everything ready for next class. Hes late giving back tests sometimes, but you can always go in and ask for your grade. Literally the smartest teacher Ive ever had. Knows everything about everything. Incredibly nice and so so helpful. Will NEVER leave you hanging

Extremely knowledgable in MANY different fields, very technical, and won't ever give you incorrect answers. Teaches many interesting classes. Plant and vertebrate classes involve a lot of specimen identification and name memorization. Study hard. Essay question tests mostly. Keep your attendance up. Species accounts in Ichthyology and Herpetology.

Conservation Biology is really useful for knowing more about social issues associated with the environment. Kaz's tests are very long, thorough and require a lot of detailed knowledge to make an A. I think his tests are fabulous because he does not allow you to pass unless you show you understand. High standards!

I was one of the few people who really loved Plant Classification. It takes loads of extra time, and you can't just start on the project immediately because it takes a while to navigate the mass amounts of new vocabulary/how to use the key. Probably the best thing to do is to study the terms so that navigating the key isn't such a pain. The tests a

Everyone knows Dr. Kaz is knowledgable, but it comes at a price: he's exceedingly opinionated, and expresses his personal opinions as if they were hard-fast rules. A great guy to ask for help, just make sure you stroke his ego and don't question what he says. It might also be a good idea to develop your own opinions, and not take all he says in "discussions" (which seem to be stacked toward his views and against the students) as fact. Other than that, he's a good teacher, and I recommend him.

Best prof. he is a well of knowledge i have had many of his classes and have never been disappointed. btw take conservation bio, not required but learned more in that class than all 3 years in the program combined

Most knowledgeable professor I've ever had. He is a sponge for biological information, and you can ask him anything and get a clear answer. A bit shy at the beginning of all of his classes, but you will never have a professor you learn more from. The best.
Awesome! He really cares a lot about students and is willing to help you out anytime you need it.

Dr. Riney gives very good and supportive feedback. I appreciate the work we have in this class. I feel that it is helping me to develop as an educator and be thoughtful in my practices. He is responsive to emails and that is not something I can say for all professors.

Dr. Riney seems to think that referring to himself in 3rd person somehow removes himself from the long-winded and unclear directions. I haven't been treated with such disrespect and clear disregard by a teacher since I was in highschool. Please don't call us professionals and then treat us disrespectfully. We read your syllabus. Why quiz on it?
Dr Riney is a great professor.
Took Dr. Riney as an undergrad now as a graduate student. I truly enjoy his classes, very nice man and is always willing to help out.

A sharp lack of actual teaching and generic communication on individual assignments.  Treating Grad School like a high school course with weekly timed quizzes is not effective teaching (or professing).

Dr. Riney has a lot to offer if you'll engage yourself w/in the class.  He expects student participation & encourages questions.  His methods class requires quite a bit of work, but he grades easy so an A is quite easy to achieve if you'll just do the work.  He's very understanding and is clearly there to teach.  He's also easy on the eyes...
Dr. Riney is an excellent professor- and I'd definately take another course from him.
Dr. Riney requires a great deal of work for future teachers. However, he is always willing to help students and spends extra time to do so. He's an inspirational educator!
Dr. Riney's multicultural education class was all about assigning blame to teachers instead of helping teachers find ways to bridge the gap to multicultural students!

What a jerk.  Insulting, boring, talks to people as if they are studid...spends most of his time paying attention to young attrative students.   As a male student who doesn' sing his praises and appreciate his lame sense of humor...I didn't stand a chance of an "A"   Run...run far away!
Lots of boring jokes, rambles
No Comments
I would have rather watched paint try.  He is ther eason our education system is messed up.  Terrible teacher!
Dr. Riney is funny,plus he's cute!
Subject matter is common sense, so it's kind of boring.  He has a good sense of humor which helps some.  But he paces non-stop around the classroom.  I leave feeling dizzy.
I learn a lot about drawings from him. Very good teacher and very helpful.
I have been out of school for and have studied with several well known artist.  His classes got me on the right track and have been successful from the information imparted.

I love David rindlisbacher. He is by far my favorite teacher at WT. He is very kind and caring and has the most amazing stories. Unlike the other art profressors at WT he is open to all aspects of art!!!

he is a great teacher who is open to anyone and any style of art. he has great ideas but is open to letting you put your own style on his assignments. he dose talk a lot but if you can work while he talks you can have the whole class to work on projects while he humers you with his awosome stories. theres not a lot of lecture just help

he is a great teacher who is open to new ideas and will grade any style of art and will be able to help anyone progress in thier own style. he dose talk a lot but if u can learn to work and listen at the same time, you can have the whole class to work on projects and get some fun storys along with it.
He is a wonderful man full of spirit and knowledge anyone could learn new and interesting facts from him. You will enjoy his stories as well as his approach to art. Well I do...

Having him as a professor has been life changing for me. He has taught me an enormous amount and about art and life. He is a very sincere and has great character. I see it as an honor to have had him as a professor.
incredible mentor.  loved his style.  tells stories and makes class an experience.  very knowledgeable and nurturing.  scattered at times.  knows his stuff.
He plays favorites, if he does not like you he will ignore you and he is very vague, he also has tenure so he's not going anywhere
Would definitely take this professor again. He respects his students and will help you with anything you need.
I had Rick for IDS. He is super sweet, cares about all of his students, and is always ready to help you with ANYTHING. Highly recommend taking ANY class from him.
Gotta go to class, but if you do you will get an A.  Really friendly teacher who will help you when you need it.  Figured a senior level class would be harder, but I had fun!
Amazing Professor. Very understanding and caring of his students. Make learning fun and applicable!

His classes in the SES department have EVERYTHING to do with his experience as a former coach. Coach Haasl cares immensely about his students and brings real life situations and knowledge to the classroom. His tests ensure that you have attended and payed attention in class but they are reasonable.
Great Class!  Very practical ways to deal with stress in life and college
FORMER COACH THAT IS WASTING TIME!
useless, x coach
No Comments
No Comments
Takes attendance everyday.  Requires the book be purchased but you can get by without it.  Everything you need to study comes from printed out power point slides.

He was pretty mid. His lectures are insanely boring but also important. He knows what he's talking about about but isn't great at translating that into something students understand. There aren't many grades, just two exams a final a project and two assignments. He's always behind on grading, so be prepared to wait a while.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Environment Sampling and Interpretation course: This course is hard, exames I found it hard, I failed the first exam, but Dr Rogers gave us an opportunity to correct and give it back to him so you can improve your grade. Field trips are exhausting but it is really good because you learn more the concept of the course. 2 exams and the final.

Most material you will find online. This class is once a week for 2h 45min and it is boring. You will need to like to read, otherwise you will fail the course. It is environmental law, so expect to read all about laws. He is a good professor, if you need to get a good grade talk to him, he will help you out. Matching exams, study hard!!!

I took Dr Rogers Environment Law class for the second time. I did much better this time, the material is the same. This class is 2h45 class on tuesdays night. Believe me it is looongg. Well, we did two exams, library project, take home waste assessment, scenario  project and the final. He uses a lot of matching on his exams, you need to study.
Awesome course mentor!
Excellent professor in person. I've had online classes with her. Not as engaging but just as interesting. A very good professor. Teaches lots of meaningful information.
Waste of time. Made me hate online courses.
Great teacher...assignments were not pointless. Very good.

She does a lot of pointless projects in this class. I ended up getting a 'D' because of the projects. My other grades were fine, but because she hated my projects (and would give no reasons on how to improve) I have to retake the class.

He is an excellent Professor.  He is interesting, engaging, and makes sure you understand.  I am taking every class he offers.  He is brilliant and as a result is moving up in the University.  He is hard to reach, but that is because his boss doesn't do his job, therefore Russell has to.  If you don't take his class, you are missing out.

very personable! teaches discussion classes, if you prefer lecture/notes format he's not for you. makes students think outside the box, and works to help students reach their potential and grow as individuals. he IS big on being liked, but that doesn't diminish his value as a teacher. difficult to reach, due to his commitments to the university.
kerry/edwards?  soo old, get over it.
No Comments
No Comments

Russell is a fantastic teacher and person.  He is always willing to go out on a limb and make sure we as students step out of our box to learn something.  Even further, he will stop at nothing to make sure we understand what he is teaching.

Russell is big on being liked...Everyone seems to really like him, but I think he looses focus on what's important. His students (as opposed to himself) He is a political player and it effects class. He is very hard to contact!

Dr. Shea's class "lectures" are videos of him lecturing online. Which makes it convenient if you don't wanna show up to class. Though there is a ton of homework to do every week. His test are difficult but he gives fat curves like FAT curves. I once got like a 72 on a test and he gave like an 20 point curve.

All his lectures were video lectures online and were required for a participation grade. The class was based mainly on homework and while the tests were ridiculously hard, they didn't count much toward the final grade. I failed all 4 tests and still passed with a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: The majority of your grade will consist of homework. Which is really nice, because it makes the test grades not count for a whole lot. I did poorly on one exam and I was still able to make an A. The tutors in the tutoring center typically grade the homework, so I would always go in for help because they knew exactly how to guide me in my answers.
Gives good curves on tests but be ready to teach yourself
Great Man. Horrible Teacher! He does not believe in lectures and expects you to learn from the worksheets and videos posted online.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Teaches online style class but I still have to show up? ALL online lectures. Gives you a packet at the beginning of class and wanders the room correcting students. Honestly not what I want in an in person type class. Switching professors for Chem 2.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He does teach a flipped classroom, so if you do good with this lecture style, then you should do great. He posts videos to watch outside of class and you do the assignments in class and he walks around the class to help. People complain that he doesn't help, but he will help if you give an honest try. He doesn't just hand out the answers.

Yes, he is tough sometimes and doesn't always explain things well, but know that if you go to Chem Help Lab, they are great at helping. Also, if you study practice exam from online, you can do really well on exams. Usually good curves. He's a really nice guy. Don't get behind on hw or its hard to get back.

His classes arent hard. Hell say you wont have homework, B.S. Hes the most chill about attendance out of all my teachers. If you do miss, its extremely out of your way to make up. I work almost full time 27-39hrs a week, and have 16 credit hours. Im never able to find time to do the makeup process. Talked to him about it, no help but oh well
If you need class lectures DO NOT take this class.

He's good, but he teaches unclearly. So, usually, I don't listen to him. Do homework, read notes, go to the tutor or his office if you need. The tests are easy than what you study in class, so it makes you confused and surprised because he doesn't give many examples for that. You should understand the basic and practice it. He has a big curve.

Great guy and class. Chem is hard, cant get around that. He posts lectures and all you need online. Always present during posted hours. A few late nights as the HW  does take hours to finish. However, the hw and partner quizzes are worth about half your grade. Group tutoring and reworking old tests he posted were the key to my A. Awful handwriting.
Yes, the tests are ridiculously hard but he curves them just as ridiculously. Make sure you read or else anything he says will not make sense.
Bad handwriting, lectures did not help with homework, used book to do homework, tests are passable if you understand the homework.
Lectures with videos and then you do the homework in class. May work for some people but I struggled tremendously. The work sheets are also hard and dont make sense.

Lectures are hard to follow, and cannot read his writing. Writes his own homework questions, so good luck trying to find examples or get help online. Questions often don't make sense.  Tests are ridiculously hard. Tough grader on homework. Tells you to infer information, but takes points for not telling him, or not doing it the "way he would".

He just graduated from graduate school, and this was his first semester teaching. With that being said, he performed horribly. Test averages are around a 40, but he did offer extra credit and homework is for completion. His tests are ridiculously hard. His homework assignments average around 8 hours to complete.
He is NOT CLEAR in his lecture, tests are hard and don't know what he is doing

I took his class on-line.  It was very easy as long as you did the work required.  However, he was VERY contradictory with his instructions.  He also obviously did not actually grade anything.  He gave absolutely zero legitimate feedback.  It also took him a very long time to give any grades back.  Take his class if you want an A, not to learn.
Fun class - when we met face to face. Is he still married?

Okay, the semester is over and I can post this with clarity. Mr. Loyd is a very good teacher and cares about his students. You know when he likes you because he challenges you more than the other students. He doesn't pick favorites...I enjoyed his class and learned what I needed. The best part was that he taught us what we needed to know...Take him
This guy failed me because I challenged him. There was no need to go to his class b/c he's boring. Atleast his tests weren't hard.

I think this guy has too much on his plate...he cares about what we learn and us, but it just seems he doesn't have time to complete his ideas. He's fun and I got a lot out of the class...but I think he can do better. TAKE HIS CLASSES - IT'S FUN

It took him a while to get started...something about we have understand content? Anyway - He is moving along now. He's a nice guy. Young (and cute) but focused. He knows his stuff and goes out of his way so that you do too. He makes sense of it all. It's a shame he's only an adjunct...we could use more profs like him!  :)

I thought this class was going to be tough after the first meeting. It's not the easiest class in the world, but Loyd does a good job. It takes him a while to get going occassionally, but once he does it's great. Take him - you'll learn something and have fun!
She has homework due every day. She is a tough grader but doesn't teach any lessons.. seems unfair that we have to do so much work and she only grades what a company teaches.

Davidson is tough, but kind. She expects you to do the work and participate in class. I had three classes with her and would take a class with her again. If you show up and do the work you will do well in her class.

Knows her stuff, but we use one website ($75) for all of our work and she basically uses that to teach us instead of sending lectures or videos. Grades sort of tough on the projects so just make sure you follow her instructions VERY specifically. Also never specifies when/if she wants your answers in Spanish or English so be careful.

Isn't the best in terms of class engagement and it's really obvious when a lot of the other students aren't really absorbing the material, but she is never rude about it. Gets a bit tedious sometimes, but overall is a very chill class and the slightly strict attendance policy isn't a huge issue for me.

Professor Davidson is awesome. She really wants each student to learn in her class and cares about everyone's performance. For fall 2020 semester we have used online textbook that gives its own homework assignments. You have unlimited attempts at the homework, no reason you can't get 100. She did not use tests but had unit final projects instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! Davidson is really passionate about teaching her students the language of Spanish. I was there for the first year they started using the online homework, which will be due every morning before class. The second year of using the online homework she started doing more pop quizzes but she will tell you what they are over. 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Do the extra credit sheets she gives you because they are great reviews for the tests. Pay attention in class or you won't do well. Participation is required- she calls you out, but this makes you learn material!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: I loved Señora Davidson! She's definitely the way to go if you really want to learn Spanish. If you show a genuine interest in class, participate and show up, this class should be relatively easy.

Senora Davidson is a wonderful teacher. She knows whats she's teaching and how to teach it. However, she is a tough teacher. She's a hard test grader and you have to be prepared to pass. If you want to actually LEARN Spanish though, she is the way to go.

Señora Davidson, though a tough teacher, does give helpful tools throughout her lessons to aid students. Im currently still in her beginning Spanish 1411 class, but it's been educational, and hopefully I get an A.

I took both spanish 1 and 2 with her. I speak Spanish and there were still things that I learned in her classes. Her tests are not easy. You have to take good notes and do all the work to pass the class, she will not just give you the grade. But she makes the class fun and that's important. She was by far one of my favorite professors.
No Comments
Senora Davidson is so much fun!! She sings to help you remember the words! She's really hard, but also really helpful and willing to help you whenever! I loved both Spanish 1 and 2 with her

The class was really complicated because I'm definitely not a philosopher. He was pretty easy going though. He'd push you to think which on Mondays was rough but as long as you pay attention in class, you'll do okay on the tests.

I took his Logic class, which is a very difficult subject to study. He was funny, easy-going, extremely knowledgeable and passionate. He has a tutor, but he offers one-on-one help for those who need it. He even gives a few extra points here and there for effort. Highly recommend. I would take many more classes with him if I could!
Dr. Scala is a great professor. His classes can drone on a bit but overall he makes you think. He is also very passionate about the subject he teaches and it shows in his lectures.

His tests have a lot of content that he never went over in class. 
Goes over things that are irrelevant to our homework/tests.
He expects us to learn everything he teaches by just pointing at slides
Rarely goes through math problems step by step and if he does, he does it on the board where students can't see

has no idea what he is teaching.. he doesnt know what changes have been made to blackboard, he doesnt know that his students dont have access to information about this course and gets very upset about it if you ask him. The homework is 100% irrelevant to lectures so good luck searching the internet for answers bc you wont get any help from him

I actually had him for a graduate class (Linear Algebra 6332). Tough grader. Never answers his emails. Only 5 assignments went into the final grade. The homeworks took HOURS. Assignments due on Friday and wouldn't submit grades for the previous assignment until the day the next assignment had to be submitted.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: lectures are so unhelpful and when he talks it make no scene. Also he does not answer his emails and is very hard to get ahold of outside of class. I have him for liner algebra and he makes the subject so much harder than what it is.
He never gives any type of review for exams.

Good lord, the lectures are legendary. The monotone is on point! Read ahead so you can get great naps and understand HW later. In all reality, he is a good person and knows his stuff and is easy to talk to about the content, but the quiz of the day often ran over the allotted class time; it is graded too, so don't leave. Group labs out of class :)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The worst about communication. He/ll not show up for a few days and not ever post our homework, then expect us to know the material and have it done. Horrible about grading, extremely weird. Grades late and puts in all grades as zero when he assigns it so you cant ever actually tell what your grade is. Wouldn't recommend that anyone takes him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The exams reflect the homework and online lectures but the professor doesn't communicate very well. He doesn't answer questions fully. Only answer half of it then ask if you understand. Personally, he was hard to understand while sitting in lecture, but all of the online material was very helpful and not that hard of a class.

Fair amount of homework online for completion grade. Tests mirror the homework for the most part. Don't like group projects in general, but his weren't too bad. No attendance but daily quizzes worth a few points each. Reviewing for tests is necessary but didn't stress at all to make my A.

Terrible. Do not recommend. He grades discussions all or nothing. So even if you write a great discussion but reply to peers poorly, you will get a zero. His class is mostly busy work. It is a management course but he had so much career services spins on things it was hard to keep things clear. Grades hard then won't explain why or how to fix it.

I do not see why he has so many super bad reviews. It is a college level course, obviously there will be a lot of work. You have to interact a lot with your discussions and short posts won't get you a good grade. It is a lot of work but not undo-able. Group projects that are long, but split up with your group. Overall not bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Sellars grades the case studies as if this is a class for an English major. He also expects you to get all the homework done in a timely manner (there's a lot) but takes weeks to grade them. Prepare yourself for the end of the semester. He won't have all your grades in before the final.

Assigns so much work that you scramble to get it all done in time. Discussion criteria is not clear, he just says "more participation" so be ready to respond to every person in your class. Syllabus doesn't match the class work and he really doesn't give any lectures or notes so be ready to teach yourself. Oh and there are 3 group projects

Absolute WORST instructor I have ever had at WT. He is picky about every single little detail and doesn't give you much direction with anything.  Assigns group work to online classes and makes you take pre-quizzes before you can take the quiz that counts for a grade.  I would not recommend taking Strategic Management with Sellars.

You will have 3 group papers. They will be about 10 pages long each, and he grades these hard, so make sure you are in a good group. Each week there will be a quiz and a discussion post. Quizzes are pretty easy, everything comes straight from the book.

Best English professor I've ever had. And Ive had a lot of good English professors. This class really helped my writing, so if you're wanting to be a good writer definitely take his classes. He will push you to work hard  but he always gives positive feedback. The first paper I wrote in his class I got an 81. the last paper I wrote I got a 90.

He's not very clear about what he wants when it comes to essays and tests. He's a really tough grader. You have to try really hard to get an A or a B on writing assignments. Conferences help a little with this though. He gives lots of points away for classroom participation, so make sure to go to class.

Dr. Severn is one of my favorite professors. He is really laid back and although some of the material is boring, he makes it interesting. He is super helpful. DEFINITELY go to him during office hours. If you make the effort, you can easily get an A in his class.
AMAZING teacher. He goes out of his way to help you and make you have a good time learning english. If you have the chance to have him DO ITTT!!!

If you have an opportunity to take a course taught by Dr Severn, you should absolutely take it. He is without a doubt the BEST teacher I have ever had - the course I took challenged me but was not impossible, and Dr Severn is VERY willing to help students who need it. He never failed to make class interesting.

Best Professor I will probably ever have in college; quizzes were fill in the blank, but STRAIGHT from the lecture; papers were a little difficult, but he doesn't grade hard; if you can stay on top of things and not procrastinate, this class is totally for you; if you put in the effort and go to class, there is no reason you shouldn't make an A.
Honestly he is my favorite professor. He helps with any questions. I have not had too much of a problem in his class and when I did, he helped with everything he could.
No Comments

All papers are over the same topic. All papers seemed repititious. Mondays were lectures, and Wednesday and Thursdays were time with the TA's (teaching assitants). My TA barely spoke english. Had difficulty with her. Severn didnt help with my TA problem.

There are good professors, and there are bad professors -- you'll have both. But, I hope that once, just once, you can have a professor like Dr. Severn. He makes his class interesting and fun, all the while, you're learning things you never knew before, or see things in new perspectives. Severn is a great guy all around.

I would recommend taking Tao because he is extremely reasonable with grades and I can tell he really cares about his students. He wants every student to do the best they can. It is mainly a test heavy class but he is very reasonable with curves. I would recommend him to anyone and I will take him again next semester.

Very accent heavy. He just reads off the slides and works out the examples that are in the slides. Tests are very hard but they're graded on a curve. Not too many homework assignments, so the exams make a large percentage. Final worth 35% of the grade in this course.

Do not expect for anything to be explained or numbers to have a source in equations. You will not understand the material, and your best hope is that the curve reflects that your classmates do not either. Pray that your lab and homework grade will get you through.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you do not keep up with the material you will fail. Tao is not great at explanations. He can also be intimidating when asking questions in class as he is passive aggressive. He uses a homework website and app you have to pay for.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: You will write 3 papers about chemical literature about locating of peer reviewed scientific articles from multiple tertiary resources. He doesnt give much info about the assignments so try you best at figuring out what he wants from you.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: You will only meet up for a few weeks in the semester watching either online or in person seminars. Attendance and doing a research presentation is required for your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hes a great person but since English isnt his first language you will lose stuff in translation. The tests are nothing like the online hw but it follows the concepts in the PowerPoints but not the examples so try your best at riding the curve.

He's really nice, though a bit hard to follow. There's a lot of homework and a quiz every single lecture, which isn't very fun. Curves are great (on tests only)(unless someone ruins it lol). He's willing to answer questions, and tries to explain things. The material itself is really hard though, so be prepared to study and not necessarily ace it.

Hes hilarious. You wont understand what he is saying at first, but you will get use to his accent. Hes super understanding and listens to the class. Also his curves are insane so you most likely wont fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Okay, so honestly he is a good professor. He can seem hard to understand at first but eventually you get it. As long as you do the work and study the book you dont need to go to class. While this doesnt say much from a person who made a C, I was god awful at online and it was corona time so yeah. He is willing to help and gObed a lot of homework

Dr. Tao's lectures can be hard to follow but that's just the nature of 3511/4410. The courses cover A TON of concepts and are CHEM/PHYS hybrids. If you attend just the lectures you should be able to pass. In the research setting he is easily one of the best mentors at the uni. He will do whatever to see you do well in your goals.
Its not hard once you've been there for a couple of weeks and gives a lot of partial credit even on tests and finals.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Tao expects everyone to always read the next chapter before coming to his lecture otherwise you'll be 100% confuse. There is a small quiz every lecture and his test are hard and without curves or anything. NOTE: I'm asian and English is my second language but even for me it was hard to understand him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Tao is a hard professor and extremely hard to understand. There's only 2 exams the midterm and final which are difficult and long.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Tao is a good guy at heart but during his lectures it can be difficult to catch up with him as his talking speed is quick and his accent is heavy. The most difficult part for me was the online homeworks that will take up a lot of your time and only 2 test that you either pass or fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I am God awful at Chemistry, so I was really worried that I wouldn't pass with him. He is somewhat hard to understand, but not too bad. He only has a midterm and a final for tests, but he does quizzes every class that are open book and can use friends to help you. The homework doesn't match anything the test, and it's all online, so it was useless.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Accent is not a problem. Quiz's everyday, but done w/people around you which helps your grade. Homework once a week that takes hours and is mandatory, and difficult. Very helpful and kind. Helpful in and outside of class, definitely worth taking. Exams are pretty easy, but only two (midterm and final)
Dr. Tao, aside from his accent, is a pretty easier teacher. yes you have to work for your grade and do the homework but he is willing to help you. it can be hard to focus in his class though
Great Guy!
Great Guy!!  Very smart!!  Best Professor in this department!!!
Difficult to understand in the beginning, but once youâ??re in the class for more than a month... Best part is he helps you with in class quizzes and hw if you ask
It is really to understand.

Dr.Tao is the bomb!  I took him for chem 1411 and 1412 during the summer and the class was not that tough.  Why? Because I did the homework, attended class, and studied for tests.  Office hours are helpful, and Dr.Tao is always available after class for any clarification.  For the people who say Dr.Tao is laughing at them, please understand that he

For his Chem 2 class he improved his teaching method by placing the quizzes intermittently through the class period,we were more attentive so everyone did much better. He strongly encourages you refresh your own math, but will certainly help if you stay up with the course work. Go to class, do the homework early, you can do it!

really hard to understand. Must do the homework and quizzes. only 2 tests that are worth more then half your grade so if you fail just one your kinda screwed. he wasn't that helpful and when you would ask a question he would most the time just laugh at you. would not suggest to anyone

Understand that this is a SELF TAUGHT COURSE. You have to read the book before class and do the homework early if you want to do really excellent. I hated the quizzes because there was never enough time for me because I am slow and kept trying to learn from the lecture rather than the book. Yes, he is hard to understand, so sit at the front if you

If you could understand him you were doing great. When I asked for help, he laughed at me. Daily quizes are done by a remote you buy at the bookstore (if you have the money). HW was online. Basically, you either do really well or fail.

His English is not the best, but after a while you can understand him better if you go to class and listen.  I took Carlisle for Chem 1 and barely squeaked by with a C, so I swapped to Tao and now I have an A

I thoroughly believe that I might have a different opinion of him if he would stop with the daily quizzes, and slow down his lectures. His accent would be difficult enough to decipher at a normal pace, much less the cheetah-like speed at which he talks. Definitely not conducive to learning a difficult subject like chemistry.

The lectures are very long and boring. Try not to fall asleep because his voice is extremely monotone and lacks any kind of excitement. I made a B on this class but the class average for all the tests were less than a 70 if that explains anything. The test questions were very specific over irrelevant details from the notes. Would not recommend.

Nice guy, who knows his stuff in and out. Didn't need the book, the exams came straight from the notes, but the notes are fill in the blank so you have to go to class for them. 5 exams, all which are about 50 questions and really detail orientated. Study the notes in and out and you will pass, but does require a good amount of studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Sissom is an awesome teacher. I took Arthropods this semester, and it is very test heavy. Only 5 grades all semester and all were tests. I didn't buy the textbook and you don't need it. He gives you notes online that you can use to fill in. That's all you need to study, but it is A LOT. Not terrible though. Just a lot of information.

Dr. Sissom is an awesome teacher. His lectures can drag on, but the class is relatively easy. There is an outline with blanks for every chapter, and if you come to class and fill them in that's all you need. The book isn't needed. The lab is an easy lecture booster if you study, and the tests are all multiple choice. Not hard if you just try
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Had him for several classes with high A's in every one. If you study, you will pass. He doesn't teach blow off courses but is always willing to help you. He is very understanding and caring about your life outside of school if you need help. He really wants you to learn. Some subjects may be difficult for those that lack interest in them.

He has an online note sheet with blanks that you fill in during his lectures.  It is vital to have these printed out before you go to class so you can fill in the blanks.  He lectures from powerpoints and pulls test questions from the outline.  He is very professional.  Some questions on his tests are tricky, so be prepared to study everything.
You will have to work for your grade, but if you put in the effort you will be amazed by the results.

Dr. Sissom is very nice. But, it's hard to focus on what he's saying in class because his voice is monotone and quite. Reading book is unnecessary. You just need to study the outline. The tests focus on details and strict you on words. You should understand well the material. Going to SI class is useful sometimes. If you really study, you can get A

Definitely one of the harder upper level classes I've taken, but highly informative and fun to learn with him at times. Voice can be low and droning (easy to fall asleep to), but he's strongly passionate about the things he teaches and helpfully hands on in the field. Always willing to help, too! Tests are TOUGH.

Lectures truly do not make any sense and it's hard to stay awake when he is talking. The PowerPoint slides can be confusing and you better know the tiny details for each test. Tests are extremely difficult to pass.
Really great teacher. You do have to study for your exams and labs. Doesn't curve test much and no homework. Don't need a text book, just print out the lecture outlines and study those.
Tough tests, but I have learned so much in this class and am loving it!

He loves the subjects he teaches! His tests are easy if you study thoroughly. His upper level classes are more difficult and you have to know a LOT of information for each test. I feel like my tuition money was well spent. I learned more in his classes than I have learned with any other professor. Nice, personable guy that will actually teach and not just lecture. However, he can be pretty scatterbrained. Overall a very good professor!

This class is so easy is you take good notes and pay attention. He makes sure everything is clear before going on, and encourages questions if you don't understand. Textbook is good for the diagrams and going over anything you might have problems with.

Dr. Sissom is a really nice guy, he is SUPER interested in the course topics so he talks a lot. There is a TON of info that you have to study a lot. Tests are very similar to past years tests. GO TO SI! it is the reason i passed.

Class was helpful. Studying is a MUST! His test from previous years are helpful for your current semester. I opened the book a total of 3 times the whole semester (to look at diagrams). Bottom line: Go to class, take notes, study & you will do fine.

A lot of notes for the class but he gives you the outlines. He is very interested in Zoology and is a great guy but there is a lot of information for each test. You have to study a lot for this class. It's not a blow off class.

Zoology. He is very easy to talk to and a very nice person. His area of expertise is scorpions and parasites, so the course is geared toward those topics. Not much on higher forms of life, unfortunately (Only a couple minutes on vertebrates on the last day of lecture)
the class is not bad but he picks the tiniest details that are not at all important to put on his tests, and there is a ton of material to learn for each test.
Overload of information
His class gets very boring and there are tons of notes for the tests. It is a ridiculous amount to study for one test because he can only ask so many questions. But, he is a nice, personable guy.
No Comments

An inspiration to anyone wishing to teach English, and a joy to learn from. It is a chore to find anything not to love about her. I take classes from her every chance I get, she is by far the best professor I have ever had.
She is truly a great teacher that is really good at engaging the class. It was always exciting going into her class.
Professor Smith is awesome! She really cares about her subject, and her students! SImply one of the best!
No Comments
She made tough material understandable and was incredibly nice and understanding.

I've taken 3 classes with Dr Song and cannot even express how amazing she is! She is so intelligent and such a great teacher. She has such high expectations for you but helps you reach them. I really feel like I learned so much from every class I have taken with her. She is very fair and gives great feedback on every assignment.

I can't overstate how exceptional Dr. Song is. I wish I could take her for every class. She sets a high bar and gives you the support to reach it: clear explanations, quick clarifications even outside office hours, and fair, thoughtful grading. She'll recognize solid reasoning with partial credit,but your final grade is earned.#Imissdrsongsteaching

Song goes pretty quickly through her content but honestly if you do the homework and practice the problems you'll do fine. Books aren't required but if needed use a calculus textbook as an extra supplement and go to class regularly. There is a lot of content that goes through calculus 2 but she wants you to get better and succeed.

Her attitude towards us changed within 2 to 3 weeks after she realized our section had a harder time grasping the concepts. She thought we were stupid and got more and more annoyed with us as time passed. Go to the math lab every day, do the homework everyday, and you'll be fine. Just don't let her get to you. Had bad office hours experience too

If you have to take calc 2, and you catch a semester where Dr. Song is teaching it, absolutely take it with her. She makes a class that is known for being a bit difficult easy to digest and teaches the content extremely well. 
Exams are reasonable and homework load is not excessive. Be wary of weekly quizzes. Overall an excellent prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Expects a lot from you, but is always rooting for you to pass. Exams are reasonable, homework load isn't excessive, and she will give you a fair amount of partial credit for starting your problems correctly. Pay attention, show up to lecture, and don't be afraid to ask her questions - she does want you to feel confident about the subject matter.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: You must pay attention and be willing to put in work.

Most awful math teacher I have ever had. She does not care about her students and their success in the class. She is constantly corrected by students on her notes, homework solutions, and test/quiz solutions. She doesn't care about students personal lives. Overall the worst math professor. Avoid if you want to have a good chance at passing.
I would not take this guy if you dont need to. Totally takes the convenience out of a online class.

This class is rediculous and I will try my hardest to never take Sollosy again. He requires a large amount of pointless "busy work" and extremely subjective answers, and then doesn't respond to e-mails. He will waste your precious time in class and take attendence. He has no clear grading criteria so he can basically give you any gradewithoutcause.

Taken online Fall 2010. Class seemed to be on autopilot at times. Professor likes to have team assignments which I hate.  One lazy team member can ruin your grade and there is little you can do to argue your objections.  Exams were tough and had a lot of errors, but good luck arguing that too.
Overall not a bad class.  Taken duing the Winter Intersession so it was like drinking water through a fire hose, but I earned a "B".
I liked this course, but he never e-mailed me back when I had questions.
His class requires a lot of work from discussions to case studies. However, all the tests and case studies are done in a group so it is very critical that you choose reliable group members.

Mr. Sollosy knows his stuff when it comes to mgt. The problem is that he knows that he knows! While I learned a lot about mgt in his class, I also learned a lot about how great he and his accomplishments are, and how much he dislikes our school and that he's too good to even be living in this area! I wouldn't take him again if I had another option.
Mrs spears passed away earlier this year. She was a great teacher and was very sweet.
HOld on its gonna be a bumpy ride. She goes lightning quick, her tests are challenging, BUT show her you are trying and you'll be okay. She is a trip!
Spears ensures that you have a complete understanding of physics.  If you don't take the time to read the material, ask intelligent questions, and do your work, how can you expect success?
No Comments
No Comments

Dr. Robertson is such a good professor. He genuinely wants to know all of his students and relates back to us well. He is also so funny and makes his class fun and entertaining. I 100% recommend him to all. He is passionate about what he does, which makes it all the better!
He's a great teacher and willing to work with you on due dates!
I LOVE TANNER!!!
Dr. Robertson definitely cares about his students and loved his job. He makes class fun

Dr. Robertson is a fantastic professor. He truly cares about students and their success. His lectures are usually pretty interesting and engaging. Attendance is a must for his class but you paid for it so might as well go! He is very lenient on when assignments are due. I would definitely take his class again if I had the chance.

Dr. Rob is a great professor. He cares about his students and that they are successful. He sets deadlines for assignments but is usually pretty lenient about when you actually turn them in. Attendance is important because he counts points off for everyday you're gone.
Dr. Tarpley is a wonderful professor. He cares so much about his students. As long as you show up & at least try to do the work assigned, you will pass this class.

The exams were hard but were curved by a lot. There are some group projects, but honestly, they are not that hard, so if you get a group that does not help, you could probably do the assignment on your own and give them a bad evaluation. If you still get a bad grade on the exam, do not worry; he offers a lot of extra credit opportunities.

Tarpley was not the best this semester. He was very unorganized and all of our papers were graded all at once at the end of the semester. He says you need the happy state bank book but please do not get it we never used it. Be sure to go to class because his participation grade is the one thing he will actually give you a grade for. EASY A+.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Tarpley is a great instructor. He knows his stuff when it comes to camera equipment and video. Attendance is mandatory and graded. He is readily available if you need him and replies quickly to all emails throughout the semester. I would highly recommend him for any AGRI COMM classes. All around great class and instructor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: A great professor and teacher. He is always willing to help plus he has a great sense of humor.
Dr. Tennant is one of the funniest professors on WT campus. Most say he's dry but if you actually participate you will get a lot out of his class.

Tennant was a good teacher and he is a nice guy. But be prepared because he won't reply to your emails. The ta didn't know really what she was doing. The class is fun, he includes activities that keep students engaged and he provides great reviews for the tests.

This professor is terrible. He will never answer your emails on time wait a few weeks for a response. Go to the review sessions and thats the test. very boring, he's monotone and not very interested in the course and it shows. Communication skills are LACKING. he has a few in class assignments.
He is a knowledgeable professor! A material dense course. Exam reviews are extremely helpful. Very nice and easy to talk to.
He was a great man.

Dr. Thoman teaches the most boring class at WT, I won't lie, but go to class before the tests to get the review and put a little effort into studying. It isn't a hard class by any means. The only grades are from the tests, so don't slack on them.

Dr. Thoman might be as old as the earth itself, but he's sweet. His lectures are super boring and hard to pay attention, but you don't have to go to pass. As long as you get the handouts and read the book (most of the test is from the book) then you should be fine. He's a great guy.

Very nice old man, he prints outlines for every lecture, but most of material comes from the text book. Which you have to read on your own time. You dont really have to go to class, just keep up with the readings. Only grades are the test, but he will allow you to make them up if you miss! Great old man.
He is older and it is hard to pay attention. His tests weren't the easiest but most came from the book, but some came from things he said. So if you miss them you don't get the questions.

Dr. Thoman was a great professor. Really easy to understand. Test were not hard at all. And he is also a really nice guy, I was late to the final by over an hr and he allowed me to finish final in his office. Attendance is not mandatory, but if you go don't just sign the sign in sheet and leave, I found that extremely rude that people would do that

He didn't care about his students. He wrote outlines for every chapter which was what I was use to then for the final, he totally didn't!Now I have to change up my whole exam study rotinue becuase he "didn't have time" to write an outline. That is his job! I do not recommend him and I think he should retire already.

Dr. Thoman is really informative and his exams are straight from textbook material. I liked having him because if the topic is interesting he is interesting telling you about it.  He does not require outside classwork which is a big + b/c you don't have to spread yourself thin. When I was there, his texts were all essay. Good pick.

Dr. Thoman is nearly as old as Christmas, but he is a really good source for Political information.  He lectures the entire class and never has outside assignments.  His exams are not comprehensive so they only cover about 4 chapters a piece.  I recommend using the Textbook website to study because Dr. Thoman uses a test bank from the book.
Unorganized, rude, excessive workload, and could not stay on topic of class, but rather taught about journalism (in a personnel management class).

He is knowledgeable about news story's. I don't know what insight he has in public admin or emergency mngt. If you disagree with his views he will tell you that you are wrong and cite an article(Nytimes ect). Only considers the pub. he reads as reputable(don't bother to cite pub. he doesn't read). He seems to believe reporters are expects of all.

I have taken 12 classes under him and I would take 12 more if they were available. Great understanding of the subject matter and willing to accept other opinions if they come with supported documentations. Very organized and teaches adults like adults and children like children.

He is not an easy professor, but he is fair. He knows the subject well and expects you to do the work. Lots of writing but his goals are clearly presented. He gives you all you need to do the first day and will accept and grade work early. If you get behind, you will hate his class. I prefer him to all but two other professors I have had at WTAMU.
Good instructor. Sometimes unclear, but is quick to clarify. Stay on task and follow instructions and everything falls in to place at the end for a well deserved A.
Hardest prof I have ever taken.  Worth every minute.  Teaches well---makes you think and won't allow laziness!!!  Worth the work!
He was absolutely horrible!  I hate him - he is the worst teacher I have ever had in my life hands down.  He can't stay on topic or teach anything out of the book to save his life.

He goes purely off of slides; the entire class is memorization. He's pretty nice but can be easily distracted. There is a quiz pretty much every day, and they can be really difficult, so be sure to study outside of class, and to show up every single tie.

reviews.comment: Steffens is an awesome teacher. At first I did not like the class but then I learned that if I participated I would have a much better time. With participation came with more knowledge for the material, and better notes.

Terrible at teaching and lacks communication skills. Steffens refuses to use the online grade book and wont tell you exactly what your grades are or how he grades. Dont try to teach yourself the course. There is no book or online resources. Not a fair professor by any stretch. Dont take any of his classes if you care about learning or your GPA!

reviews.comment: Great professor to get to know. She does grade a little bit hard but overall if you put effort into your assignments and be prepared you'll end up with a A or B. Be careful who you peer review with because unless you see her in office hours that's all the feed back you'll Get until the paper is already graded.

reviews.comment: This professor does make essays into sections so that you can focus on one paragraph to get feedback within your peers and the professor. This made it engaging to write an essay without having to stress the entire essay all at once.

reviews.comment: She hated me and I have no idea why. I felt like she picks favorites and grades way to hard. I would not recommend her. She is very smart but its ridiculous how hard she grades for a sophomore level class.

reviews.comment: Lots of papers, and lots of reading. You can easily pass without working hard, but if you work, read, and try, you will make an A or B. Trela is the ideal professor, tough and honest. She teaches correctly, follows the book, and helps those who need help. Take her if possible!

reviews.comment: This class was not easy but I really did enjoy her. There are tons of assignments and she grades pretty hard but she gives you time to edit papers and accepts late work. She's very old fashioned in her way of teaching but I found that to be helpful and it kept me on track. I would suggest her but plan lots of time for this class.
I enjoyed her class. Although there were lots of things to do, you will be assigned homework every class day but she's not a tough grader. Learnt a lot from this class.
Mrs. Trela is a very good professor, she's funny, kind, and knows her stuff! She made the material very interesting and enjoyable. She does require lots of work, but it's manageable!
Mrs. trela is a very knowledgeable person but expects too much of her English 1301 students.
Mrs. Trela is my favorite professor this semester, but beware: this is not a blow off class!
Mrs. Trela is awesome. She's very funny and helpful. You will always turn in a rough draft of a paper before the final so you have a really good opportunity to receive a high grade.

Mrs. Trela is the best english professor ever!  She loves each one of her students and goes out of her way to make sure they are successful.  One of the most caring and energetic professors I have had so far.  Take every class with her that you can!
I took her for English 1301 and I'm so happy I did! She's one of the funniest teachers I've had. She gives you comments on your rough drafts, and that helps a bunch! I would take her again for sure.

She takes attendance and loves people who participate in class. Before you turn in a final essay, she gives comments on the rough draft...very helpful! Class often ends early. One of my favorite teachers!
Mrs. Trela is a wonderful teacher.  She is very engaging and has a respect for the youth culture.  Her class is easy to participate in.  I enjoyed her class so much, I am taking it in 1302!
my favorite she sparked a great interest and new Love for the subject
She is a really great teacher and will help you when you need it.
GREAT class. She is so great-she helps you even when you really don't deserve it. An extra plus-she has quite a pleasant voice. Makes it easier to sit in class everyday.
very good class enjoyed it very much. good teacher she helps when you need it and sometimes even when you dont
A great teacher.  Liked the way she grades and taught so much I took her for 1302 as well
Always interesting to listen to

Dr. Carpenter is by far the best professor I have gotten the pleasure to know. She wants you to succeed in her class. If you are confused, she will be there to help you, but you have to do the work. She's really funny and she really cares about her students. She makes learning Music Theory a whole lot more fun than it is. She's awesome!
She wants you to pass. You just have to put forth some effort.

Her online class was enjoyable. You need to read the chapters and you need to listen to the online songs, because they WILL be on the test. Tests are not too bad, and you can receive extra credit. She tries to help you, giving you hints and such.
Very helpful, funny, and always nice
Great teacher. She is quick in answering questions and clarifying assignments. Easy class and fun. Easy A.
No Comments
She is the best!! I loved everything about her class. My best advice would be go to class!! She is very understanding and will help you the best she can, the work isn't super hard either.

She was terrible at explaining assignment requirements and expected you to figure it out yourself. She isn't easy to get ahold of outside of class and doesn't seem to care at all about student success. She is the worst professor I have had in my entire college career. She assigned a group project without giving clear requirements/expectations.

She is severely unorganized and terrible at communication. I emailed her two weeks ago and she hasn't responded. All of the assignments we've done this semester are not on the syllabus. She doesn't tell you how much of your grade the assignments are worth. I'm a straight-A student and failing her class because she doesn't communicate!!

reviews.comment: I loved how excited she was to come to class and play games. Very laid back and the class is very very skippable
