reviews.comment: Lots of activities, personal fitness class has 2 class days in the classroom and 1 class day in the activity center per week. Would definitely recommend this to anyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great professor and such an easy class. You show up, you pass!

Dr. Hanson is very passionate about what she does and she cares about her students. Since it was a class that only meets once a week, she didn't have time to explain the information fully, so the group projects were a bit confusing. Read all assigned material. She gives listening quizzes over them. Ask many questions and pay attention.
Dr. Hanson truly cares about her students. Great professor.
knows her material, uses pop culture examples often to explain concepts which was cool and helpful. very committed to her students.
Cares about students...one of the best teachers i've ever had! ~ One of the best in the SCOM department!

I enjoyed Dr. D, she loved her work and knows her stuff, BUT if you want to make a good grade, don't miss class. She skips around in the book, and taking good notes can be difficult. My biggest problem is the tests are a midterm and a final, it is a LOT of info to remember for each test.
If you can, pleas avoid her!..I love history and I hated that class!...really, really, really boring..hard to me to stay awake!...lessons did not go with the book!..AVOID!

Dr. De la Trinidad clearly loves the subject she teaches and cares about her students. The only problem is that she doesn't do a very good job of managing the classroom and is easily distracted. If you want an A in her class, it will require some effort outside at home. This isn't a class where you can just show up and expect to pass.

Dr. Tyrer provided helpful feedback on the assignments, which allowed me to improve and ultimately do quite well. Be sure to pay attention to the rules. Participate in the case studies, and post your drafts in the discussion board in a timely manner, to obtain feedback from classmates. Participation is a big part of the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved this class and this professor. The stories are super interesting and Tyrer is totally ready to help you. Sure the grading criteria may seem vague on the papers but she is quick to respond and will give you so much help and encouragement if you ask. If you like sci-fi stories and want to be a better writer, take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She has a few discussion posts and it can seem like a lot but if you stay on top of things its an easy class. Gives extra credit often. It was online so there was no meeting time.

I took Dr. Tyrers creative writing poetry class and absolutely loved it. Shes an amazing woman and really knows what shes doing. Shell give you great feedback on your poems and will help in any way she can. I would highly recommend taking a class with her!

(Eng Comm online) Just.. no. Vague instructions for assignments, I had to ask her to clarify almost every assignment. Frustrating, took awhile for replies. No grading rubric, got away with taking 50 points from my midterm for 1 mistake.  Suggested I should take a 0 on my final with 6 months left. Luckily the class was so easy, she couldn't give a B
She is a very abrasive person, but beneath the shell she is a sweet cookie.  Be prepared to write a lot, and read n front of people every week. Introverts beware.
Took online
No Comments

Took the class online.  Does a good job of helping you before your final draft with things to correct.  Sometimes instructions for reviewing other people's papers are hard to understand, which can really change your grade in a negative way.

I actually took this class online, but Dr. Tyrer was easily the best online professor I have had!  She was always willing to answer questions, and her class material was consistently enjoyable.  Take this class! It doesn't take more than about an hour or two a week, and is fun along the way.
She is one of best professors I have studied with. She is awesome. I was almost to drop my class because of some difficulties I faced, but she helped me a lot!

Dr. V class is an easy A. I missed exactly 3 classes and passed. She has a great personality, and goes through her lectures well and in-depth. She will answer questions. She responds to her emails promptly.  A total of 4 exams, 1 assignment, group project, and attendance & participation is graded. Lenient but wants her work done.
Love Dr V she's the best def would take her again in an heartbeat

I think I would've liked Dr. V more if I took her for a different class; 2272 is kind of a joke when you're a junior. I didn't care about the class content, but I did like Dr. V. She was energetic, knowledgable, hilarious, and encouraged discussion. I hope to take her for an upper-level class to get a better feel for her!

Dr. V is awesome!  I knew nothing about psych before I took this course, but she was very knowledgeable and always there to help.  You def won't fall asleep in this class, she is very fun and outgoing.  I would recommend this class  to everyone.

Dr. V is a lot of fun. I took her my very first semester and I loved her class! She is from Canada, so she has a bit of that Canadian accent, but its great! She is really fun and really nice. She tries her best to help in any way possible.

Dr. Ward can be fun as long as the class is too. His test are the only main grades in this course besides the little "pop quizzes" which are mostly for attendance grade to help boost those who attend. I recommend printing out his lectures and taking notes during it. He gives 5-10 point curves depending on how many people miss a certain question.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Ward's lectures are primarily what's on the exam, plus application. If you want to learn, he's a great professor. Skipping class is detrimental to your grade because he'll mention things in class that are not in the power points or book. Reading the book helps if you need another source of information, but it's not the same as his lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great guy, fun to talk to in and outside of class. Never purchased a book, just studied his powerpoints and everything he talked about in class. Has about 3 exams which were all difficult except the last. He curves a lot because a lot don't pass, and grades heavy on projects/essays. I enjoy him, but do not suggest unless naturally intelligent.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Ward is a very nice professor, however being in class is rather pointless. The only reason to go to class is because he gives random pop quizzes. He said if you're there you probably get full credit, so it's an attendance grade essentially. There's only 3 tests. Go to the review sessions that the older students offer because they are so helpful

You are only graded on 3 exams.  The last exam covered around 6 chapters.  He has pop quizzes randomly so it's important to be in class.  He also says things in class that are not on the powerpoints.  Reading will really help you understand the content if you are confused in class.  He is available in his office too.  Funny and nice!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Ward is a very nice and caring professor. The tests aren't too bad, just don't overthem and go to class because he does give pop quizzes. However, the class is usually at 8 a.m. so be prepared with your choice of caffeine to help you through.

Dr. Ward is awesome. He cares for his students and is willing to help in any way. He doesn't go to far into depth, so reading your book may help. He provides and SI for exams which is VERY helpful. Three exams, which includes the final, not comprehensive btw. A few easy pop quizzes to help higher grade. I highly recommend!
He expects you to be in class and on time and gives pop quizzes that are really easy and will help bump your grade. Tests are tough but much easier if you attend the SI sessions.

Dr. Ward is the sweetest! So helpful and caring, he wants the best for his students. Only had 3 exams, which are difficult if you don't read, study or attend the review sessions provided by SI. Gives pop quizzes that are easy 100's. Easy A-B if you study and attend review. Great professor!
Lectures don't make hardly any sense.
Dr. Ward is interesting, funny, and a great professor. He seems genuinely interested in making sure his students understand the material.

Good geneticist, albeit old school, and can apply theory to real world. Have had several classes with him, all interesting and well delivered. Funny, genuine, helpful, intelligent. Good with grads and undergrads. Good wildlife research. WT needs more genetics classes!

Although attending lectures isn't mandatory, its highly recommended. His quizzes are NOT open book or notes, and he uses them as attendance. Being an AG major, I have not benefited from this course as I had hoped. Ag related content was summed up in one class period. He makes content difficult to understand.

Had him for Biol I, Genetics, and about to take for Molecular Cytogenetics. Clear on what's on the test, always willing to elaborate, GREAT with people. Always curves tests, tests always M/C. A warning for his higher level classes: his tests have gotten harder, utilize the tutors he recommends.

Great teacher! Very easy-going and funny. Lectures not mandatory, some classes are just spent watching videos. All power points are online. Occasional quizzes (easy, often open-book). Tests are easy with some studying. Honors section is easy as well. Definitely reccommen

Dr. Ward is laid back, kind, and generally awesome. Though he's a kick-ass conservation geneticist, he has a background in psychology, so he's very easy to talk with and relate to. He rocks! (had him for Conservation Genetics Special Topics course)
Great teacher! Gives curves
HE'S GREATTTT!!! he lectures most of the time and gives good notes. just read the notes and little bit from the textbook and you would get a 'B' in this class.

He's great and I learned a lot.  Hard work paid off. If you're like the person below who thinks that writing essays is "pointless and stupid," then you won't like him.  It's a writing cvlass after all, and boneheads don't belong in this class.

At the first day of class I really liked professor Werden, but after getting to know him, he started to become really mean and strict. Every single day we would do essays and comment o n other people's essays which I thought was pointless and stupid. I went to class every single day, did all the idiodic work he assigned and still made a C in the cl

Dr. Werden gives you hints and tips all year as to what will appear on the final. IF you read, IF you do your homework and IF you attend chats... you'll do fine. Looking at the previous post though; I'd say if you are barely literate then no, this class will prove too difficult for you to handle.

He's class was aweful!!! We has to read, The Od. Illiad, ect. And the final was 15 random quotes from each story, and you had tell him who said it, who it was said to, what it meant, how important it was, and the theme of the chapter it came from. He's extremely hard and unfai.

Dr. Wright is great. He has a dry sense of humor that is sometimes interpreted as mean. He makes students figure things out for themselves. This way of teaching has really pushed me to understand biometry, instead of just regurgitating equations. His classes are very basic, so you can truly understand each concept, instead of brushing past things.
He is a difficult person to deal with. Not willing to help you at all. Does not explain well.Does not have office hours, is hard to find and does not have set dates for exams.
Very old, needs to retire. Terrible prof, will never take a class of his again. Does not prepare you for tests and is not willing to help you after class

Very tough teacher. Material doesn't seem too tough but he throws lots of curve balls on the exams and loves testing over all the exceptions. There is homework but you do not receive a grade for it. Go to SI sessions-this is how I did so well in the course.

This a very difficult class if you don't pay attention. Go to SI sessions they will help and they know how he grades his tests. If you don't learn in class you can just read his slideshow book that you purchase and get the information that way instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Woodyard is a very good teacher. He truly cares about his students and is always there for help if you need him to check something or do not fully understand something. Get a white board and just go through the notes over and over weeks before exam and you will be fine. He also likes to pull some things from the book so look through that.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: No homework or feeeback, and good luck on the tests... very difficult grader, be ready to study for weeks and maybe get a D

Dr. Woodyard is a very tough professor but you do learn a lot in his classes. You need to spend at ton of outside of class to master the concepts. You need to master the concepts to do well in this class. The TA's and tutors are very helpful so take advantage of their awesomeness!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you take his elementary organic class, show up to class everyday and do your homework right away. Basically I don't know why people think his class is hard. Basically you need to study his notes. I mean really study his notes. Afterwards, do your homework and ask him for help after class. If you do everything I just mentioned,you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Woodyard is a very harsh grader and his expectations in this class is almost unattainable.

he is a nice guy but if an arrow is not perfectly above bc you were anxious and working quickly but the answer is clearly correct you will lose 5pts. overall lectures didn't teach me much, made it to every lecture-still had to teach myself. if  taking his class expect to spend your whole semester studying for ONLY his class, get outside help.
The 3032013 was hilarious.  Putty made me wish I was dead.

O chem is super tough.  His grading is harsh - if your arrow is not in the perfect angle or length you will love points.  His notes are gold - if it's in the notes, you must know it - all of it.  There are only a couple things to know from the books.  If you ask for help, he'll send you to another student or TA.  Get a tutor through WT.

Dr Woodyard is tough, but fair. That is a good thing since by being a hard class it weeds out those people who would not do well in professional school. To get through this course make sure you ask your TA's lots of questions, make study guides for each test that summarizes the slides in a condensed form. Make sure you form study groups they help.

Dr. Woodyard is the sweetest old man I've ever met, he tries so hard to keep you interested and be funny, is very caring and invested in his students. He gives you every note you ever need printed out and loves to help you. He just understands chemistry on a level that he can't teach it simply. He's great but don't take if you struggle with chem.
Easiest Class I’ve taken by far... I don’t see why everyone complains... I love Putty! best thing ever!

This is the hardest class i have taken in my three years of college. His tests get harder every year (I have 2007-2011 tests) and an A was nearly impossible this semester. I am going to Tech to take ochem 2 next semester. I would say to stay away from this class unless you need a GPA hit.
Just study hard and you will make an A. Dr. Woodyard follows a Bell Curve no matter what, at the end of the semester if you failed, it's because you're an idiot and deserved to fail.

The hardest class you will take as an undergraduate. If you think Organic 1 was hard, well Organic 2 is ten times harder. Do not forget anything from Organic 1.There is much more material, but I found it easier than Organic 1 since it just builds on the concepts. Lab tests are kinda of fair unless he throws a curve ball. Know NMR very well.Goodluck

Great teacher, The class is a definite "weeder" class. Thank god some teachers still believe that a student should understand the material in order to pass the class.  People who are taking organic are the doctors, pharmacists, dentists......etc of the future!  Thanks for everything Dr.Woodyard, your apart of a rare breed.

Don't expect to get an A if you're female-he prefers males.  Online homework is ridiculous, and the tests and precise grading are hard to get used to.  He does teach well, though, and if you pass, you know your stuff!

Where can I start he is a good teacher..his test are not bad but he throws in stuff he does not cover..his homework is harder than the actual tests and a waste of time..89.5 is not an A in his class...he has favorites...his final hardly covers the material he covered in class..not hard if you try just study..goodluck you'll need it
boring, hard tests, designs his own program for online homework which is hard in its self, and does not answer questions clearly
monotone...have a question? stay after class for an answer.

Cool guy.  Easy class for a chemistry class, although his tests are a bit more challenging.  I found attendance to be optional as long as I made it to the tests.  Tests are only 20 questions, and multiple choice.  Looking forward to having him again for organic.

He's a good teacher and willing to help. I can't garentee you'll understand his answers. His test are outrageously hard. Don't take him if you can help it. But you will hit him in Organic Chem 1. So watch out.

I must admit, his monotone voice has put me to sleep many a times; however, if you ever have any questions he is more than willing to help.  Overall, the class is ****ing hard and the whole 20 dollars for a practice exam is ****.
Sure the labs are easy but the material in class is so clustered and crammed together makes the exams hard
understandalbe as a fence post
If you miss one class, kiss the whole semester goodbye
Brilliant, but tough!  Don't expect any free weekends
No Comments
Dr. Woodyard is thorough and fair. If one chooses not to study, then one will not be successful in his classes. It is an honor to have taken a class from him.

Since my attendance at WTAMU, the phrase  Wailing and gnashing or teeth  has often been associated with Dr. James Woodward's classes.  Students looking for a blow off class, blow somewhere else.  You will work and pray for your A, or just study for your D
